The following workspace instructions may be relevant to your work. Use them as guidance when applicable. More specific instructions take precedence over broader ones. They do not override system, developer, or direct user instructions.

Instructions from: AGENTS.md

# Agent Instructions

## Scope

- These rules apply to the entire repository.
- Read `PRODUCT.md`, `PRODUCT-TECH.md`, and `docs/index.md` before changing
  product behavior or architecture.
- More specific `AGENTS.md` files may add constraints but may not weaken the
  delivery, data-integrity, styling, or safety rules below.
- Keep `CLAUDE.md` as a symlink to this file.

## Delivery Contract

- A delivery must not contain stubs, placeholder routes, fake data, inert
  controls, disabled previews of future work, fabricated metrics, or
  surface-only implementations.
- An incomplete feature stays out of the shipped navigation and UI. Do not use
  "coming soon" as a substitute for implementation.
- Loading, empty, unavailable, stale, and error states must be truthful and
  visibly distinct.
- Preserve observable upstream behavior unless `PRODUCT.md` explicitly removes
  it from scope.

## Product Boundaries

- Fracta is one desktop application in one window. A bare shell with a
  Knowledge/Observatory toggle hosts both modes; each mode loads its own
  styles only while mounted. Do not reintroduce separate windows or a
  shared styled shell.
- The Fractorches Go service is the canonical source for agent sessions,
  transcripts, projects, usage, search, analytics, quality, recall, pins, and
  edits. Do not recreate provider parsers in JavaScript or Rust.
- RepoGraph scan JSON remains canonical for codebase graph views. Daily-log JSON
  remains canonical for the daily activity browser.
- RepoGraph is a moving upstream until its external handoff is complete. Do not
  copy or edit a mid-change snapshot. Record a content hash or commit before
  importing it.
- Fractapad is the Knowledge upstream. Remove its upstream update checks and
  branding tethers without removing working local knowledge features.
- Helix is out of scope. OpenCoVibe belongs to the later v0.1 milestone.

## Styling

- Install Sass with `pnpm add -D sass` in every Svelte application that authors
  styles.
- New or changed authored styles use indented `.sass` only: tabs for nesting,
  no braces, no semicolons, no `.css`, no `.scss`, no inline `style` attributes,
  and no component `<style>` blocks.
- New styling must follow Fractalstyler2's current semantic token and fractal
  composition contract. Do not introduce foreign custom properties or
  hardcoded visual values where a contract token exists.
- A retained theme control must use Fractalthemer integrated with
  Fractalstyler2's complete token contract. Otherwise omit theme controls.
- New icon needs use Fractalicons. Do not add another icon package.
- Existing upstream styling may remain during the compatibility phase. A file
  touched for new styling must migrate the touched rules to the contract above.

## Data Integrity

- Never estimate a value that the UI labels as observed, actual, total, saved,
  or live.
- Preserve source provenance, provider identity, canonical session identity,
  timestamp semantics, and usage deduplication.
- Date, project, agent, model, and search filters must be applied by the
  authoritative query layer and must affect every displayed aggregate in their
  scope.
- Do not present cached data as live. Expose generation time, sync state, and
  refresh failures.
- Validate JSON paths and schemas before reading scan or daily-log files. Reject
  path traversal and unsupported scan types.
- Persistent archives are user data. Never delete, truncate, recreate, or
  migrate a live archive as a shortcut.

## Records and Specifications

- `PRODUCT.md` defines product behavior. `PRODUCT-TECH.md` defines its technical
  realization. Keep both synchronized with implementation.
- Record meaningful progress in `docs/project-log.md`, durable decisions in
  `docs/decisions.md`, and current ownership in `docs/work-items.md`.
- Every document added under `docs/` must be linked from `docs/index.md` and
  include YAML frontmatter except `docs/index.md`.
- Do not put personal absolute paths, private hostnames, credentials, or private
  identities in tracked files, fixtures, logs, commits, or release text.

## Agent Orchestration

- Parallel implementation agents use isolated Git worktrees and one bounded
  ownership area each. Do not allow overlapping file ownership.
- The integrating agent reviews every diff, runs repository-wide gates, and is
  solely responsible for integration order.
- Subagents may not weaken specifications, add placeholders, or silently defer
  acceptance criteria.

## Verification

- Run relevant unit, integration, type, build, browser, and Tauri checks for the
  surfaces changed.
- Svelte production builds do not replace `svelte-check`.
- Go changes require `go fmt ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and relevant tests.
- Rust changes require formatting, linting, and relevant tests.
- Delivery gates must scan production sources for mock data, placeholder copy,
  inert controls, forbidden upstream update endpoints, and newly authored
  styling outside the contract.
- Browser and desktop acceptance use real isolated fixtures and local data, not
  mocked production dashboards.

## Git and Safety

- Preserve unrelated work and inspect branch state before editing.
- Commit each coherent tracked change. Do not amend, squash, rebase, merge,
  push, or pull unless the user asks.
- Do not use destructive Git or filesystem commands.

</system-reminder>

A skill is a reusable set of task-specific instructions. The following skills are available in this session:

<available_skills>
- `browser-use`: Direct browser control via CDP for web interaction: automation, scraping, testing, screenshots, and site/app work.
- `code-review`: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes — Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/spec asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to "review since X".
- `context-map`: Generate a map of all files relevant to a task before making changes
- `context-save`: Save working context. (gstack)
- `implement-specs`: Implement an approved feature from PRODUCT.md and TECH.md, keeping specs and code aligned in the same PR as implementation evolves. Use after the product and tech specs are approved and the next step is building the feature.
- `indexion-wiki`: Project wiki lifecycle — create pages, track source changes with ingest, update stale pages, lint structural integrity, detect code-to-doc drift with reconcile, and manage search indexes. A runbook for navigating and maintaining the wiki as an agent.
- `karpathy-llm-wiki`: Use when building or maintaining a personal LLM-powered knowledge base. Triggers: ingesting sources into a wiki, querying wiki knowledge, linting wiki quality, 'add to wiki', 'what do I know about', or any mention of 'LLM wiki' or 'Karpathy wiki'.
- `open-knowledge-discovery`: Read when the user asks what OpenKnowledge is, wants to install it on a repository, wants to open or preview a single markdown file that is not part of an OpenKnowledge project, wants to share an OpenKnowledge project with collaborators, or asks how `ok init` / `ok cowork` / OK Desktop set up a project. Do NOT load to perform OpenKnowledge reads/writes — the runtime guidance for editing markdown inside an initialized OK project ships as a separate project-local skill installed into each detec...
- `open-knowledge-write-skill`: Use when the user wants to create, author, write, or design a new Agent Skill (a SKILL.md) — for OpenKnowledge or for their editors — including requests like 'help me write a skill', 'make a skill that…', 'turn this workflow into a skill', or improving an existing skill's triggering and discipline. Also use when capturing reusable agent guidance that should live as an installable skill rather than a one-off prompt. Covers choosing scope (project vs global), the SKILL.md frontmatter contract, ...
- `open-source`: Documentation reference for writing Python code using the browser-use open-source library. Use this skill whenever the user needs help with Agent, Browser, or Tools configuration, is writing code that imports from browser_use, asks about @sandbox deployment, supported LLM models, Actor API, custom tools, lifecycle hooks, MCP server setup, or monitoring/observability with Laminar or OpenLIT. Also trigger for questions about browser-use installation, prompting strategies, or sensitive data hand...
- `paseo`: Paseo reference for managing workspaces, workspace scripts, agents, schedules, and heartbeats.
- `spec-driven-development`: Creates specs before coding. Use when starting a new project, feature, or significant change and no specification exists yet. Use when requirements are unclear, ambiguous, or only exist as a vague idea.
- `write-feature-docs`: Draft a complete documentation page for a new Warp feature from its PRODUCT.md and/or TECH.md spec. Use when an engineer has written a spec and needs to produce a first-pass MDX draft for the warpdotdev/docs repo. Also handles features without specs by researching the codebase first. Invoke this skill whenever an engineer mentions writing docs for a feature, drafting a docs page, creating feature documentation, starting the eng-docs workflow, or converting a spec into documentation. Works fro...
- `write-product-spec`: Write a PRODUCT.md specs for the user-facing features in product, focused on detailed behavior and validation. Use when the user asks for a product spec, desired behavior doc, or PRD, wants to define feature behavior before implementation, or when the feature is substantial or behaviorally ambiguous enough that a written spec would improve implementation or review.
- `write-tech-spec`: Write a TECH.md spec for a significant features after researching the current codebase and implementation constraints. Use when the user asks for a technical spec, implementation plan, or architecture doc tied to a product spec.
</available_skills>

If the user names a skill, or the task clearly matches a skill's description, call the `skill` tool with the exact skill name before taking task actions. Load all applicable skills, then follow their full instructions. This catalog contains summaries only; do not infer or follow a skill's instructions until it has been loaded.
A user may also invoke a skill directly; its <skill_content> block then appears in this conversation. Follow it, and do not call the `skill` tool again for that skill.
</system-reminder>

# Fracta v0 Product Specification

incorrect aggregation. Fractorches has the mature multi-provider archive and
analytics backend but not RepoGraph's graph or daily-log interfaces. Fractapad
provides a useful local knowledge surface but carries upstream branding and
update tethers that do not belong in Fracta.

1: // ============================================================================
2: // dimensions — L1. The loop-generated half of the registry: 17 space families,
3: // radius, size, viewport heights, shadows — each class in three bands (base,
4: // -mob, -desk) per Contract 7. Presets are token-routed; literals are px.
5: // ============================================================================
6: 
7: @use 'sass:string'
8: @use 'sass:list'
9: @use '01_config' as *
10: 
11: $lo: list.nth($utility-range, 1)
12: $hi: list.nth($utility-range, 2)
13: $steps: ('3xs' '2xs' 'xs' 'sm' 'md' 'lg' 'xl' '2xl' '3xl')
14: 
15: $space-families: (gap: gap, rgap: row-gap, cgap: column-gap, pad: padding, pad-x: padding-inline, pad-y: padding-block, pad-top: padding-top, pad-right: padding-right, pad-bottom: padding-bottom, pad-left: padding-left, marg: margin, marg-x: margin-inline, marg-y: margin-block, marg-top: margin-top, marg-right: margin-right, marg-bottom: margin-bottom, marg-left: margin-left)
16: 
17: // Negatives ride margin families only (Contract: `--` infix).
18: $marg-families: (marg: margin, marg-x: margin-inline, marg-y: margin-block, marg-top: margin-top, marg-right: margin-right, marg-bottom: margin-bottom, marg-left: margin-left)
19: 
20: // --- Base band ---------------------------------------------------------------
21: @each $name, $prop in $space-families
22: 	@each $step in $steps
23: 		.#{$name}-#{$step}
24: 			#{$prop}: var(--space-#{$step})
25: 	@for $n from $lo through $hi
26: 		.#{$name}-#{$n}
27: 			#{$prop}: #{$n}px
28: 
29: @each $name, $prop in $marg-families
30: 	@each $step in $steps
31: 		.#{$name}--#{$step}
32: 			#{$prop}: calc(var(--space-#{$step}) * -1)
33: 	@for $n from $lo through $hi
34: 		.#{$name}--#{$n}
35: 			#{$prop}: -#{$n}px
36: 
37: // Radius — literal px (0 = the reset); never rides shape presets.
38: @for $n from 0 through $hi
39: 	.radius-#{$n}
40: 		border-radius: #{$n}px
41: 
42: .radius-full
43: 	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
44: 
45: // Size
46: @for $n from $lo through $hi
47: 	.w-#{$n}
48: 		width: #{$n}px
49: 	.h-#{$n}
50: 		height: #{$n}px
51: 	.square-#{$n}
52: 		width: #{$n}px
53: 		height: #{$n}px

---_01_config.sass---
// ============================================================================
// config — the builder knobs the Contract names. All !default: overridable at
// compile time via `@use 'config' with (…)`, never edited in place.
// ============================================================================

// The responsive seam. Every loop-generated class takes -mob (below) and
// -desk (at or above) this width.
$breakpoint: 768px !default
$responsive-modes: (mob: 'all and (max-width: #{$breakpoint - 1})', desk: 'all and (min-width: #{$breakpoint})') !default

// Literal utility ceiling: .gap-{N}, .radius-{N}, .w-{N}… emit lo…hi in px.
$utility-range: (1, 256) !default

// Named steps for grid stepping and the shell rails (not the responsive seam).
$breakpoints: (sm: 640px, md: 768px, lg: 1024px, xl: 1280px) !default

// ============================================================================
// base — element baseline. Builder infrastructure, not registry classes: the
// registry is a list of classes; this only makes documents predictable so the
// classes behave. Deliberately minimal — no typographic opinions beyond body.
// ============================================================================

*,
*::before,
*::after
	box-sizing: border-box

*
	margin: 0

body, html
	font-family: var(--font-sans)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	line-height: 1.5
	color: var(--text-primary)
	background: var(--bg)

img,
video,
svg
	display: block
	max-width: 100%

button,
input,
select,
textarea
	font: inherit
	color: inherit

a
	color: inherit

---_02_dimensions.sass---
// ============================================================================
// dimensions — L1. The loop-generated half of the registry: 17 space families,
// radius, size, viewport heights, shadows — each class in three bands (base,
// -mob, -desk) per Contract 7. Presets are token-routed; literals are px.
// ============================================================================

@use 'sass:string'
@use 'sass:list'
@use '01_config' as *

$lo: list.nth($utility-range, 1)
$hi: list.nth($utility-range, 2)
$steps: ('3xs' '2xs' 'xs' 'sm' 'md' 'lg' 'xl' '2xl' '3xl')

$space-families: (gap: gap, rgap: row-gap, cgap: column-gap, pad: padding, pad-x: padding-inline, pad-y: padding-block, pad-top: padding-top, pad-right: padding-right, pad-bottom: padding-bottom, pad-left: padding-left, marg: margin, marg-x: margin-inline, marg-y: margin-block, marg-top: margin-top, marg-right: margin-right, marg-bottom: margin-bottom, marg-left: margin-left)

// Negatives ride margin families only (Contract: `--` infix).
$marg-families: (marg: margin, marg-x: margin-inline, marg-y: margin-block, marg-top: margin-top, marg-right: margin-right, marg-bottom: margin-bottom, marg-left: margin-left)

// --- Base band ---------------------------------------------------------------
@each $name, $prop in $space-families
	@each $step in $steps
		.#{$name}-#{$step}
			#{$prop}: var(--space-#{$step})
	@for $n from $lo through $hi
		.#{$name}-#{$n}
			#{$prop}: #{$n}px

@each $name, $prop in $marg-families
	@each $step in $steps
		.#{$name}--#{$step}
			#{$prop}: calc(var(--space-#{$step}) * -1)
	@for $n from $lo through $hi
		.#{$name}--#{$n}
			#{$prop}: -#{$n}px

// Radius — literal px (0 = the reset); never rides shape presets.
@for $n from 0 through $hi
	.radius-#{$n}
		border-radius: #{$n}px

.radius-full
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)

// Size
@for $n from $lo through $hi
	.w-#{$n}
		width: #{$n}px
	.h-#{$n}
		height: #{$n}px
	.square-#{$n}
		width: #{$n}px
		height: #{$n}px

.wfull
	width: 100%
.hfull
	height: 100%
.full
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
.min0
	min-width: 0
	min-height: 0

// Viewport heights
.hfull-vh
	min-height: 100vh
.hfull-vh-fitted
	min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height, 48px))

// Shadows — token channels; per-mode values live in tokens.
.shadow-sm
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)
.shadow-md
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
.shadow-lg
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)

// --- Responsive bands: -mob / -desk, generated wholesale (Contract 7) --------
@each $mode, $query in $responsive-modes
	@media #{string.unquote($query)}
		@each $name, $prop in $space-families
			@each $step in $steps
				.#{$name}-#{$step}-#{$mode}
					#{$prop}: var(--space-#{$step})
			@for $n from $lo through $hi
				.#{$name}-#{$n}-#{$mode}
					#{$prop}: #{$n}px
		@each $name, $prop in $marg-families
			@each $step in $steps
				.#{$name}--#{$step}-#{$mode}
					#{$prop}: calc(var(--space-#{$step}) * -1)
			@for $n from $lo through $hi
				.#{$name}--#{$n}-#{$mode}
					#{$prop}: -#{$n}px
		@for $n from 0 through $hi
			.radius-#{$n}-#{$mode}
				border-radius: #{$n}px
		.radius-full-#{$mode}
			border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		@for $n from $lo through $hi
			.w-#{$n}-#{$mode}
				width: #{$n}px
			.h-#{$n}-#{$mode}
				height: #{$n}px
			.square-#{$n}-#{$mode}
				width: #{$n}px
				height: #{$n}px
		.wfull-#{$mode}
			width: 100%
		.hfull-#{$mode}
			height: 100%
		.full-#{$mode}
			width: 100%
			height: 100%
		.min0-#{$mode}
			min-width: 0
			min-height: 0
		.hfull-vh-#{$mode}
			min-height: 100vh
		.hfull-vh-fitted-#{$mode}
			min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height, 48px))
		.shadow-sm-#{$mode}
			box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)
		.shadow-md-#{$mode}
			box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
		.shadow-lg-#{$mode}
			box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)

// ============================================================================
// flow — L2. Containers and the alignment universe, verbatim from the
// registry. Alignment classes are nested under their base — never standalone.
// x/y are physical axes, always (Contract 4).
// ============================================================================
.box
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	&.xcenter

---_04_layouts.sass---
// ============================================================================
// layouts — L3. Grids (gridding golden rules), card-grid, prose, frame
// presets, reel. Grids are pure stepping: no default gap — compose .gap-*
// (self-sufficiency; a default gap is an opinion the system doesn't hold).
// ============================================================================

@use 'sass:string'
@use 'sass:list'
@use 'sass:map'
@use '01_config' as *

$sm: map.get($breakpoints, sm)
$md: map.get($breakpoints, md)
$lg: map.get($breakpoints, lg)

// Gridding golden rules: exactly 3 items → 3→1, never 2+1; count 4 or a
// multiple of 4 → 4→2→1, never 3+1; 6 → 6→3→2→1 (both rules hold throughout).
.grid-1
	display: grid
	grid-template-columns: repeat(1, minmax(0, 1fr))

.grid-2
	display: grid
	grid-template-columns: repeat(1, minmax(0, 1fr))
	@media #{string.unquote('(min-width: #{$md})')}
		grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))

.grid-3
	display: grid
	grid-template-columns: repeat(1, minmax(0, 1fr))
	@media #{string.unquote('(min-width: #{$lg})')}
		grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))

.grid-4
	display: grid
	grid-template-columns: repeat(1, minmax(0, 1fr))
	@media #{string.unquote('(min-width: #{$sm})')}
		grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))
	@media #{string.unquote('(min-width: #{$lg})')}
		grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr))

.grid-6
	display: grid
	grid-template-columns: repeat(1, minmax(0, 1fr))
	@media #{string.unquote('(min-width: #{$sm})')}
		grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))
	@media #{string.unquote('(min-width: #{$md})')}
		grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))
	@media #{string.unquote('(min-width: #{$lg})')}
		grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr))

// Auto-fit repeatable cards — column count negotiable, min track from config.
.card-grid
	display: grid
	grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(var(--card-min), 100%), 1fr))

// Prose — the reading measure (≤ 760px) + typographic rhythm (rhythm authored).
.prose
	max-width: min(100%, 760px)
	margin-inline: auto
	line-height: 1.65
	> * + *
		margin-top: var(--space-sm)
	h1, h2, h3, h4
		line-height: 1.25
		font-weight: 600
		margin-top: var(--space-md)
		&:first-child
			margin-top: 0

// Frame presets — aspect-ratio media boxes (replaces any frame abstraction).
$frame-ratios: ('16-9': '16 / 9', '9-16': '9 / 16', '4-3': '4 / 3', '3-4': '3 / 4', '3-2': '3 / 2', '2-3': '2 / 3', '1-1': '1 / 1')
@each $name, $ratio in $frame-ratios
	.frame-#{$name}
		aspect-ratio: #{$ratio}
		overflow: hidden
		position: relative
		> *
			width: 100%
			height: 100%
		> :is(img, video, iframe)
			object-fit: cover

// Reel — the human-driven scroll-snap rail (filmstrip). Open for carousel duty.
.reel
	display: flex
	flex-direction: row
	overflow-x: auto
	overscroll-behavior-inline: contain
	scroll-snap-type: inline mandatory
	> *
		flex: 0 0 auto
		scroll-snap-align: start

---_05_shells.sass---
// ============================================================================
// shells — L4. Canonical markups are canon: every class here implements the
// markup registered in the registry. Overlay mechanics, the docs-frame roles
// and the mobile TOC disclosure are authored to the registered behaviors.
// Motion reads the motion tokens — presets reach everything.
// ============================================================================

@use 'sass:string'
@use 'sass:list'
@use 'sass:map'
@use '01_config' as *

$md: map.get($breakpoints, md)
$lg: map.get($breakpoints, lg)

// --- The app-shell canon ------------------------------------------------------
.app-shell
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	position: relative
	min-height: 100vh

.app-header
	display: flex
	flex-direction: row
	align-items: center
	position: sticky
	top: 0
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	height: var(--header-height)
	padding-right: var(--space-sm)
	padding-left: 88px
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border)

.app-main
	flex: 1 1 0%
	min-width: 0
	min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height))
	display: flex
	flex-direction: row

.main-section
	flex: 1 1 0%
	min-width: 0

.sidebar-left,
.sidebar-right
	width: var(--sidebar-width)
	flex-shrink: 0
	position: sticky
	top: var(--header-height)
	height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height))
	overflow-y: auto

.content-shell
	max-width: var(--measure)
	margin-inline: auto

.app-footer
	display: flex
	flex-direction: row
	align-items: center
	padding-inline: var(--space-sm)
	min-height: var(--footer-height)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border)

// --- .docs — config modifier on .app-shell -----------------------------------
// Below the seam both rails retract: the left tree goes off-canvas (.open on
// the shell brings it back — the header menu button toggles it), the right
// TOC contracts to .docs-mobile-toc. At lg: the three-column frame.
.docs
	> .app-main > .sidebar-left,
	> .app-main > .sidebar-right
		display: none
	&.open > .app-main > .sidebar-left
		display: block
		position: fixed
		top: var(--header-height)
		left: 0
		z-index: var(--z-modal)
		width: min(85vw, var(--sidebar-width))
		height: calc(100dvh - var(--header-height))
		background: var(--bg)
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)
	@media #{string.unquote('(min-width: #{$lg})')}
		> .app-main
			display: grid
			grid-template-columns: var(--sidebar-width) minmax(0, 1fr) var(--docs-toc-w, 240px)
		> .app-main > .sidebar-left
			display: block
			border-right: 1px solid var(--border)
		> .app-main > .sidebar-right
			display: block
			border-left: 1px solid var(--border)
		> .docs-mobile-toc
			display: none

// Mobile TOC disclosure — <details class="docs-mobile-toc"><summary>…</summary>…
.docs-mobile-toc
	padding: var(--space-xs)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	summary
		display: flex
		flex-direction: row
		align-items: center
		justify-content: space-between
		font-weight: 500
		font-size: var(--text-sm)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		cursor: pointer
		user-select: none
		list-style: none
		&::-webkit-details-marker
			display: none
	&[open]
		background: var(--bg-raised)
		summary
			padding-bottom: var(--space-2xs)
			margin-bottom: var(--space-xs)
			border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border)

// --- Page frames — padding ownership moves with full-bleed chrome ------------
.page-shell
	padding-inline: var(--page-gutter)
	padding-block: var(--space-md)

.page-split
	display: grid
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)
	> .page-main
		min-width: 0
		padding: var(--page-gutter)
	> .page-sidebar
		display: none
	@media #{string.unquote('(min-width: #{$md})')}
		grid-template-columns: var(--sidebar-width) minmax(0, 1fr)
		> .page-sidebar
			display: block
			position: sticky
			top: var(--header-height)
			height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height))
			overflow-y: auto
			border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

// --- Overlays — shown via .open; triggers carry native aria ------------------
.drawer
	position: fixed
	top: var(--header-height)
	left: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	width: min(85vw, 320px)
	height: calc(100dvh - var(--header-height))
	padding: var(--space-sm)
	overflow-y: auto
	background: var(--bg)
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)
	transform: translateX(-105%)
	visibility: hidden
	transition: transform var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out), visibility var(--motion-base)
	&.open
		transform: translateX(0)
		visibility: visible

.dialog
	position: fixed
	top: 50%
	left: 50%
	translate: 0 -4px
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	max-width: min(92vw, 540px)
	width: 100%
	background: var(--bg-dialog)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-lg)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)
	opacity: 0
	visibility: hidden
	pointer-events: none
	transition: opacity var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out), visibility var(--motion-base), translate var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.open,
	&[open]
		opacity: 1
		visibility: visible
		pointer-events: auto
		translate: 0 0
	&::backdrop
		background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)

.popover
	position: absolute
	top: calc(100% + 6px)
	left: 0
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	min-width: 200px
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	translate: 0 -4px
	opacity: 0
	visibility: hidden
	pointer-events: none
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-out), visibility var(--motion-fast), translate var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-out)
	&.open
		opacity: 1
		visibility: visible
		pointer-events: auto
		translate: 0 0

.accordion
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.accordion-item
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	> .accordion-content
		display: grid
		grid-template-rows: 0fr
		transition: grid-template-rows var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
		> *
			overflow: hidden
			min-height: 0
	&.open > .accordion-content
		grid-template-rows: 1fr

.accordion-trigger
	display: flex
	flex-direction: row
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	width: 100%
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-align: left
	background: transparent
	border: 0
	cursor: pointer
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: var(--bg-raised)
	&:focus-visible
		outline: 2px solid var(--ring)
		outline-offset: -2px

// --- .hero — documented sugar: .box.ycenter + gap-lg + pad-y-xl ---------------
.hero
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	gap: var(--space-lg)
	padding-block: var(--space-xl)

---
title: Canonical Markups
description: Source of truth for shell and layout markups
---

> Transcribed from registry-v1.md (L4 ruling: "an L4 class without a canonical markup is an incomplete definition"). Implementation status is noted per section against `src/lib/styles/`.

## 1 - Canonical App Shell and Children

```html
<div class="app-shell">
	<header class="app-header"></header>
	<main class="app-main">
		<aside class="sidebar-left"></aside>
		<section class="main-section">
			<article class="content-shell"></article>
		</section>
		<aside class="sidebar-right"></aside>
	</main>
	<footer class="app-footer"></footer>
</div>
```

| Class | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `.app-shell` | min-height fill; column; publishes `--header-height` |
| `.app-header` | fixed-height bar (sticky), `height: var(--header-height)` |
| `.app-main` | the row below the header; `min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height))` |
| `.sidebar-left` / `.sidebar-right` | sticky columns; `top: var(--header-height)`; width from `--sidebar-width`; dress your own bg |
| `.main-section` | `min-width: 0`; owns horizontal padding via `.page-main` semantics |
| `.content-shell` | max-width content column inside main-section |
| `.app-footer` | full-width footer bar |

Status: **implemented** — `_05_shells.sass`.

## 2 - Canonical Docs and Children

`.docs` is a config modifier on `.app-shell`: left sidebar retracts below the seam (header menu button toggles `.open`), right TOC contracts to `.docs-mobile-toc`.

```html
<div class="app-shell docs">
	<header class="app-header">
		<button class="button is-icon" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Menu"></button>
	</header>
	<main class="app-main">
		<aside class="sidebar-left">
			<nav class="navtree">
				<div class="navtree-group">
					<div class="navtree-title"></div>
					<a class="navtree-link" href="…"></a>
					<div class="navtree-sub"></div>
				</div>
			</nav>
		</aside>
		<section class="main-section">
			<article class="content-shell"></article>
		</section>
		<aside class="sidebar-right">
			<nav class="toc">
				<div class="toc-title"></div>
				<ul class="toc-list">
					<li><a class="toc-link" href="…"></a></li>
				</ul>
				<div class="toc-footer"></div>
			</nav>
		</aside>
	</main>
	<details class="docs-mobile-toc">
		<summary></summary>
	</details>
	<footer class="app-footer"></footer>
</div>
```

Tab strip, wherever it lives:

```html
<div class="tab-list" role="tablist">
	<button class="tab-trigger active" role="tab" aria-selected="true"></button>
</div>
```

Current tab = `.active`; triggers carry native `aria-selected`.

Status: `.docs` and `.docs-mobile-toc` **implemented** — `_05_shells.sass`. `.navtree*`, `.toc*`, `.tab-list`, `.tab-trigger` are **registered but not yet in the styles** (definitions to be transcribed at build, per registry L4).

## 3 - Canonical Sidebar with Accordions

```html
<aside class="page-sidebar">
	<div class="accordion">
		<div class="accordion-item open">
			<button class="accordion-trigger" aria-expanded="true"></button>
			<div class="accordion-content">
				<a class="navtree-link" href="…"></a>
			</div>
		</div>
		<div class="accordion-item">
			<button class="accordion-trigger" aria-expanded="false"></button>
			<div class="accordion-content"></div>
		</div>
	</div>
</aside>
```

`.open` on `.accordion-item` shows the content; triggers carry native `aria-expanded`.

Status: accordion family **implemented** — `_05_shells.sass`.

## 4 - Canonical Page Frames

```html
<!-- plain page: padded content frame -->
<section class="page-shell"> … </section>

<!-- sidebar page: full-bleed split, padding lives in .page-main -->
<section class="page-split">
	<aside class="page-sidebar"></aside>
	<main class="page-main"></main>
</section>
```

Status: **implemented** — `_05_shells.sass`.

## 5 - Canonical Hero

```html
<section class="hero">
	<h1 class="text-3xl"></h1>
	<p class="text-lg text-muted"></p>
</section>
```

Status: **implemented** — `_05_shells.sass` (documented sugar: `.box.ycenter` + `gap-lg` + `pad-y-xl`).

438: 	const EXECUTABLE_EXTENSIONS = new Set([
439: 		// macOS / shell / scripting
440: 		"app",

47:     lastMermaidTheme = theme;
48:     mermaid.initialize({
49:       startOnLoad: false,
50:       theme,
51:       securityLevel: "loose",
52:       themeVariables: isDark ? {

	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.btn
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 0 var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: 1px solid transparent
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.btn-icon
	padding: 0
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		position: absolute
		top: 6px
		right: 6px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin: 0 var(--space-3xs)

// --- Dropdown menu (used for Copy menu and tab context menu) ----------------
.dropdown
	position: fixed
	width: 160px
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-3xs)
	overflow: hidden

.dropdown-item
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.dropdown-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)

// --- Tab bar ----------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	position: sticky
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg))
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs) 0
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tabbar-inner
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	gap: 2px
	min-width: 100%

.tabbar-files
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	gap: 2px
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
	&.active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		box-shadow: 0 -1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over
		border-left: 2px solid var(--theme-color)

.tab.home-tab
	min-width: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	flex-shrink: 0
	svg
		flex-shrink: 0

.tab-label
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	flex: 1
	text-align: left

.tab-dirty
	color: var(--theme-color)
	font-weight: 700
	margin-right: var(--space-3xs)

.tab-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 22px
	height: 22px
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	flex-shrink: 0
	cursor: pointer
	background: transparent
	border: none
	.tab:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.new-tab-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	margin-left: 2px
	margin-bottom: 2px
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	flex-shrink: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
		color: var(--theme-color)

// --- TOC (table of contents) sidebar ----------------------------------------
.toc-sidebar
	position: fixed
	left: 0
	top: 80px
	bottom: 0
	width: 240px
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)
	box-shadow: 2px 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 4%, transparent)
	overflow-y: auto
	z-index: var(--z-base)

.toc-header
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--text-muted)
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em

.toc-nav
	padding: 0 var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column

.toc-item
	display: block
	width: 100%
	text-align: left
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-left: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: pointer
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	line-height: 1.6
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-width: 3px
		font-weight: 500
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)
		border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0

// --- Content main area: raw source + viewer with TOC spacing ---------------
.content-main
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--page-gutter) var(--space-2xl)
	transition: padding-inline var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.toc-spaced
		padding-left: calc(240px + var(--space-md))

.raw-source
	display: block
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	line-height: 1.6
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	white-space: pre-wrap
	overflow-x: auto

// --- Knowledge edit layout (full or split) ---------------------------------
.knowledge-edit-layout
	position: fixed
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px)
	left: 0
	right: 0
	bottom: 0
	display: flex
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	background: var(--bg)
	&.split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.split-preview
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	overflow-y: auto

// --- Editor -----------------------------------------------------------------
.editor-wrap
	position: fixed
	inset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px) 0 0 0
	display: flex
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	&.split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.editor-stack
	position: relative
	flex: 1
	width: 100%
	height: 100%

.editor,
.editor-backdrop,
.editor-gutter
	position: absolute
	inset: 0
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-md)
	border: none
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	tab-size: 2
	-moz-tab-size: 2
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-wrap: break-word
	overflow-wrap: break-word
	box-sizing: border-box
	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	line-height: 1.6

.editor
	background: transparent
	outline: none
	resize: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	z-index: 1
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-backdrop
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	z-index: 0

.editor.with-gutter,
.editor-backdrop.with-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))

.editor-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	overflow: hidden
	z-index: 0
	counter-reset: gl
	.gl
		counter-increment: gl
		position: relative
	&__line::before
		content: counter(gl)
		position: absolute
		left: calc(-1 * var(--gutter-w))
		width: calc(var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-2xs))
		text-align: right
		color: var(--text-muted)
	.gl.active
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 3%, transparent)
	.gl.active::before
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		font-weight: 500

.editor-stack.with-gutter::before
	content: ""
	position: absolute
	left: 0
	top: 0
	bottom: 0
	width: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-3xs))
	border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 1%, transparent)
	z-index: 0
	pointer-events: none

// Highlight layer — only the <mark> backgrounds should be visible
.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-highlight
	color: transparent
	background-color: var(--warning)
	border-radius: 2px

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-active
	color: transparent !important
	background-color: var(--danger) !important

// --- Search overlay ---------------------------------------------------------
.search-bar
	position: fixed
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	right: var(--space-xs)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)

.search-icon
	color: var(--text-muted)
	flex-shrink: 0

.search-input
	width: 200px
	padding: 2px 0
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	outline: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.search-count
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	min-width: 32px
	text-align: center
	flex-shrink: 0

.search-nav
	display: flex
	gap: 1px

.search-nav-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 24px
	height: 24px
	border: none
	background: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.3
		cursor: default

.search-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 24px
	height: 24px
	border: none
	background: none
	color: var(--text-muted)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

// --- Highlight styles (view mode) ------------------------------------------
mark.mdv-search-highlight
	background-color: var(--warning)
	color: inherit
	padding: 1px 0
	border-radius: 2px

mark.mdv-search-active
	background-color: var(--danger) !important
	color: var(--text-inverse) !important

// --- Link tooltip -----------------------------------------------------------
.link-tooltip
	display: none
	position: fixed
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	max-width: 400px
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	pointer-events: none

// --- Image lightbox ---------------------------------------------------------
.lightbox
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(4px)

.lb-image
	max-width: 90vw
	max-height: 90vh
	object-fit: contain
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	user-select: none

.lb-close,
.lb-nav
	position: absolute
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 10%, transparent)
	color: #fff
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 20%, transparent)

.lb-close
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: 40px
	height: 40px

.lb-nav
	top: 50%
	transform: translateY(-50%)
	width: 44px
	height: 44px

.lb-prev
	left: var(--space-sm)

.lb-next
	right: var(--space-sm)

.lb-counter
	position: absolute
	bottom: var(--space-sm)
	left: 50%
	transform: translateX(-50%)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums

// --- Empty state (home / recents / pinned folders / plans) -----------------
.empty-root
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	max-width: 1040px
	margin: 0 auto
	min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height) - var(--space-md))
	gap: var(--space-sm)

.hero-bar
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) 0 var(--space-2xs)

.hero-logo
	flex-shrink: 0
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)

.hero-text
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: 2px

.hero-title
	font-size: var(--text-lg)
	font-weight: 700
	letter-spacing: -0.01em
	color: var(--text-primary)
	margin: 0

.hero-desc
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0

.quick-actions
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	flex-wrap: wrap

.qa-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		border-color: var(--state-selected)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.qa-primary
		background: var(--theme-color)
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
		color: var(--text-inverse)
		&:hover
			background: var(--theme-color-alt)
			border-color: var(--theme-color-alt)

.section
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.section-header
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: 0 var(--space-3xs)

.section-title
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0
	flex: 1

.section-count
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	padding: 1px var(--space-2xs)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.section-action
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: none
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	padding: 0
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)

.section-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: none
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.section-action.unpin
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	.section-header:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)

.card
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	overflow: hidden

.card-scroll
	overflow-y: auto

.uniform-card
	height: 300px

.recents-grid
	display: grid
	grid-template-columns: 1fr
	&.two-col
		grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr
		.item:nth-child(even)
			border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

@media #{string.unquote('(max-width: 720px)')}
	.recents-grid.two-col
		grid-template-columns: 1fr
		.item:nth-child(even)
			border-left: none

.card-empty
	padding: var(--space-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	text-align: center

.item
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:last-of-type
		border-bottom: none
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.item-icon
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-lg)
	height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--theme-color)
	flex-shrink: 0
	&.plan
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 12%, transparent)
		color: var(--success)

.item-info
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: 1px

.item-name
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-primary)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.item-path
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.item-time
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	white-space: nowrap
	flex-shrink: 0

.panels-grid
	display: grid
	grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))
	gap: var(--space-sm)

@media #{string.unquote('(max-width: 720px)')}
	.panels-grid
		grid-template-columns: 1fr

.footer-row
	margin-top: auto
	padding-top: var(--space-xs)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	flex-wrap: wrap
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.footer-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	.kbd
		display: inline-block
		padding: 1px var(--space-3xs)
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		background: var(--bg-raised)
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		border-radius: var(--radius-sm)

.footer-link
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--theme-color)
	background: none
	border: none
	padding: 0
	cursor: pointer
	text-decoration: underline
	&:hover
		text-decoration: none

.zoom-controls
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.zoom-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.zoom-label
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	min-width: 28px
	text-align: center
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums

// --- Marp presentation ------------------------------------------------------
.present-root
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-md)
	background: #0e0e10

.present-stage
	position: relative
	width: min(100%, calc((100vh - 96px) * 16 / 9))
	aspect-ratio: 16 / 9
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: 0 8px 40px color-mix(in srgb, #000 50%, transparent)
	overflow: hidden

Now I have everything I need. Let me start building the new sass design system extensions. The approach:

1. Create `_09_knowledge-workspace.sass` (all the notes module component styles)
2. Create `_10_knowledge-dialogs.sass` (modals/dropdowns/overlays)
3. Migrate `mdrend.css` content to a sass file (the markdown renderer styles)
4. Update `index.sass` to forward the new files
5. Update components to remove all `<style>` blocks and inline styles
6. Update NotesModule.svelte to remove inline styles

Let me start by creating the new sass files.

const root = '/Users/amrit/fractalmandala/fracta-era1';

// ===== KNOWLEDGE WORKSPACE - all the NotesModule component classes =====
const workspace = String.raw`// =============================================================================

// --- Content main area: raw source + viewer with TOC spacing ---------------
.content-main

	tab-size: 2

	overflow-wrap: break-word

	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll

	outline: none

	color: var(--text-primary)

.editor-backdrop
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none

.editor.with-gutter,
.editor-backdrop.with-gutter

	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	overflow: hidden
	z-index: 0
	counter-reset: gl
	.gl

		position: relative
	&__line::before

		position: absolute
		left: calc(-1 * var(--gutter-w))

.editor-stack.with-gutter::before

Now I have everything I need. Let me start building the new sass design system extensions. The approach:

1. Create `_09_knowledge-workspace.sass` (all the notes module component styles)
2. Create `_10_knowledge-dialogs.sass` (modals/dropdowns/overlays)
3. Migrate `mdrend.css` content to a sass file (the markdown renderer styles)
4. Update `index.sass` to forward the new files
5. Update components to remove all `<style>` blocks and inline styles
6. Update NotesModule.svelte to remove inline styles

Let me start by creating the new sass files.

const root = '/Users/amrit/fractalmandala/fracta-era1';

// ===== KNOWLEDGE WORKSPACE - all the NotesModule component classes =====
const workspace = String.raw`// =============================================================================
// 09_KNOWLEDGE-WORKSPACE — Notes workspace: toolbar, tab bar, library, editor,
// table of contents, status bar, scroll-to-top, progress, search overlay,
// toasts, frontmatter, link tooltips, image lightbox, marp presentation, etc.
// All classes the Notes workspace authors sit in this file. Components
// themselves own no <style> blocks.
// =============================================================================

@use 'sass:string'
@use 'sass:list'
@use 'sass:map'
@use '01_config' as *

$md: map.get($breakpoints, md)
$lg: map.get($breakpoints, lg)

// --- Inline progress bar at the top of the page ------------------------------
.progress-bar
	position: fixed
	top: 0
	left: 0
	height: 3px
	background: var(--theme-color)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	transition: width 0.1s linear
	pointer-events: none

// --- Status bar — fixed footer, blurs backdrop, hides on print --------------
.status-bar
	position: fixed
	bottom: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	.sep
		color: var(--border)

// --- Frontmatter bar — horizontal key/value strip above the article --------
.fm-bar
	display: flex
	flex-wrap: wrap
	gap: var(--space-xs) var(--space-md)
	max-width: min(100%, 720px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.fm-field
	display: flex
	align-items: baseline
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.fm-key
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)

.fm-value
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

// --- Scroll-to-top FAB -------------------------------------------------------
.scroll-top
	position: fixed
	bottom: var(--space-lg)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	width: 36px
	height: 36px
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	opacity: 0.7
	&:hover
		opacity: 1
		background: var(--state-hover)

// --- Toasts -----------------------------------------------------------------
.toast-stack
	position: fixed
	bottom: 96px
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-toast)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	align-items: flex-end

.toast
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	max-width: 360px
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	animation: slideUp var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)

.toast svg
	color: var(--danger)
	flex-shrink: 0

.toast-text
	line-height: 1.35

@keyframes slideUp
	from
		opacity: 0
		transform: translateY(10px)
	to
		opacity: 1
		transform: translateY(0)

// --- State center (loading + error UI inside page-main) ---------------------
.state-center
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--page-gutter)
	min-height: 60vh

.state-text
	color: var(--text-muted)
	&.pulse
		animation: pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite

@keyframes pulse
	0%, 100%
		opacity: 0.4
	50%
		opacity: 1

.error-box
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--danger)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	max-width: min(100%, 480px)

.error-msg
	color: var(--danger)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	margin: 0

// --- Drop zone — full-viewport dashed overlay when dragging a file ----------
.dropzone
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 8%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(2px)
	pointer-events: none

.dropzone-content
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-2xl)
	border: 2px dashed var(--theme-color)
	border-radius: var(--radius-lg)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)
	color: var(--theme-color)

.dropzone-text
	font-size: var(--text-md)
	font-weight: 500
	margin: 0

// --- Sidebar / Library (KnowledgeLibrary) -----------------------------------
.knowledge-library-actions
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs) var(--space-xs)

.knowledge-library-secondary-actions
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.knowledge-library-section
	padding: 0 var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)

.knowledge-library-heading
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)

.knowledge-library-heading h2
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0

.knowledge-library-icon-action
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.knowledge-library-empty
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	margin: 0

.knowledge-library-list
	list-style: none
	margin: 0
	padding: 0

.knowledge-library-folder-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.knowledge-library-folder-button
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.knowledge-library-count
	margin-left: auto
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums

.knowledge-library-remove
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
	li:hover &
		opacity: 1

.knowledge-library-files
	list-style: none
	margin: 0
	padding: 0 0 0 var(--space-md)

.knowledge-library-file
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	text-align: left
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.knowledge-library-recent-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.knowledge-library-recent
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.knowledge-library-recent-copy
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	min-width: 0
	flex: 1
	gap: 2px
	small
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		color: var(--text-muted)

// --- Toolbar (top bar in the workspace) ------------------------------------
.toolbar
	position: sticky
	top: var(--header-height)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)

.toolbar-left
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	min-width: 0
	flex: 1

.toolbar-center
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	flex-shrink: 0

.toolbar-right
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	flex-shrink: 0

.current-heading
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	min-width: 0
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.mode-segmented
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 2px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)

.mode-seg
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: 100%
	padding: 0 var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.btn
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 0 var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: 1px solid transparent
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.btn-icon
	padding: 0
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		position: absolute
		top: 6px
		right: 6px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin: 0 var(--space-3xs)

// --- Dropdown menu (used for Copy menu and tab context menu) ----------------
.dropdown
	position: fixed
	width: 160px
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-3xs)
	overflow: hidden

.dropdown-item
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.dropdown-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)

// --- Tab bar ----------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	position: sticky
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg))
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs) 0
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tabbar-inner
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	gap: 2px
	min-width: 100%

.tabbar-files
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	gap: 2px
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
	&.active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		box-shadow: 0 -1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over
		border-left: 2px solid var(--theme-color)

.tab.home-tab
	min-width: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	flex-shrink: 0
	svg
		flex-shrink: 0

.tab-label
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	flex: 1
	text-align: left

.tab-dirty
	color: var(--theme-color)
	font-weight: 700
	margin-right: var(--space-3xs)

.tab-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 22px
	height: 22px
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	flex-shrink: 0
	cursor: pointer
	background: transparent
	border: none
	.tab:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.new-tab-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	margin-left: 2px
	margin-bottom: 2px
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	flex-shrink: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
		color: var(--theme-color)

// --- TOC (table of contents) sidebar ----------------------------------------
.toc-sidebar
	position: fixed
	left: 0
	top: 80px
	bottom: 0
	width: 240px
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)
	box-shadow: 2px 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 4%, transparent)
	overflow-y: auto
	z-index: var(--z-base)

.toc-header
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--text-muted)
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em

.toc-nav
	padding: 0 var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column

.toc-item
	display: block
	width: 100%
	text-align: left
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-left: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: pointer
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	line-height: 1.6
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-width: 3px
		font-weight: 500
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)
		border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0

// --- Content main area: raw source + viewer with TOC spacing ---------------
.content-main
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--page-gutter) var(--space-2xl)
	transition: padding-inline var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.toc-spaced
		padding-left: calc(240px + var(--space-md))

.raw-source
	display: block
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	line-height: 1.6
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	white-space: pre-wrap
	overflow-x: auto

// --- Knowledge edit layout (full or split) ---------------------------------
.knowledge-edit-layout
	position: fixed
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px)
	left: 0
	right: 0
	bottom: 0
	display: flex
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	background: var(--bg)
	&.split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.split-preview
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	overflow-y: auto

// --- Editor -----------------------------------------------------------------
.editor-wrap
	position: fixed
	inset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px) 0 0 0
	display: flex
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	&.split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.editor-stack
	position: relative
	flex: 1
	width: 100%
	height: 100%

.editor,
.editor-backdrop,
.editor-gutter
	position: absolute
	inset: 0
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-md)
	border: none
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	tab-size: 2
	-moz-tab-size: 2
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-wrap: break-word
	overflow-wrap: break-word
	box-sizing: border-box
	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	line-height: 1.6

.editor
	background: transparent
	outline: none
	resize: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	z-index: 1
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-backdrop
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	z-index: 0

.editor.with-gutter,
.editor-backdrop.with-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))

.editor-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	overflow: hidden
	z-index: 0
	counter-reset: gl
	.gl
		counter-increment: gl
		position: relative
	&__line::before
		content: counter(gl)
		position: absolute
		left: calc(-1 * var(--gutter-w))
		width: calc(var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-2xs))
		text-align: right
		color: var(--text-muted)
	.gl.active
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 3%, transparent)
	.gl.active::before
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		font-weight: 500

.editor-stack.with-gutter::before
	content: ""
	position: absolute
	left: 0
	top: 0
	bottom: 0
	width: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-3xs))
	border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 1%, transparent)
	z-index: 0
	pointer-events: none

// Highlight layer — only the <mark> backgrounds should be visible
.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-highlight
	color: transparent
	background-color: var(--warning)
	border-radius: 2px

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-active
	color: transparent !important
	background-color: var(--danger) !important

// --- Search overlay ---------------------------------------------------------
.search-bar
	position: fixed
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	right: var(--space-xs)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)

.search-icon
	color: var(--text-muted)
	flex-shrink: 0

.search-input
	width: 200px
	padding: 2px 0
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	outline: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.search-count
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	min-width: 32px
	text-align: center
	flex-shrink: 0

.search-nav
	display: flex
	gap: 1px

.search-nav-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 24px
	height: 24px
	border: none
	background: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
