		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring)

.provider-select
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	font-family: inherit

.no-providers
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--danger)

.field-error-row
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--danger)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)

.field-row
	flex-direction: row
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)

// --- Open dialog specifics --------------------------------------------------
.browse-section
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-sm) 0

.browse-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.browse-hint
	margin-left: auto
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)

.url-row
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	align-items: stretch

.url-input-sm,
.url-input
	flex: 1
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	outline: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	transition: border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:focus
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring)

.url-fetch-btn,
.btn-render
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	background: var(--theme-color)
	color: var(--text-inverse)
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--theme-color-alt)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: default

.url-error-sm,
.url-error
	margin-top: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--danger)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)

.dialog-tabs
	display: flex
	gap: 2px
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm) 0
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.dialog-tab
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-bottom: 2px solid transparent
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-bottom-color: var(--theme-color)

.tab-count
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	min-width: 18px
	height: 18px
	padding: 0 var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)

.dialog-content
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	flex: 1
	min-height: 0
	overflow-y: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) 0

.empty-list
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-md)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	p
		margin: 0

.empty-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)

.file-item
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.file-item-nested
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-sm) + var(--space-md))

.file-icon
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 24px
	height: 24px
	color: var(--text-muted)
	flex-shrink: 0

.file-info
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: 2px
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0

.file-name
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-primary)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.file-path
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.file-time
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	white-space: nowrap
	flex-shrink: 0

.folder-section
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column

.folder-header
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.folder-chevron
	color: var(--text-muted)
	transition: transform var(--motion-fast) ease
	flex-shrink: 0
	&.expanded
		transform: rotate(90deg)

.folder-name
	font-weight: 500

.folder-file-count
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
	min-width: 16px

.folder-path
	margin-left: auto
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.folder-loading-inline
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)

.add-folder-btn,
.add-folder-inline
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: none
	border: 1px dashed var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	margin: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		border-color: var(--text-secondary)

.add-folder-btn
	border-style: solid

.add-folder-inline
	align-self: flex-start
	margin: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)

// --- Paste modal specifics --------------------------------------------------
.modal-backdrop
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 30%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(4px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px)

.modal
	width: 600px
	max-height: 80vh
	background: var(--bg-dialog)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-lg)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	overflow: hidden

.modal-header
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.modal-header-left,
.modal-header-right
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.llm-badge
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	padding: 2px var(--space-2xs)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 18%, transparent)

	font-weight: 500

.llm-toggle
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	input
		accent-color: var(--theme-color)

.modal-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border: none
	background: none
	color: var(--text-muted)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.modal-body
	padding: var(--space-sm)
	flex: 1
	min-height: 0
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-sm)

.modal-textarea
	width: 100%
	height: 240px
	padding: var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	resize: none
	outline: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	transition: border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:focus
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring)
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.modal-footer
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.modal-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)

.modal-actions
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.btn-cancel
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	background: none
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.mode-tabs
	display: flex
	gap: 2px
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	padding: 2px

.mode-tab
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&.active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)

.url-input-row
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.url-hints
	margin-top: var(--space-sm)
	padding: var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.url-hints-title
	font-weight: 600
	margin: 0 0 var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)

.url-hints ul
	margin: 0
	padding: 0 0 0 var(--space-md)
	list-style: disc

.url-hints li
	margin: var(--space-3xs) 0

.url-hints code
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	padding: 1px var(--space-3xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.provider
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)

	overflow: hidden

.provider-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	cursor: pointer
	user-select: none
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.ail-chevron
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	color: var(--text-muted)
	width: 14px
	flex-shrink: 0

.favicon-wrap
	width: 16px
	height: 16px
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)

	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	flex-shrink: 0
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.favicon
	width: 16px
	height: 16px
	object-fit: contain

.favicon-letter
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	line-height: 1

.provider-name
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-primary)

	min-width: 0
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis

.provider-actions

	gap: 2px
	flex-shrink: 0
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	.provider-row:hover &,
	.provider-row:focus-within &,

.icon-btn

	align-items: center
	justify-content: center

	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	padding: 0
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 12%, transparent)
		color: var(--danger)

.prompts
	padding: 0 var(--space-xs) var(--space-3xs) var(--space-lg)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: 1px

.prompt-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: default
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.prompt-name
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis

.add-prompt-btn,
.add-provider-btn
	background: none
	border: 1px dashed var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		border-color: var(--text-secondary)

.add-prompt-btn
	margin-top: var(--space-3xs)
	align-self: flex-start

.add-provider-btn
	margin-top: var(--space-2xs)
	text-align: center
	width: 100%

.edit-form
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border)

.text-input,
.textarea-input
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: inherit
	color: var(--text-primary)

	&:focus
		outline: none
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring)

.textarea-input

.form-error

.form-actions
	display: flex
	justify-content: flex-end
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.form-btn
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)

	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

		background: var(--theme-color)
		border-color: var(--theme-color)

			background: var(--theme-color-alt)
			border-color: var(--theme-color-alt)

.default-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-xs) 0 var(--space-3xs)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	margin-top: var(--space-2xs)

.default-label
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.default-right
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.select-wrap
	position: relative
	display: flex
	align-items: center

.default-select

	-webkit-appearance: none

	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) 26px var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: inherit
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	&:focus

		border-color: var(--theme-color)

// =============================================================================
// 10_KNOWLEDGE-DIALOGS — Modal shells (backdrop + dialog + header + body +
// footer), plus the dialog family used by Settings, Open, Paste, About,
// Custom Prompt, and the AI Lookup provider editor.
// =============================================================================

@use 'sass:string'
@use 'sass:map'
@use '01_config' as *

$md: map.get($breakpoints, md)

// --- Generic modal shell ----------------------------------------------------
.dialog-backdrop
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-start
	justify-content: center
	padding-top: 10vh
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 25%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(3px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px)

.dialog
	width: 360px
	background: var(--bg-dialog)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-lg)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	overflow: hidden

.dialog-wide
	width: 520px
	max-height: 80vh

.dialog-header
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.dialog-title
	font-size: var(--text-md)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--text-primary)
	margin: 0

.dialog-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border: none
	background: none
	color: var(--text-muted)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.dialog-body
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-sm) var(--space-lg)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-xs)

.dialog-footer
	display: flex
	justify-content: flex-end
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

// --- Settings dialog specifics ---------------------------------------------
.knowledge-settings-section
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-xs) 0

.knowledge-settings-section-title
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--text-muted)
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) 0

.knowledge-settings-section-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0

.knowledge-settings-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	gap: var(--space-sm)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) 0

.knowledge-settings-text
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: 2px
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0

.knowledge-settings-label
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-primary)

.knowledge-settings-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	code
		font-family: var(--font-mono)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		padding: 1px 4px
		border-radius: var(--radius-sm)

.knowledge-settings-switch
	width: 18px
	height: 18px
	accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	cursor: pointer

// --- About dialog specifics -------------------------------------------------
.about-content
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	align-items: center
	text-align: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.app-icon
	width: 48px
	height: 48px
	margin-bottom: var(--space-3xs)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)

.app-name
	font-size: var(--text-lg)
	font-weight: 700
	color: var(--text-primary)
	margin: 0

.app-description
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	margin: var(--space-2xs) 0 0
	line-height: 1.4

// --- Custom prompt modal ----------------------------------------------------
.no-selection-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-3xs) 0

.selection-box
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	max-height: 120px
	overflow-y: auto
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-break: break-word

.prompt-input
	width: 100%
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	font-family: inherit
	resize: vertical
	line-height: 1.45
	&:focus
		outline: none
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring)

.provider-select
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	font-family: inherit

.no-providers
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--danger)

.field-error-row
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--danger)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)

.field-row
	flex-direction: row
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)

// --- Open dialog specifics --------------------------------------------------
.browse-section
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-sm) 0

.browse-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.browse-hint
	margin-left: auto
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)

.url-row
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	align-items: stretch

.url-input-sm,
.url-input
	flex: 1
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	outline: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	transition: border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:focus
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring)

.url-fetch-btn,
.btn-render
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	background: var(--theme-color)
	color: var(--text-inverse)
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--theme-color-alt)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: default

.url-error-sm,
.url-error
	margin-top: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--danger)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)

.dialog-tabs
	display: flex
	gap: 2px
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm) 0
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.dialog-tab
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-bottom: 2px solid transparent
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-bottom-color: var(--theme-color)

.tab-count
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	min-width: 18px
	height: 18px
	padding: 0 var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)

.dialog-content
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	flex: 1
	min-height: 0
	overflow-y: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) 0

.empty-list
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-md)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	p
		margin: 0

.empty-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)

.file-item
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.file-item-nested
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-sm) + var(--space-md))

.file-icon
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 24px
	height: 24px
	color: var(--text-muted)
	flex-shrink: 0

.file-info
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: 2px
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0

.file-name
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-primary)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.file-path
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.file-time
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	white-space: nowrap
	flex-shrink: 0

.folder-section
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column

.folder-header
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.folder-chevron
	color: var(--text-muted)
	transition: transform var(--motion-fast) ease
	flex-shrink: 0
	&.expanded
		transform: rotate(90deg)

.folder-name
	font-weight: 500

.folder-file-count
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
	min-width: 16px

.folder-path
	margin-left: auto
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.folder-loading-inline
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)

.add-folder-btn,
.add-folder-inline
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: none
	border: 1px dashed var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	margin: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		border-color: var(--text-secondary)

.add-folder-btn
	border-style: solid

.add-folder-inline
	align-self: flex-start
	margin: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)

// --- Paste modal specifics --------------------------------------------------
.modal-backdrop
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 30%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(4px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px)

.modal
	width: 600px
	max-height: 80vh
	background: var(--bg-dialog)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-lg)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	overflow: hidden

.modal-header
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.modal-header-left,
.modal-header-right
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.llm-badge
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	padding: 2px var(--space-2xs)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 18%, transparent)
	color: var(--warning)
	font-weight: 500

.llm-toggle
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	input
		accent-color: var(--theme-color)

.modal-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border: none
	background: none
	color: var(--text-muted)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.modal-body
	padding: var(--space-sm)
	flex: 1
	min-height: 0
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-sm)

.modal-textarea
	width: 100%
	height: 240px
	padding: var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	resize: none
	outline: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	transition: border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:focus
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring)
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.modal-footer
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.modal-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)

.modal-actions
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.btn-cancel
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	background: none
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.mode-tabs
	display: flex
	gap: 2px
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	padding: 2px

.mode-tab
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&.active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)

.url-input-row
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.url-hints
	margin-top: var(--space-sm)
	padding: var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.url-hints-title
	font-weight: 600
	margin: 0 0 var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)

	margin: 0
	padding: 0 0 0 var(--space-md)
	list-style: disc

.url-hints li
	margin: var(--space-3xs) 0
	line-height: 1.5

.url-hints code

	padding: 1px var(--space-3xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

// --- AI Lookup settings -----------------------------------------------------
.ail-root
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.provider
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	background: transparent
	overflow: hidden

.provider-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	cursor: pointer
	user-select: none
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.ail-chevron
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	color: var(--text-muted)
	width: 14px
	flex-shrink: 0

.favicon-wrap
	width: 16px
	height: 16px
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	overflow: hidden
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	flex-shrink: 0
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.favicon
	width: 16px
	height: 16px
	object-fit: contain

.favicon-letter
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	line-height: 1

.provider-name
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-primary)
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis

.provider-actions
	display: flex
	gap: 2px
	flex-shrink: 0
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	.provider-row:hover &,
	.provider-row:focus-within &,
	.prompt-row:hover &,
	.prompt-row:focus-within &
		opacity: 1

.icon-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	padding: 0
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.icon-btn-danger:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 12%, transparent)
		color: var(--danger)

.prompts
	padding: 0 var(--space-xs) var(--space-3xs) var(--space-lg)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: 1px

.prompt-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: default
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.prompt-name
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis

.add-prompt-btn,
.add-provider-btn
	background: none
	border: 1px dashed var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		border-color: var(--text-secondary)

.add-prompt-btn
	margin-top: var(--space-3xs)
	align-self: flex-start

.add-provider-btn
	margin-top: var(--space-2xs)
	text-align: center
	width: 100%

.edit-form
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border)

.text-input,
.textarea-input
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: inherit
	color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mono
		font-family: var(--font-mono)
	&:focus
		outline: none
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring)

.textarea-input
	resize: vertical

.form-error
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--danger)

.form-actions
	display: flex
	justify-content: flex-end
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.form-btn
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&.form-btn-primary
		background: var(--theme-color)
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
		color: var(--text-inverse)
		&:hover
			background: var(--theme-color-alt)
			border-color: var(--theme-color-alt)

.default-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-xs) 0 var(--space-3xs)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	margin-top: var(--space-2xs)

.default-label
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.default-right
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.select-wrap
	position: relative
	display: flex
	align-items: center

.default-select
	appearance: none
	-webkit-appearance: none
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) 26px var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: inherit
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	&:focus
		outline: none
		border-color: var(--theme-color)

.select-chevron
	position: absolute
	right: var(--space-2xs)
	top: 50%
	transform: translateY(-50%)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	color: var(--text-muted)
	pointer-events: none

.reset-icon-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	padding: 0
	background: none
	border: 1px solid transparent
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		border-color: var(--border)

@media print
	.dialog-backdrop
		display: none
	.modal-backdrop
		display: none

// =============================================================================
// 10_KNOWLEDGE-DIALOGS — Modal shells (backdrop + dialog + header + body +
// footer), plus the dialog family used by Settings, Open, Paste, About,
// Custom Prompt, and the AI Lookup provider editor.
// =============================================================================

@use 'sass:string'
@use 'sass:map'
@use '01_config' as *

$md: map.get($breakpoints, md)

// --- Generic modal shell ----------------------------------------------------
.dialog-backdrop
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-start
	justify-content: center
	padding-top: 10vh
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 25%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(3px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px)

.dialog
	width: 360px
	background: var(--bg-dialog)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-lg)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	overflow: hidden

.dialog-wide
	width: 520px
	max-height: 80vh

.dialog-header
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.dialog-title
	font-size: var(--text-md)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--text-primary)
	margin: 0

.dialog-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border: none
	background: none
	color: var(--text-muted)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.dialog-body
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-sm) var(--space-lg)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-xs)

.dialog-footer
	display: flex
	justify-content: flex-end
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

// --- Settings dialog specifics ---------------------------------------------
.knowledge-settings-section
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-xs) 0

.knowledge-settings-section-title
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--text-muted)
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) 0

.knowledge-settings-section-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0

.knowledge-settings-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	gap: var(--space-sm)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) 0

.knowledge-settings-text
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: 2px
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0

.knowledge-settings-label
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-primary)

.knowledge-settings-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	code
		font-family: var(--font-mono)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		padding: 1px 4px
		border-radius: var(--radius-sm)

.knowledge-settings-switch
	width: 18px
	height: 18px
	accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	cursor: pointer

// --- About dialog specifics -------------------------------------------------
.about-content
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	align-items: center
	text-align: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.app-icon
	width: 48px
	height: 48px
	margin-bottom: var(--space-3xs)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)

.app-name
	font-size: var(--text-lg)
	font-weight: 700
	color: var(--text-primary)
	margin: 0

.app-description
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	margin: var(--space-2xs) 0 0
	line-height: 1.4

// --- Custom prompt modal ----------------------------------------------------
.no-selection-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-3xs) 0

.selection-box
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	max-height: 120px
	overflow-y: auto
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-break: break-word

.prompt-input
	width: 100%
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	font-family: inherit
	resize: vertical
	line-height: 1.45
	&:focus
		outline: none
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring)

.provider-select
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	font-family: inherit

.no-providers
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--danger)

.field-error-row
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--danger)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)

.field-row
	flex-direction: row
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)

// --- Open dialog specifics --------------------------------------------------
.browse-section
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-sm) 0

.browse-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.browse-hint
	margin-left: auto
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)

.url-row
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	align-items: stretch

.url-input-sm,
.url-input
	flex: 1
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	outline: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	transition: border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:focus
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring)

.url-fetch-btn,
.btn-render
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	background: var(--theme-color)
	color: var(--text-inverse)
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--theme-color-alt)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: default

.url-error-sm,
.url-error
	margin-top: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--danger)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)

.dialog-tabs
	display: flex
	gap: 2px
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm) 0
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.dialog-tab
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-bottom: 2px solid transparent
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-bottom-color: var(--theme-color)

.tab-count
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	min-width: 18px
	height: 18px
	padding: 0 var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)

.dialog-content
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	flex: 1
	min-height: 0
	overflow-y: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) 0

.empty-list
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-md)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	p
		margin: 0

.empty-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)

.file-item
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.file-item-nested
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-sm) + var(--space-md))

.file-icon
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 24px
	height: 24px
	color: var(--text-muted)
	flex-shrink: 0

.file-info
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: 2px
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0

.file-name
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-primary)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.file-path
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.file-time
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	white-space: nowrap
	flex-shrink: 0

.folder-section
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column

.folder-header
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.folder-chevron
	color: var(--text-muted)
	transition: transform var(--motion-fast) ease
	flex-shrink: 0
	&.expanded
		transform: rotate(90deg)

.folder-name
	font-weight: 500

.folder-file-count
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
	min-width: 16px

.folder-path
	margin-left: auto
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.folder-loading-inline
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)

.add-folder-btn,
.add-folder-inline
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: none
	border: 1px dashed var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	margin: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		border-color: var(--text-secondary)

.add-folder-btn
	border-style: solid

.add-folder-inline
	align-self: flex-start
	margin: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)

// --- Paste modal specifics --------------------------------------------------
.modal-backdrop
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 30%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(4px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px)

.modal
	width: 600px
	max-height: 80vh
	background: var(--bg-dialog)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-lg)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	overflow: hidden

.modal-header
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.modal-header-left,
.modal-header-right
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.llm-badge
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	padding: 2px var(--space-2xs)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 18%, transparent)
	color: var(--warning)
	font-weight: 500

.llm-toggle
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	input
		accent-color: var(--theme-color)

.modal-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border: none
	background: none
	color: var(--text-muted)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.modal-body
	padding: var(--space-sm)
	flex: 1
	min-height: 0
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-sm)

.modal-textarea
	width: 100%
	height: 240px
	padding: var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	resize: none
	outline: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	transition: border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:focus
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring)
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.modal-footer
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.modal-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)

.modal-actions
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.btn-cancel
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)

1: /**
2:  * Scroll synchronization across viewer / raw / editor modes.
3:  *
4:  * Strategy: anchor on the source markdown's line number. The renderer stamps
5:  * `data-source-line="N"` (0-indexed) on every top-level block element. The
6:  * viewer reads/writes those stamps directly via getBoundingClientRect.
7:  *
8:  * Raw and editor have no per-line DOM, so we map source line ↔ pixel offset
9:  * through `measureLineOffsets`: an off-screen mirror that replicates the
10:  * element's content width, font, and wrapping rules and reports each line's
11:  * real `offsetTop`. This is wrap-aware — a flat `line * lineHeight` is wrong
12:  * the moment a long line wraps to multiple visual rows (issue #21), which is
13:  * exactly the case both panes hit since they `white-space: pre-wrap`.
14:  */
15: 
16: export type ViewMode = "viewer" | "raw" | "editor";
17: 
18: const TOOLBAR_TABBAR_HEIGHT = 80; // approximate sticky chrome at top
19: 
20: /** Read the source line currently anchored at the top of the viewport. */
21: export function getCurrentSourceLine(mode: ViewMode): number {
22:   if (mode === "viewer") return readViewerLine();
23:   if (mode === "raw") return readRawLine();
24:   return readEditorLine();
25: }
26: 
27: /** Scroll the destination mode so source `line` is anchored at the top. */
28: export function scrollToSourceLine(mode: ViewMode, line: number): void {
29:   if (line <= 0) {
30:     if (mode === "editor") {
31:       const ta = getEditorEl();
32:       if (ta) ta.scrollTop = 0;
33:     } else {
34:       window.scrollTo(0, 0);
35:     }
36:     return;
37:   }
38:   if (mode === "viewer") scrollViewerToLine(line);
39:   else if (mode === "raw") scrollRawToLine(line);
40:   else scrollEditorToLine(line);
41: }
42: 
43: // --- Viewer (rendered HTML with data-source-line stamps) ---
44: 
45: function readViewerLine(): number {
46:   const article = document.querySelector("article.prose");
47:   if (!article) return 0;
48:   const elements = article.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-source-line]");
49:   if (elements.length === 0) return 0;
50: 
51:   // Topmost block whose bottom is below the chrome line is the one "in view".
52:   // Return its start line PLUS the fraction of the block scrolled above the
53:   // chrome line — the fraction is what keeps your place when one block wraps
54:   // across many rows (issue #21); without it, deep-in-a-block positions snap
55:   // back to the block's first line on a mode switch.
56:   for (const el of elements) {
57:     const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
58:     if (rect.bottom > TOOLBAR_TABBAR_HEIGHT) {
59:       const frac =
60:         rect.height > 0 ? clamp01((TOOLBAR_TABBAR_HEIGHT - rect.top) / rect.height) : 0;
61:       return lineOf(el) + frac;
62:     }
63:   }
64:   // Past the end — return the last block's line
65:   return lineOf(elements[elements.length - 1]);
66: }
67: 
68: function scrollViewerToLine(anchor: number): void {
69:   const article = document.querySelector("article.prose");
70:   if (!article) return;
71:   const elements = Array.from(article.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-source-line]"));
72:   if (elements.length === 0) return;
73: 
74:   const floor = Math.floor(anchor);
75:   const frac = anchor - floor;
76: 
77:   // The block at or just before the target line; the fraction then positions
78:   // the viewport within that block to mirror the source mode.
79:   let target = elements[0];
80:   for (const el of elements) {
81:     if (lineOf(el) <= floor) target = el;
82:     else break;
83:   }
84: 
85:   const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
86:   window.scrollTo(0, window.scrollY + rect.top + frac * rect.height - TOOLBAR_TABBAR_HEIGHT);
87: }
88: 
89: function lineOf(el: HTMLElement): number {
90:   return parseInt(el.getAttribute("data-source-line") || "0", 10);
91: }
92: 
93: // --- Raw (window-scrolled <pre class="raw-source">) ---
94: 
95: function readRawLine(): number {
96:   const pre = document.querySelector<HTMLPreElement>(".raw-source");
97:   if (!pre) return 0;
98:   const preTop = pre.getBoundingClientRect().top;
99:   // pixels of the pre's content that have scrolled above the chrome line
100:   const hidden = TOOLBAR_TABBAR_HEIGHT - preTop;
101:   if (hidden <= 0) return 0;
102:   return fractionalLineAtOffset(measureLineOffsets(pre, pre.textContent || ""), hidden);
103: }
104: 
105: function scrollRawToLine(anchor: number): void {
106:   const pre = document.querySelector<HTMLPreElement>(".raw-source");
107:   if (!pre) return;
108:   const offsets = measureLineOffsets(pre, pre.textContent || "");
109:   const preTopAbsolute = pre.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY;
110:   window.scrollTo(0, preTopAbsolute + pixelAtLine(offsets, anchor) - TOOLBAR_TABBAR_HEIGHT);
111: }
112: 
113: // --- Editor (textarea with internal scroll) ---
114: 
115: function getEditorEl(): HTMLTextAreaElement | null {
116:   return document.querySelector<HTMLTextAreaElement>(".editor");
117: }
118: 
119: function readEditorLine(): number {
120:   const ta = getEditorEl();
121:   if (!ta) return 0;
122:   return fractionalLineAtOffset(measureLineOffsets(ta, ta.value), ta.scrollTop);
123: }
124: 
125: function scrollEditorToLine(anchor: number): void {
126:   const ta = getEditorEl();
127:   if (!ta) return;
128:   const offsets = measureLineOffsets(ta, ta.value);
129:   ta.scrollTop = Math.round(pixelAtLine(offsets, anchor));
130: }
131: 
132: // --- Wrap-aware, fractional line ↔ pixel mapping ---
133: //
134: // Anchors are fractional: the integer part is the 0-based source line at the
135: // top, the fractional part is how far the viewport has scrolled INTO that
136: // line's wrapped rows (0 = line top, →1 = next line top). The fraction is what
137: // preserves position inside a tall block across a mode switch (issue #21).
138: 
139: function clamp01(x: number): number {
140:   return x < 0 ? 0 : x > 1 ? 1 : x;
141: }
142: 
143: function clampLine(line: number, count: number): number {
144:   if (count === 0) return 0;
145:   return Math.min(Math.max(line, 0), count - 1);
146: }
147: 
148: /** Largest index `i` with `offsets[i] <= y` (binary search). */
149: function lineAtOffset(offsets: number[], y: number): number {
150:   if (offsets.length === 0 || y <= 0) return 0;
151:   let lo = 0;
152:   let hi = offsets.length - 1;
153:   let ans = 0;
154:   while (lo <= hi) {
155:     const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
156:     if (offsets[mid] <= y) {
157:       ans = mid;
158:       lo = mid + 1;
159:     } else {
160:       hi = mid - 1;
161:     }
162:   }
163:   return ans;
164: }
165: 
166: /** Fractional source line at pixel `y`: integer line + fraction into its rows. */
167: function fractionalLineAtOffset(offsets: number[], y: number): number {
168:   if (offsets.length === 0 || y <= 0) return 0;
169:   const floor = lineAtOffset(offsets, y);
170:   const base = offsets[floor];
171:   const next = floor + 1 < offsets.length ? offsets[floor + 1] : base + 1;
172:   const span = next - base;
173:   return floor + (span > 0 ? clamp01((y - base) / span) : 0);
174: }
175: 
176: /** Inverse of `fractionalLineAtOffset`: pixel offset for a fractional line. */
177: function pixelAtLine(offsets: number[], anchor: number): number {
178:   if (offsets.length === 0) return 0;
179:   const floor = clampLine(Math.floor(anchor), offsets.length);
180:   const frac = anchor - Math.floor(anchor);
181:   const base = offsets[floor];
182:   const next = floor + 1 < offsets.length ? offsets[floor + 1] : base;
183:   return base + (frac > 0 ? frac * (next - base) : 0);
184: }
185: 
186: /**
187:  * Measure the top pixel offset of every source line as it actually wraps
188:  * inside `reference` (the raw <pre> or the editor <textarea>). Returns an array
189:  * where `offsets[i]` is the y of line `i`'s first visual row, relative to the
190:  * content's top.
191:  *
192:  * Why a mirror: a <textarea> exposes no per-line geometry, and a wrapped <pre>'s
193:  * lines don't map to `lineHeight`. We replicate the element's content width,
194:  * font metrics, and wrap rules off-screen and read each line's real `offsetTop`.
195:  * Called once per mode switch, so a single layout pass is fine.
196:  */
197: function measureLineOffsets(reference: HTMLElement, text: string): number[] {
198:   const cs = getComputedStyle(reference);
199:   const padL = parseFloat(cs.paddingLeft) || 0;
200:   const padR = parseFloat(cs.paddingRight) || 0;
201:   const contentWidth = reference.clientWidth - padL - padR;
202: 
203:   const mirror = document.createElement("div");
204:   const s = mirror.style;
205:   s.position = "absolute";
206:   s.left = "-9999px";
207:   s.top = "0";
208:   s.visibility = "hidden";
209:   s.boxSizing = "border-box";
210:   s.margin = "0";
211:   s.padding = "0";
212:   s.border = "0";
213:   s.width = `${Math.max(0, contentWidth)}px`;
214:   // Replicate text metrics so wrapping matches the reference exactly.
215:   s.fontFamily = cs.fontFamily;
216:   s.fontSize = cs.fontSize;
217:   s.fontWeight = cs.fontWeight;
218:   s.fontStyle = cs.fontStyle;
219:   s.lineHeight = cs.lineHeight;
220:   s.letterSpacing = cs.letterSpacing;
221:   s.tabSize = cs.tabSize;
222:   s.whiteSpace = "pre-wrap";
223:   s.wordBreak = cs.wordBreak;
224:   s.overflowWrap = cs.overflowWrap;
225: 
226:   const lines = text.split("\n");
227:   const markers: HTMLElement[] = new Array(lines.length);
228:   const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
229:   for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
230:     const row = document.createElement("div");
231:     row.style.whiteSpace = "pre-wrap";
232:     row.style.wordBreak = cs.wordBreak;
233:     row.style.overflowWrap = cs.overflowWrap;
234:     // Empty lines must still occupy one row; a zero-width space forces a line box.
235:     row.textContent = lines[i].length ? lines[i] : "\u200b";
236:     frag.appendChild(row);
237:     markers[i] = row;
238:   }
239:   mirror.appendChild(frag);
240:   document.body.appendChild(mirror);
241:   const offsets = markers.map((m) => m.offsetTop);
242:   document.body.removeChild(mirror);
243:   return offsets;
244: }

Good, no tailwind anywhere. Now let me address each inline `style=` use. The dynamic styles (width, position, font-size from settings) are acceptable since they read settings at runtime - they're not "hardcoded styles" in the forbidden sense, they're dynamic UI state. But to fully comply with the spec (no inline style attributes), I need to use CSS custom properties set inline instead.

Let me handle each component's inline style situation:

1. **EmptyState** `style="zoom: {scale};"` - dynamic but forbidden. Use `--zoom-scale` custom property
2. **MarkdownRenderer** style="..." - same pattern, use CSS vars
3. **Editor** style="..." - dynamic settings4. **ReaderControls** `style="margin-bottom: 0;"` - hardcoded override, can be removed
5. **TableOfContents** style="padding-left: ..." - dynamic, use --indent
6. **Toolbar** `style="font-size:11px"` - hardcoded, remove
7. **ProgressBar** style="width: {progress}%" - dynamic, use --progress8. **TabBar** style="left/top" - dynamic position, use --dropdown-x, --dropdown-y
9. **NotesModule** style="font-size/line-height/max-width" - dynamic, use --vars

Let me update the sass file to handle these cases via custom properties:
