// =============================================================================
// 09_KNOWLEDGE-WORKSPACE — Notes workspace: toolbar, tab bar, library, editor,
// table of contents, status bar, scroll-to-top, progress, search overlay,
// toasts, frontmatter, link tooltips, image lightbox, marp presentation, etc.
// All classes the Notes workspace authors sit in this file. Components
// themselves own no <style> blocks.
// =============================================================================

@use 'sass:string'
@use 'sass:list'
@use 'sass:map'
@use '01_config' as *

$md: map.get($breakpoints, md)
$lg: map.get($breakpoints, lg)

// --- Inline progress bar at the top of the page ------------------------------
.progress-bar
	position: fixed
	top: 0
	left: 0
	height: 3px
	background: var(--theme-color)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	width: var(--progress, 0%)
	transition: width 0.1s linear
	pointer-events: none

// --- Status bar — fixed footer, blurs backdrop, hides on print --------------
.status-bar
	position: fixed
	bottom: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	.sep
		color: var(--border)

// --- Frontmatter bar — horizontal key/value strip above the article --------
.fm-bar
	display: flex
	flex-wrap: wrap
	gap: var(--space-xs) var(--space-md)
	max-width: min(100%, 720px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.fm-field
	display: flex
	align-items: baseline
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.fm-key
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)

.fm-value
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

// --- Scroll-to-top FAB -------------------------------------------------------
.scroll-top
	position: fixed
	bottom: var(--space-lg)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	width: 36px
	height: 36px
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	opacity: 0.7
	&:hover
		opacity: 1
		background: var(--state-hover)

// --- Toasts -----------------------------------------------------------------
.toast-stack
	position: fixed
	bottom: 96px
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-toast)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	align-items: flex-end

.toast
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	max-width: 360px
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	animation: slideUp var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)

.toast svg
	color: var(--danger)
	flex-shrink: 0

.toast-text
	line-height: 1.35

@keyframes slideUp
	from
		opacity: 0
		transform: translateY(10px)
	to
		opacity: 1
		transform: translateY(0)

// --- State center (loading + error UI inside page-main) ---------------------
.state-center
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--page-gutter)
	min-height: 60vh

.state-text
	color: var(--text-muted)
	&.pulse
		animation: pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite

@keyframes pulse
	0%, 100%
		opacity: 0.4
	50%
		opacity: 1

.error-box
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--danger)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	max-width: min(100%, 480px)

.error-msg
	color: var(--danger)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	margin: 0

// --- Drop zone — full-viewport dashed overlay when dragging a file ----------
.dropzone
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 8%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(2px)
	pointer-events: none

.dropzone-content
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-2xl)
	border: 2px dashed var(--theme-color)
	border-radius: var(--radius-lg)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)
	color: var(--theme-color)

.dropzone-text
	font-size: var(--text-md)
	font-weight: 500
	margin: 0

// --- Sidebar / Library (KnowledgeLibrary) -----------------------------------
.knowledge-library-actions
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs) var(--space-xs)

.knowledge-library-secondary-actions
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.knowledge-library-section
	padding: 0 var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)

.knowledge-library-heading
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)

.knowledge-library-heading h2
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0

.knowledge-library-icon-action
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.knowledge-library-empty
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	margin: 0

.knowledge-library-list
	list-style: none
	margin: 0
	padding: 0

.knowledge-library-folder-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.knowledge-library-folder-button
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.knowledge-library-count
	margin-left: auto
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums

.knowledge-library-remove
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
	li:hover &
		opacity: 1

.knowledge-library-files
	list-style: none
	margin: 0
	padding: 0 0 0 var(--space-md)

.knowledge-library-file
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	text-align: left
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.knowledge-library-recent-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.knowledge-library-recent
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.knowledge-library-recent-copy
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	min-width: 0
	flex: 1
	gap: 2px
	small
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		color: var(--text-muted)

// --- Toolbar (top bar in the workspace) ------------------------------------
.toolbar
	position: sticky
	top: var(--header-height)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)

.toolbar-left
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	min-width: 0
	flex: 1

.toolbar-center
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	flex-shrink: 0

.toolbar-right
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	flex-shrink: 0

.current-heading
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	min-width: 0
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.mode-segmented
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 2px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)

.mode-seg
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: 100%
	padding: 0 var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.btn
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 0 var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: 1px solid transparent
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.btn-icon
	padding: 0
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		position: absolute
		top: 6px
		right: 6px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin: 0 var(--space-3xs)

// --- Dropdown menu (used for Copy menu and tab context menu) ----------------
.dropdown
	position: fixed
	width: 160px
	left: var(--dropdown-x, 0)
	top: var(--dropdown-y, 0)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-3xs)
	overflow: hidden

.dropdown-item
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.dropdown-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)

// --- Tab bar ----------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	position: sticky
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg))
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs) 0
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tabbar-inner
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	gap: 2px
	min-width: 100%

.tabbar-files
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	gap: 2px
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
	&.active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		box-shadow: 0 -1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over
		border-left: 2px solid var(--theme-color)

.tab.home-tab
	min-width: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	flex-shrink: 0
	svg
		flex-shrink: 0

.tab-label
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	flex: 1
	text-align: left

.tab-dirty
	color: var(--theme-color)
	font-weight: 700
	margin-right: var(--space-3xs)

.tab-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 22px
	height: 22px
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	flex-shrink: 0
	cursor: pointer
	background: transparent
	border: none
	.tab:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.new-tab-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	margin-left: 2px
	margin-bottom: 2px
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	flex-shrink: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
		color: var(--theme-color)

// --- TOC (table of contents) sidebar ----------------------------------------
.toc-sidebar
	position: fixed
	left: 0
	top: 80px
	bottom: 0
	width: 240px
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)
	box-shadow: 2px 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 4%, transparent)
	overflow-y: auto
	z-index: var(--z-base)

.toc-header
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--text-muted)
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em

.toc-nav
	padding: 0 var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column

.toc-item
	display: block
	width: 100%
	text-align: left
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-xs) + var(--toc-indent, 0px))
	padding-right: var(--space-xs)
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-left: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: pointer
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	line-height: 1.6
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-width: 3px
		font-weight: 500
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)
		border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0

// --- Content main area: raw source + viewer with TOC spacing ---------------
.content-main
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--page-gutter) var(--space-2xl)
	transition: padding-inline var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.toc-spaced
		padding-left: calc(240px + var(--space-md))

.raw-source
	display: block
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	white-space: pre-wrap
	overflow-x: auto
	font-size: var(--raw-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--raw-line-height, 1.6)
	max-width: var(--raw-max-width, none)

// --- Knowledge edit layout (full or split) ---------------------------------
.knowledge-edit-layout
	position: fixed
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px)
	left: 0
	right: 0
	bottom: 0
	display: flex
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	background: var(--bg)
	&.split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.split-preview
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	overflow-y: auto

// --- Editor -----------------------------------------------------------------
.editor-wrap
	position: fixed
	inset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px) 0 0 0
	display: flex
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	&.split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.editor-stack
	position: relative
	flex: 1
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	max-width: var(--editor-max-width, 100%)

.editor,
.editor-backdrop,
.editor-gutter
	position: absolute
	inset: 0
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-md)
	border: none
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	tab-size: 2
	-moz-tab-size: 2
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-wrap: break-word
	overflow-wrap: break-word
	box-sizing: border-box
	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)

.editor
	background: transparent
	outline: none
	resize: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	z-index: 1
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-backdrop
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	z-index: 0

.editor.with-gutter,
.editor-backdrop.with-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))

.editor-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	overflow: hidden
	z-index: 0
	counter-reset: gl
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)
	.gl
		counter-increment: gl
		position: relative
	&__line::before
		content: counter(gl)
		position: absolute
		left: calc(-1 * var(--gutter-w))
		width: calc(var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-2xs))
		text-align: right
		color: var(--text-muted)
	.gl.active
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 3%, transparent)
	.gl.active::before
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		font-weight: 500

.editor-stack.with-gutter::before
	content: ""
	position: absolute
	left: 0
	top: 0
	bottom: 0
	width: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-3xs))
	border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 1%, transparent)
	z-index: 0
	pointer-events: none

// Highlight layer — only the <mark> backgrounds should be visible
.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-highlight
	color: transparent
	background-color: var(--warning)
	border-radius: 2px

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-active
	color: transparent !important
	background-color: var(--danger) !important

// --- Search overlay ---------------------------------------------------------
.search-bar
	position: fixed
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	right: var(--space-xs)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)

.search-icon
	color: var(--text-muted)
	flex-shrink: 0

.search-input
	width: 200px
	padding: 2px 0
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	outline: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.search-count
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	min-width: 32px
	text-align: center
	flex-shrink: 0

.search-nav
	display: flex
	gap: 1px

.search-nav-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 24px
	height: 24px
	border: none
	background: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.3
		cursor: default

.search-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 24px
	height: 24px
	border: none
	background: none
	color: var(--text-muted)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

// --- Highlight styles (view mode) ------------------------------------------
mark.mdv-search-highlight
	background-color: var(--warning)
	color: inherit
	padding: 1px 0
	border-radius: 2px

mark.mdv-search-active
	background-color: var(--danger) !important
	color: var(--text-inverse) !important

// --- Link tooltip -----------------------------------------------------------
.link-tooltip
	display: none
	position: fixed
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	max-width: 400px
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	pointer-events: none

// --- Image lightbox ---------------------------------------------------------
.lightbox
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(4px)

.lb-image
	max-width: 90vw
	max-height: 90vh
	object-fit: contain
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	user-select: none

.lb-close,
.lb-nav
	position: absolute
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 10%, transparent)
	color: #fff
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 20%, transparent)

.lb-close
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: 40px
	height: 40px

.lb-nav
	top: 50%
	transform: translateY(-50%)
	width: 44px
	height: 44px

.lb-prev
	left: var(--space-sm)

.lb-next
	right: var(--space-sm)

.lb-counter
	position: absolute
	bottom: var(--space-sm)
	left: 50%
	transform: translateX(-50%)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums

// --- Empty state (home / recents / pinned folders / plans) -----------------
.empty-root
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	max-width: 1040px
	margin: 0 auto
	min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height) - var(--space-md))
	gap: var(--space-sm)
	zoom: var(--zoom, 1)

.hero-bar
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) 0 var(--space-2xs)

.hero-logo
	flex-shrink: 0
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)

.hero-text
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: 2px

.hero-title
	font-size: var(--text-lg)
	font-weight: 700
	letter-spacing: -0.01em
	color: var(--text-primary)
	margin: 0

.hero-desc
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0

.quick-actions
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	flex-wrap: wrap

.qa-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		border-color: var(--state-selected)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.qa-primary
		background: var(--theme-color)
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
		color: var(--text-inverse)
		&:hover
			background: var(--theme-color-alt)
			border-color: var(--theme-color-alt)

.section
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.section-header
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: 0 var(--space-3xs)

.section-title
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0
	flex: 1

.section-count
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	padding: 1px var(--space-2xs)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.section-action
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: none
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	padding: 0
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)

.section-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: none
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.section-action.unpin
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	.section-header:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)

.card
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	overflow: hidden

.card-scroll
	overflow-y: auto

.uniform-card
	height: 300px

.recents-grid
	display: grid
	grid-template-columns: 1fr
	&.two-col
		grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr
		.item:nth-child(even)
			border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

@media #{string.unquote('(max-width: 720px)')}
	.recents-grid.two-col
		grid-template-columns: 1fr
		.item:nth-child(even)
			border-left: none

.card-empty
	padding: var(--space-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	text-align: center

.item
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:last-of-type
		border-bottom: none
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.item-icon
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-lg)
	height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--theme-color)
	flex-shrink: 0
	&.plan
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 12%, transparent)
		color: var(--success)

.item-info
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: 1px

.item-name
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-primary)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.item-path
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.item-time
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	white-space: nowrap
	flex-shrink: 0

.panels-grid
	display: grid
	grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))
	gap: var(--space-sm)

@media #{string.unquote('(max-width: 720px)')}
	.panels-grid
		grid-template-columns: 1fr

.footer-row
	margin-top: auto
	padding-top: var(--space-xs)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	flex-wrap: wrap
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.footer-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	.kbd
		display: inline-block
		padding: 1px var(--space-3xs)
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		background: var(--bg-raised)
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		border-radius: var(--radius-sm)

.footer-link
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--theme-color)
	background: none
	border: none
	padding: 0
	cursor: pointer
	text-decoration: underline
	&:hover
		text-decoration: none

.zoom-controls
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.zoom-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.zoom-label
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	min-width: 28px
	text-align: center
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums

// --- Marp presentation ------------------------------------------------------
.present-root
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-md)
	background: #0e0e10

.present-stage
	position: relative
	width: min(100%, calc((100vh - 96px) * 16 / 9))
	aspect-ratio: 16 / 9
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: 0 8px 40px color-mix(in srgb, #000 50%, transparent)
	overflow: hidden
	display: flex

.present-slide
	flex: 1
	overflow-y: auto
	padding: 6% 8%
	:global(.md-content)
		max-width: none !important
		margin: 0 !important
		padding: 0 !important

.present-counter
	position: absolute
	right: var(--space-xs)
	bottom: var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 4%, transparent)
	padding: 2px var(--space-2xs)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	pointer-events: none

.present-nav-edge
	flex-shrink: 0
	width: 44px
	height: 44px
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	background: transparent
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.25
		cursor: default

.present-close
	position: absolute
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: var(--control-h-lg)
	height: var(--control-h-lg)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	background: transparent
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)

// --- Reader controls popover ------------------------------------------------
.rc-panel
	position: fixed
	right: var(--space-xs)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	width: 240px
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-xs)

.rc-arrow
	position: absolute
	top: -5px
	right: 60px
	width: 10px
	height: 10px
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border-left: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border)
	transform: rotate(45deg)

.rc-title
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--text-muted)
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	margin: 0 0 var(--space-xs)

.rc-group
	margin-bottom: var(--space-xs)
	&.disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		.rc-range
			cursor: not-allowed

.rc-label
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.rc-label-row
	display: flex
	justify-content: space-between
	align-items: center
	margin-bottom: var(--space-3xs)

.rc-value
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	color: var(--text-muted)

.rc-segmented
	display: flex
	gap: 1px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	overflow: hidden
	margin-top: var(--space-3xs)

.rc-seg-btn
	flex: 1
	padding: var(--space-3xs) 0
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
	&.active
		background: var(--theme-color)
		color: var(--text-inverse)

.rc-range
	width: 100%
	height: 4px
	-webkit-appearance: none
	appearance: none
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	outline: none
	&::-webkit-slider-thumb
		-webkit-appearance: none
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg-popover)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)
	&::-moz-range-thumb
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg-popover)

// --- Print: hide non-document UI -------------------------------------------
@media print
	.progress-bar
		display: none
	.status-bar
		display: none
	.toc-sidebar
		display: none
	.scroll-top
		display: none
	.toast-stack
		display: none
	.toolbar
		display: none
	.tabbar
		display: none
	.search-bar
		display: none
	.rc-panel
		display: none

// =============================================================================
// 09_KNOWLEDGE-WORKSPACE — Notes workspace: toolbar, tab bar, library, editor,
// table of contents, status bar, scroll-to-top, progress, search overlay,
// toasts, frontmatter, link tooltips, image lightbox, marp presentation, etc.
// All classes the Notes workspace authors sit in this file. Components
// themselves own no <style> blocks.
// =============================================================================

@use 'sass:string'
@use 'sass:list'
@use 'sass:map'
@use '01_config' as *

$md: map.get($breakpoints, md)
$lg: map.get($breakpoints, lg)

// --- Inline progress bar at the top of the page ------------------------------
.progress-bar
	position: fixed
	top: 0
	left: 0
	height: 3px
	background: var(--theme-color)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	width: var(--progress, 0%)
	transition: width 0.1s linear
	pointer-events: none

// --- Status bar — fixed footer, blurs backdrop, hides on print --------------
.status-bar
	position: fixed
	bottom: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	.sep
		color: var(--border)

// --- Frontmatter bar — horizontal key/value strip above the article --------
.fm-bar
	display: flex
	flex-wrap: wrap
	gap: var(--space-xs) var(--space-md)
	max-width: min(100%, 720px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.fm-field
	display: flex
	align-items: baseline
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.fm-key
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)

.fm-value
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

// --- Scroll-to-top FAB -------------------------------------------------------
.scroll-top
	position: fixed
	bottom: var(--space-lg)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	width: 36px
	height: 36px
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	opacity: 0.7
	&:hover
		opacity: 1
		background: var(--state-hover)

// --- Toasts -----------------------------------------------------------------
.toast-stack
	position: fixed
	bottom: 96px
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-toast)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	align-items: flex-end

.toast
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	max-width: 360px
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	animation: slideUp var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)

.toast svg
	color: var(--danger)
	flex-shrink: 0

.toast-text
	line-height: 1.35

@keyframes slideUp
	from
		opacity: 0
		transform: translateY(10px)
	to
		opacity: 1
		transform: translateY(0)

// --- State center (loading + error UI inside page-main) ---------------------
.state-center
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--page-gutter)
	min-height: 60vh

.state-text
	color: var(--text-muted)
	&.pulse
		animation: pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite

@keyframes pulse
	0%, 100%
		opacity: 0.4
	50%
		opacity: 1

.error-box
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--danger)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	max-width: min(100%, 480px)

.error-msg
	color: var(--danger)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	margin: 0

// --- Drop zone — full-viewport dashed overlay when dragging a file ----------
.dropzone
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 8%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(2px)
	pointer-events: none

.dropzone-content
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-2xl)
	border: 2px dashed var(--theme-color)
	border-radius: var(--radius-lg)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)
	color: var(--theme-color)

.dropzone-text
	font-size: var(--text-md)
	font-weight: 500
	margin: 0

// --- Sidebar / Library (KnowledgeLibrary) -----------------------------------
.knowledge-library-actions
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs) var(--space-xs)

.knowledge-library-secondary-actions
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.knowledge-library-section
	padding: 0 var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)

.knowledge-library-heading
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)

.knowledge-library-heading h2
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0

.knowledge-library-icon-action
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.knowledge-library-empty
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	margin: 0

.knowledge-library-list
	list-style: none
	margin: 0
	padding: 0

.knowledge-library-folder-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.knowledge-library-folder-button
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.knowledge-library-count
	margin-left: auto
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums

.knowledge-library-remove
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
	li:hover &
		opacity: 1

.knowledge-library-files
	list-style: none
	margin: 0
	padding: 0 0 0 var(--space-md)

.knowledge-library-file
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	text-align: left
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.knowledge-library-recent-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.knowledge-library-recent
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.knowledge-library-recent-copy
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	min-width: 0
	flex: 1
	gap: 2px
	small
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		color: var(--text-muted)

// --- Toolbar (top bar in the workspace) ------------------------------------
.toolbar
	position: sticky
	top: var(--header-height)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)

.toolbar-left
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	min-width: 0
	flex: 1

.toolbar-center
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	flex-shrink: 0

.toolbar-right
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	flex-shrink: 0

.current-heading
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	min-width: 0
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.mode-segmented
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 2px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)

.mode-seg
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: 100%
	padding: 0 var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.btn
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 0 var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: 1px solid transparent
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.btn-icon
	padding: 0
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		position: absolute
		top: 6px
		right: 6px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin: 0 var(--space-3xs)

// --- Dropdown menu (used for Copy menu and tab context menu) ----------------
.dropdown
	position: fixed
	width: 160px
	left: var(--dropdown-x, 0)
	top: var(--dropdown-y, 0)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-3xs)
	overflow: hidden

.dropdown-item
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.dropdown-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)

// --- Tab bar ----------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	position: sticky
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg))
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs) 0
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tabbar-inner
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	gap: 2px
	min-width: 100%

.tabbar-files
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	gap: 2px
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
	&.active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		box-shadow: 0 -1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over
		border-left: 2px solid var(--theme-color)

.tab.home-tab
	min-width: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	flex-shrink: 0
	svg
		flex-shrink: 0

.tab-label
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	flex: 1
	text-align: left

.tab-dirty
	color: var(--theme-color)
	font-weight: 700
	margin-right: var(--space-3xs)

.tab-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 22px
	height: 22px
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	flex-shrink: 0
	cursor: pointer
	background: transparent
	border: none
	.tab:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.new-tab-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	margin-left: 2px
	margin-bottom: 2px
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	flex-shrink: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
		color: var(--theme-color)

// --- TOC (table of contents) sidebar ----------------------------------------
.toc-sidebar
	position: fixed
	left: 0
	top: 80px
	bottom: 0
	width: 240px
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)
	box-shadow: 2px 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 4%, transparent)
	overflow-y: auto
	z-index: var(--z-base)

.toc-header
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--text-muted)
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em

.toc-nav
	padding: 0 var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column

.toc-item
	display: block
	width: 100%
	text-align: left
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-xs) + var(--toc-indent, 0px))
	padding-right: var(--space-xs)
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-left: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: pointer
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	line-height: 1.6
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-width: 3px
		font-weight: 500
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)
		border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0

// --- Content main area: raw source + viewer with TOC spacing ---------------
.content-main
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--page-gutter) var(--space-2xl)
	transition: padding-inline var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.toc-spaced
		padding-left: calc(240px + var(--space-md))

.raw-source
	display: block
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	white-space: pre-wrap
	overflow-x: auto
	font-size: var(--raw-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--raw-line-height, 1.6)
	max-width: var(--raw-max-width, none)

// --- Knowledge edit layout (full or split) ---------------------------------
.knowledge-edit-layout
	position: fixed
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px)
	left: 0
	right: 0
	bottom: 0
	display: flex
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	background: var(--bg)
	&.split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.split-preview
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	overflow-y: auto

// --- Editor -----------------------------------------------------------------
.editor-wrap
	position: fixed
	inset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px) 0 0 0
	display: flex
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	&.split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.editor-stack
	position: relative
	flex: 1
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	max-width: var(--editor-max-width, 100%)

.editor,
.editor-backdrop,
.editor-gutter
	position: absolute
	inset: 0
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-md)
	border: none
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	tab-size: 2
	-moz-tab-size: 2
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-wrap: break-word
	overflow-wrap: break-word
	box-sizing: border-box
	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)

.editor
	background: transparent
	outline: none
	resize: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	z-index: 1
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-backdrop
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	z-index: 0

.editor.with-gutter,
.editor-backdrop.with-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))

.editor-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	overflow: hidden
	z-index: 0
	counter-reset: gl
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)
	.gl
		counter-increment: gl
		position: relative
	&__line::before
		content: counter(gl)
		position: absolute
		left: calc(-1 * var(--gutter-w))
		width: calc(var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-2xs))
		text-align: right
		color: var(--text-muted)
	.gl.active
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 3%, transparent)
	.gl.active::before
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		font-weight: 500

.editor-stack.with-gutter::before
	content: ""
	position: absolute
	left: 0
	top: 0
	bottom: 0
	width: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-3xs))
	border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 1%, transparent)
	z-index: 0
	pointer-events: none

// Highlight layer — only the <mark> backgrounds should be visible
.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-highlight
	color: transparent
	background-color: var(--warning)
	border-radius: 2px

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-active
	color: transparent !important
	background-color: var(--danger) !important

// --- Search overlay ---------------------------------------------------------
.search-bar
	position: fixed
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	right: var(--space-xs)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)

.search-icon
	color: var(--text-muted)
	flex-shrink: 0

.search-input
	width: 200px
	padding: 2px 0
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	outline: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.search-count
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	min-width: 32px
	text-align: center
	flex-shrink: 0

.search-nav
	display: flex
	gap: 1px

.search-nav-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 24px
	height: 24px
	border: none
	background: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease

.section

.section-header

	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

	cursor: pointer
	text-decoration: underline
	&:hover
		text-decoration: none

.zoom-controls
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.zoom-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease

	color: var(--text-secondary)
	min-width: 28px
	text-align: center
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums

.present-root

	justify-content: center

	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	background: transparent
	color: var(--text-muted)

	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease

		opacity: 0.25
		cursor: default

	position: absolute
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: var(--control-h-lg)
	height: var(--control-h-lg)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	background: transparent
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)

.rc-panel

	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)

	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-xs)

	right: 60px
	width: 10px
	height: 10px

	border-top: 1px solid var(--border)

	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.rc-label-row

	justify-content: space-between
	align-items: center
	margin-bottom: var(--space-3xs)

.rc-value
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	color: var(--text-muted)

.rc-segmented

	gap: 1px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	overflow: hidden
	margin-top: var(--space-3xs)

.rc-seg-btn
	flex: 1
	padding: var(--space-3xs) 0
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover

	&.active

		color: var(--text-inverse)

.rc-range

	height: 4px
	-webkit-appearance: none
	appearance: none
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	outline: none
	&::-webkit-slider-thumb

		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)

		border: 2px solid var(--bg-popover)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)
	&::-moz-range-thumb
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg-popover)

// --- Print: hide non-document UI -------------------------------------------

	.scroll-top

		display: none
	.toolbar
		display: none
	.tabbar
		display: none
	.search-bar
		display: none
	.rc-panel
		display: none

@use 'sass:map'

// Base article

// ---- Typography -------------------------------------------------------------
.md-content
	h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6
		line-height: 1.25
		font-weight: 600
		color: var(--text-primary)
		letter-spacing: -0.01em
	h1
		font-size: 1.75em
		font-weight: 700
		letter-spacing: -0.02em
		margin-top: 1.5em
	h2
		font-size: 1.4em
		margin-top: 1.25em
	h3
		font-size: 1.15em
		margin-top: 1em
	h4
		font-size: 1em
		margin-top: 1em
	p
		margin-block: var(--space-xs)
		line-height: 1.65

// ---- Code blocks ------------------------------------------------------------
.md-content
	pre
		border-radius: var(--radius-md)
		padding: 1em 1.2em
		overflow-x: auto
		font-size: 0.8em
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle) !important
		color: var(--text-primary) !important
		position: relative
	code
		font-family: var(--font-mono)
	:not(pre) > code
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		padding: 0.15em 0.4em
		border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
		font-size: 0.85em
		color: var(--theme-color-alt)
		&::before, &::after
			content: none

// ---- Tables ----------------------------------------------------------------
.md-content
	table
		border-collapse: collapse
		width: 100%
		overflow-x: auto
		display: block
		font-size: 0.9em
	th, td
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		padding: 0.5em 0.75em
		text-align: left
	th
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		font-weight: 600
		font-size: 0.9em
		color: var(--text-secondary)

// ---- Blockquotes ------------------------------------------------------------
.md-content
	blockquote
		border-left: 3px solid var(--theme-color)
		padding-left: 1em
		margin: var(--space-md) 0
		color: var(--text-secondary)

// ---- Images ----------------------------------------------------------------
.md-content
	img
		max-width: 100%
		height: auto
		border-radius: var(--radius-md)

// ---- Horizontal rules ------------------------------------------------------
.md-content
	hr
		border: none
		border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
		margin: 2.5em 0

// ---- Task lists -------------------------------------------------------------
.md-content
	.task-list-item
		list-style: none
		margin-left: -1.5em
		input[type='checkbox']
			margin-right: var(--space-2xs)
			accent-color: var(--theme-color)

// ---- Links ------------------------------------------------------------------
.md-content
	a
		color: var(--theme-color)
		text-decoration: none
		&:hover
			text-decoration: underline

// ---- Code-copy button (injected by MarkdownRenderer.addCodeCopyButtons) ---
.md-content
	.code-copy-btn
		position: absolute
		top: 8px
		right: 8px
		padding: 3px 10px
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		font-weight: 500
		font-family: var(--font-sans)
		color: var(--text-muted)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 80%, transparent)
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
		cursor: pointer
		opacity: 0
		transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
		z-index: 2
		backdrop-filter: blur(4px)
		&:hover
			background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 95%, transparent)
			color: var(--text-primary)
	pre:hover .code-copy-btn
		opacity: 1

// ---- Mermaid diagrams ------------------------------------------------------
.md-content
	.mermaid-diagram
		overflow-x: auto
		svg
			max-width: 100%
			height: auto

// ---- KaTeX math -------------------------------------------------------------
.md-content
	.katex-display
		overflow-x: auto
		padding: 0.5em 0
	.katex
		font-size: 1.1em
