// =============================================================================
// 09_KNOWLEDGE-WORKSPACE — Notes workspace: toolbar, tab bar, library, editor,
// table of contents, status bar, scroll-to-top, progress, search overlay,
// toasts, frontmatter, link tooltips, image lightbox, marp presentation, etc.
// All classes the Notes workspace authors sit in this file. Components
// themselves own no <style> blocks.
// =============================================================================

@use 'sass:string'
@use 'sass:list'
@use 'sass:map'
@use '01_config' as *

$md: map.get($breakpoints, md)
$lg: map.get($breakpoints, lg)

// --- Inline progress bar at the top of the page ------------------------------
.progress-bar
	position: fixed
	top: 0
	left: 0
	height: 3px
	background: var(--theme-color)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	width: var(--progress, 0%)
	transition: width 0.1s linear
	pointer-events: none

// --- Status bar — fixed footer, blurs backdrop, hides on print --------------
.status-bar
	position: fixed
	bottom: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	.sep
		color: var(--border)

// --- Frontmatter bar — horizontal key/value strip above the article --------
.fm-bar
	display: flex
	flex-wrap: wrap
	gap: var(--space-xs) var(--space-md)
	max-width: min(100%, 720px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.fm-field
	display: flex
	align-items: baseline
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.fm-key
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)

.fm-value
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

// --- Scroll-to-top FAB -------------------------------------------------------
.scroll-top
	position: fixed
	bottom: var(--space-lg)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	width: 36px
	height: 36px
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	opacity: 0.7
	&:hover
		opacity: 1
		background: var(--state-hover)

// --- Toasts -----------------------------------------------------------------
.toast-stack
	position: fixed
	bottom: 96px
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-toast)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	align-items: flex-end

.toast
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	max-width: 360px
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	animation: slideUp var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)

.toast svg
	color: var(--danger)
	flex-shrink: 0

.toast-text
	line-height: 1.35

@keyframes slideUp
	from
		opacity: 0
		transform: translateY(10px)
	to
		opacity: 1
		transform: translateY(0)

// --- State center (loading + error UI inside page-main) ---------------------
.state-center
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--page-gutter)
	min-height: 60vh

.state-text
	color: var(--text-muted)
	&.pulse
		animation: pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite

@keyframes pulse
	0%, 100%
		opacity: 0.4
	50%
		opacity: 1

.error-box
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--danger)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	max-width: min(100%, 480px)

.error-msg
	color: var(--danger)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	margin: 0

// --- Drop zone — full-viewport dashed overlay when dragging a file ----------
.dropzone
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 8%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(2px)
	pointer-events: none

.dropzone-content
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-2xl)
	border: 2px dashed var(--theme-color)
	border-radius: var(--radius-lg)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)
	color: var(--theme-color)

.dropzone-text
	font-size: var(--text-md)
	font-weight: 500
	margin: 0

// --- Sidebar / Library (KnowledgeLibrary) -----------------------------------
.knowledge-library-actions
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs) var(--space-xs)

.knowledge-library-secondary-actions
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.knowledge-library-section
	padding: 0 var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)

.knowledge-library-heading
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)

.knowledge-library-heading h2
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0

.knowledge-library-icon-action
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.knowledge-library-empty
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	margin: 0

.knowledge-library-list
	list-style: none
	margin: 0
	padding: 0

.knowledge-library-folder-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.knowledge-library-folder-button
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.knowledge-library-count
	margin-left: auto
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums

.knowledge-library-remove
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
	li:hover &
		opacity: 1

.knowledge-library-files
	list-style: none
	margin: 0
	padding: 0 0 0 var(--space-md)

.knowledge-library-file
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	text-align: left
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.knowledge-library-recent-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.knowledge-library-recent
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.knowledge-library-recent-copy
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	min-width: 0
	flex: 1
	gap: 2px
	small
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		color: var(--text-muted)

// --- Toolbar (top bar in the workspace) ------------------------------------
.toolbar
	position: sticky
	top: var(--header-height)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)

.toolbar-left
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	min-width: 0
	flex: 1

.toolbar-center
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	flex-shrink: 0

.toolbar-right
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	flex-shrink: 0

.current-heading
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	min-width: 0
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.mode-segmented
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 2px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)

.mode-seg
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: 100%
	padding: 0 var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.btn
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 0 var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: 1px solid transparent
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.btn-icon
	padding: 0
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		position: absolute
		top: 6px
		right: 6px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin: 0 var(--space-3xs)

// --- Dropdown menu (used for Copy menu and tab context menu) ----------------
.dropdown
	position: fixed
	width: 160px
	left: var(--dropdown-x, 0)
	top: var(--dropdown-y, 0)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-3xs)
	overflow: hidden

.dropdown-item
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.dropdown-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)

// --- Tab bar ----------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	position: sticky
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg))
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs) 0
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tabbar-inner
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	gap: 2px
	min-width: 100%

.tabbar-files
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	gap: 2px
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
	&.active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		box-shadow: 0 -1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over
		border-left: 2px solid var(--theme-color)

.tab.home-tab
	min-width: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	flex-shrink: 0
	svg
		flex-shrink: 0

.tab-label
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	flex: 1
	text-align: left

.tab-dirty
	color: var(--theme-color)
	font-weight: 700
	margin-right: var(--space-3xs)

.tab-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 22px
	height: 22px
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	flex-shrink: 0
	cursor: pointer
	background: transparent
	border: none
	.tab:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.new-tab-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	margin-left: 2px
	margin-bottom: 2px
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	flex-shrink: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
		color: var(--theme-color)

// --- TOC (table of contents) sidebar ----------------------------------------
.toc-sidebar
	position: fixed
	left: 0
	top: 80px
	bottom: 0
	width: 240px
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)
	box-shadow: 2px 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 4%, transparent)
	overflow-y: auto
	z-index: var(--z-base)

.toc-header
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--text-muted)
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em

.toc-nav
	padding: 0 var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column

.toc-item
	display: block
	width: 100%
	text-align: left
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-xs) + var(--toc-indent, 0px))
	padding-right: var(--space-xs)
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-left: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: pointer
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	line-height: 1.6
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-width: 3px
		font-weight: 500
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)
		border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0

// --- Content main area: raw source + viewer with TOC spacing ---------------
.content-main
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--page-gutter) var(--space-2xl)
	transition: padding-inline var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.toc-spaced
		padding-left: calc(240px + var(--space-md))

.raw-source
	display: block
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	white-space: pre-wrap
	overflow-x: auto
	font-size: var(--raw-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--raw-line-height, 1.6)
	max-width: var(--raw-max-width, none)

// --- Knowledge edit layout (full or split) ---------------------------------
.knowledge-edit-layout
	position: fixed
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px)
	left: 0
	right: 0
	bottom: 0
	display: flex
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	background: var(--bg)
	&.split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.split-preview
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	overflow-y: auto

// --- Editor -----------------------------------------------------------------
.editor-wrap
	position: fixed
	inset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px) 0 0 0
	display: flex
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	&.split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.editor-stack
	position: relative
	flex: 1
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	max-width: var(--editor-max-width, 100%)

.editor,
.editor-backdrop,
.editor-gutter
	position: absolute
	inset: 0
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-md)
	border: none
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	tab-size: 2
	-moz-tab-size: 2
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-wrap: break-word
	overflow-wrap: break-word
	box-sizing: border-box
	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)

.editor
	background: transparent
	outline: none
	resize: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	z-index: 1
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-backdrop
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	z-index: 0

.editor.with-gutter,
.editor-backdrop.with-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))

.editor-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	overflow: hidden
	z-index: 0
	counter-reset: gl
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)
	.gl
		counter-increment: gl
		position: relative
	&__line::before
		content: counter(gl)
		position: absolute
		left: calc(-1 * var(--gutter-w))
		width: calc(var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-2xs))
		text-align: right
		color: var(--text-muted)
	.gl.active
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 3%, transparent)
	.gl.active::before
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		font-weight: 500

.editor-stack.with-gutter::before
	content: ""
	position: absolute
	left: 0
	top: 0
	bottom: 0
	width: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-3xs))
	border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 1%, transparent)
	z-index: 0
	pointer-events: none

// Highlight layer — only the <mark> backgrounds should be visible
.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-highlight
	color: transparent
	background-color: var(--warning)
	border-radius: 2px

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-active
	color: transparent !important
	background-color: var(--danger) !important

// --- Search overlay ---------------------------------------------------------
.search-bar
	position: fixed
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	right: var(--space-xs)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)

.search-icon
	color: var(--text-muted)
	flex-shrink: 0

.search-input
	width: 200px
	padding: 2px 0
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	outline: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.search-count
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	min-width: 32px
	text-align: center
	flex-shrink: 0

.search-nav
	display: flex
	gap: 1px

.search-nav-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 24px
	height: 24px
	border: none
	background: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.3
		cursor: default

.search-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 24px
	height: 24px
	border: none
	background: none
	color: var(--text-muted)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

// --- Highlight styles (view mode) ------------------------------------------
mark.mdv-search-highlight
	background-color: var(--warning)
	color: inherit
	padding: 1px 0
	border-radius: 2px

mark.mdv-search-active
	background-color: var(--danger) !important
	color: var(--text-inverse) !important

// --- Link tooltip -----------------------------------------------------------
.link-tooltip
	display: none
	position: fixed
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	max-width: 400px
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	pointer-events: none

// --- Image lightbox ---------------------------------------------------------
.lightbox
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(4px)

.lb-image
	max-width: 90vw
	max-height: 90vh
	object-fit: contain
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	user-select: none

.lb-close,
.lb-nav
	position: absolute
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 10%, transparent)
	color: #fff
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 20%, transparent)

.lb-close
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: 40px
	height: 40px

.lb-nav
	top: 50%
	transform: translateY(-50%)
	width: 44px
	height: 44px

.lb-prev
	left: var(--space-sm)

.lb-next
	right: var(--space-sm)

.lb-counter
	position: absolute
	bottom: var(--space-sm)
	left: 50%
	transform: translateX(-50%)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums

// --- Empty state (home / recents / pinned folders / plans) -----------------
.empty-root
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	max-width: 1040px
	margin: 0 auto
	min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height) - var(--space-md))
	gap: var(--space-sm)
	zoom: var(--zoom, 1)

.hero-bar
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) 0 var(--space-2xs)

.hero-logo
	flex-shrink: 0
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)

.hero-text
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: 2px

.hero-title
	font-size: var(--text-lg)
	font-weight: 700
	letter-spacing: -0.01em
	color: var(--text-primary)
	margin: 0

.hero-desc
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0

.quick-actions
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	flex-wrap: wrap

.qa-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		border-color: var(--state-selected)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.qa-primary
		background: var(--theme-color)
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
		color: var(--text-inverse)
		&:hover
			background: var(--theme-color-alt)
			border-color: var(--theme-color-alt)

.section
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.section-header
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: 0 var(--space-3xs)

.section-title
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0
	flex: 1

.section-count
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	padding: 1px var(--space-2xs)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.section-action
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: none
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	padding: 0
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)

.section-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: none
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.section-action.unpin
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	.section-header:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)

.card
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	overflow: hidden

.card-scroll
	overflow-y: auto

.uniform-card
	height: 300px

.recents-grid
	display: grid
	grid-template-columns: 1fr
	&.two-col
		grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr
		.item:nth-child(even)
			border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

@media #{string.unquote('(max-width: 720px)')}
	.recents-grid.two-col
		grid-template-columns: 1fr
		.item:nth-child(even)
			border-left: none

.card-empty
	padding: var(--space-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	text-align: center

.item
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:last-of-type
		border-bottom: none
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.item-icon
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-lg)
	height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--theme-color)
	flex-shrink: 0
	&.plan
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 12%, transparent)
		color: var(--success)

.item-info
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: 1px

.item-name
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-primary)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.item-path
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.item-time
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	white-space: nowrap
	flex-shrink: 0

.panels-grid
	display: grid
	grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))
	gap: var(--space-sm)

@media #{string.unquote('(max-width: 720px)')}
	.panels-grid
		grid-template-columns: 1fr

.footer-row
	margin-top: auto
	padding-top: var(--space-xs)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	flex-wrap: wrap
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.footer-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	.kbd
		display: inline-block
		padding: 1px var(--space-3xs)
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		background: var(--bg-raised)
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		border-radius: var(--radius-sm)

.footer-link
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--theme-color)
	background: none
	border: none
	padding: 0
	cursor: pointer
	text-decoration: underline
	&:hover
		text-decoration: none

.zoom-controls
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.zoom-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.zoom-label
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	min-width: 28px
	text-align: center
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums

// --- Marp presentation ------------------------------------------------------
.present-root
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-md)
	background: #0e0e10

.present-stage
	position: relative
	width: min(100%, calc((100vh - 96px) * 16 / 9))
	aspect-ratio: 16 / 9
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: 0 8px 40px color-mix(in srgb, #000 50%, transparent)
	overflow: hidden
	display: flex

.present-slide
	flex: 1
	overflow-y: auto
	padding: 6% 8%
	:global(.md-content)
		max-width: none !important
		margin: 0 !important
		padding: 0 !important

.present-counter
	position: absolute
	right: var(--space-xs)
	bottom: var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 4%, transparent)
	padding: 2px var(--space-2xs)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	pointer-events: none

.present-nav-edge
	flex-shrink: 0
	width: 44px
	height: 44px
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	background: transparent
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.25
		cursor: default

.present-close
	position: absolute
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: var(--control-h-lg)
	height: var(--control-h-lg)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	background: transparent
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)

// --- Reader controls popover ------------------------------------------------
.rc-panel
	position: fixed
	right: var(--space-xs)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	width: 240px
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-xs)

.rc-arrow
	position: absolute
	top: -5px
	right: 60px
	width: 10px
	height: 10px
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border-left: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border)
	transform: rotate(45deg)

.rc-title
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--text-muted)
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	margin: 0 0 var(--space-xs)

.rc-group
	margin-bottom: var(--space-xs)
	&.disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		.rc-range
			cursor: not-allowed

.rc-label
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.rc-label-row
	display: flex
	justify-content: space-between
	align-items: center
	margin-bottom: var(--space-3xs)

.rc-value
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	color: var(--text-muted)

.rc-segmented
	display: flex
	gap: 1px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	overflow: hidden
	margin-top: var(--space-3xs)

.rc-seg-btn
	flex: 1
	padding: var(--space-3xs) 0
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
	&.active
		background: var(--theme-color)
		color: var(--text-inverse)

.rc-range
	width: 100%
	height: 4px
	-webkit-appearance: none
	appearance: none
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	outline: none
	&::-webkit-slider-thumb
		-webkit-appearance: none
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg-popover)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)
	&::-moz-range-thumb
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg-popover)


.copy-feedback
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-primary)

.rc-group-last
	margin-bottom: 0

// --- Print: hide non-document UI -------------------------------------------

@media print
	.progress-bar
		display: none
	.status-bar
		display: none
	.toc-sidebar
		display: none
	.scroll-top
		display: none
	.toast-stack
		display: none
	.toolbar
		display: none
	.tabbar
		display: none
	.search-bar
		display: none
	.rc-panel
		display: none

// =============================================================================
// 09_KNOWLEDGE-WORKSPACE — Notes workspace: toolbar, tab bar, library, editor,
// table of contents, status bar, scroll-to-top, progress, search overlay,
// toasts, frontmatter, link tooltips, image lightbox, marp presentation, etc.
// All classes the Notes workspace authors sit in this file. Components
// themselves own no <style> blocks.
// =============================================================================

@use 'sass:string'
@use 'sass:list'
@use 'sass:map'
@use '01_config' as *

$md: map.get($breakpoints, md)
$lg: map.get($breakpoints, lg)

// --- Inline progress bar at the top of the page ------------------------------
.progress-bar
	position: fixed
	top: 0
	left: 0
	height: 3px
	background: var(--theme-color)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	width: var(--progress, 0%)
	transition: width 0.1s linear
	pointer-events: none

// --- Status bar — fixed footer, blurs backdrop, hides on print --------------
.status-bar
	position: fixed
	bottom: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	.sep
		color: var(--border)

// --- Frontmatter bar — horizontal key/value strip above the article --------
.fm-bar
	display: flex
	flex-wrap: wrap
	gap: var(--space-xs) var(--space-md)
	max-width: min(100%, 720px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.fm-field
	display: flex
	align-items: baseline
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.fm-key
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)

.fm-value
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

// --- Scroll-to-top FAB -------------------------------------------------------
.scroll-top
	position: fixed
	bottom: var(--space-lg)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	width: 36px
	height: 36px
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	opacity: 0.7
	&:hover
		opacity: 1
		background: var(--state-hover)

// --- Toasts -----------------------------------------------------------------
.toast-stack
	position: fixed
	bottom: 96px
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-toast)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	align-items: flex-end

.toast
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	max-width: 360px
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	animation: slideUp var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)

.toast svg
	color: var(--danger)
	flex-shrink: 0

.toast-text
	line-height: 1.35

@keyframes slideUp
	from
		opacity: 0
		transform: translateY(10px)
	to
		opacity: 1
		transform: translateY(0)

// --- State center (loading + error UI inside page-main) ---------------------
.state-center
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--page-gutter)
	min-height: 60vh

.state-text
	color: var(--text-muted)
	&.pulse
		animation: pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite

@keyframes pulse
	0%, 100%
		opacity: 0.4
	50%
		opacity: 1

.error-box
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--danger)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	max-width: min(100%, 480px)

.error-msg
	color: var(--danger)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	margin: 0

// --- Drop zone — full-viewport dashed overlay when dragging a file ----------
.dropzone
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 8%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(2px)
	pointer-events: none

.dropzone-content
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-2xl)
	border: 2px dashed var(--theme-color)
	border-radius: var(--radius-lg)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)
	color: var(--theme-color)

.dropzone-text
	font-size: var(--text-md)
	font-weight: 500
	margin: 0

// --- Sidebar / Library (KnowledgeLibrary) -----------------------------------
.knowledge-library-actions
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs) var(--space-xs)

.knowledge-library-secondary-actions
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.knowledge-library-section
	padding: 0 var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm)

.knowledge-library-heading
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)

.knowledge-library-heading h2
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0

.knowledge-library-icon-action
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.knowledge-library-empty
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	margin: 0

.knowledge-library-list
	list-style: none
	margin: 0
	padding: 0

.knowledge-library-folder-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.knowledge-library-folder-button
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.knowledge-library-count
	margin-left: auto
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums

.knowledge-library-remove
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
	li:hover &
		opacity: 1

.knowledge-library-files
	list-style: none
	margin: 0
	padding: 0 0 0 var(--space-md)

.knowledge-library-file
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	text-align: left
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.knowledge-library-recent-row
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.knowledge-library-recent
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.knowledge-library-recent-copy
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	min-width: 0
	flex: 1
	gap: 2px
	small
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		color: var(--text-muted)

// --- Toolbar (top bar in the workspace) ------------------------------------
.toolbar
	position: sticky
	top: var(--header-height)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)

.toolbar-left
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	min-width: 0
	flex: 1

.toolbar-center
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	flex-shrink: 0

.toolbar-right
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	flex-shrink: 0

.current-heading
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	min-width: 0
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.mode-segmented
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 2px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)

.mode-seg
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: 100%
	padding: 0 var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.btn
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 0 var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: 1px solid transparent
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.btn-icon
	padding: 0
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		position: absolute
		top: 6px
		right: 6px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin: 0 var(--space-3xs)

// --- Dropdown menu (used for Copy menu and tab context menu) ----------------
.dropdown
	position: fixed
	width: 160px
	left: var(--dropdown-x, 0)
	top: var(--dropdown-y, 0)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-3xs)
	overflow: hidden

.dropdown-item
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.dropdown-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)

// --- Tab bar ----------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	position: sticky
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg))
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs) 0
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tabbar-inner
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	gap: 2px
	min-width: 100%

.tabbar-files
	display: flex
	align-items: flex-end
	gap: 2px
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
	&.active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		box-shadow: 0 -1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over
		border-left: 2px solid var(--theme-color)

.tab.home-tab
	min-width: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	flex-shrink: 0
	svg
		flex-shrink: 0

.tab-label
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	flex: 1
	text-align: left

.tab-dirty
	color: var(--theme-color)
	font-weight: 700
	margin-right: var(--space-3xs)

.tab-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 22px
	height: 22px
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	flex-shrink: 0
	cursor: pointer
	background: transparent
	border: none
	.tab:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.new-tab-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	margin-left: 2px
	margin-bottom: 2px
	background: none
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	flex-shrink: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
		color: var(--theme-color)

// --- TOC (table of contents) sidebar ----------------------------------------
.toc-sidebar
	position: fixed
	left: 0
	top: 80px
	bottom: 0
	width: 240px
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)
	box-shadow: 2px 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 4%, transparent)
	overflow-y: auto
	z-index: var(--z-base)

.toc-header
	padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--text-muted)
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em

.toc-nav
	padding: 0 var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column

.toc-item
	display: block
	width: 100%
	text-align: left
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-xs) + var(--toc-indent, 0px))
	padding-right: var(--space-xs)
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-left: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: pointer
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	line-height: 1.6
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-width: 3px
		font-weight: 500
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)
		border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0

// --- Content main area: raw source + viewer with TOC spacing ---------------
.content-main
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--page-gutter) var(--space-2xl)
	transition: padding-inline var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.toc-spaced
		padding-left: calc(240px + var(--space-md))

.raw-source
	display: block
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	white-space: pre-wrap
	overflow-x: auto
	font-size: var(--raw-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--raw-line-height, 1.6)
	max-width: var(--raw-max-width, none)

// --- Knowledge edit layout (full or split) ---------------------------------
.knowledge-edit-layout
	position: fixed
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px)
	left: 0
	right: 0
	bottom: 0
	display: flex
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	background: var(--bg)
	&.split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.split-preview
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	overflow-y: auto

// --- Editor -----------------------------------------------------------------
.editor-wrap
	position: fixed
	inset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px) 0 0 0
	display: flex
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	&.split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.editor-stack
	position: relative
	flex: 1
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	max-width: var(--editor-max-width, 100%)

.editor,
.editor-backdrop,
.editor-gutter
	position: absolute
	inset: 0
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-md)
	border: none
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	tab-size: 2
	-moz-tab-size: 2
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-wrap: break-word
	overflow-wrap: break-word
	box-sizing: border-box
	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)

.editor
	background: transparent
	outline: none
	resize: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	z-index: 1
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-backdrop
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	z-index: 0

.editor.with-gutter,
.editor-backdrop.with-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))

.editor-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	overflow: hidden
	z-index: 0
	counter-reset: gl
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)
	.gl
		counter-increment: gl
		position: relative
	&__line::before
		content: counter(gl)
		position: absolute
		left: calc(-1 * var(--gutter-w))
		width: calc(var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-2xs))
		text-align: right
		color: var(--text-muted)
	.gl.active
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 3%, transparent)
	.gl.active::before
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		font-weight: 500

.editor-stack.with-gutter::before
	content: ""
	position: absolute
	left: 0
	top: 0
	bottom: 0
	width: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-3xs))
	border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 1%, transparent)
	z-index: 0
	pointer-events: none

// Highlight layer — only the <mark> backgrounds should be visible
.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-highlight
	color: transparent
	background-color: var(--warning)
	border-radius: 2px

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-active
	color: transparent !important
	background-color: var(--danger) !important

// --- Search overlay ---------------------------------------------------------
.search-bar
	position: fixed
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	right: var(--space-xs)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)

.search-icon
	color: var(--text-muted)
	flex-shrink: 0

.search-input
	width: 200px
	padding: 2px 0
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	outline: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.search-count
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	min-width: 32px
	text-align: center
	flex-shrink: 0

.search-nav
	display: flex
	gap: 1px

.search-nav-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 24px
	height: 24px
	border: none
	background: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.3
		cursor: default

.search-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 24px
	height: 24px
	border: none
	background: none
	color: var(--text-muted)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

// --- Highlight styles (view mode) ------------------------------------------
mark.mdv-search-highlight
	background-color: var(--warning)
	color: inherit
	padding: 1px 0
	border-radius: 2px

mark.mdv-search-active
	background-color: var(--danger) !important
	color: var(--text-inverse) !important

// --- Link tooltip -----------------------------------------------------------
.link-tooltip
	display: none
	position: fixed
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	max-width: 400px
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	pointer-events: none

// --- Image lightbox ---------------------------------------------------------
.lightbox
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(4px)

.lb-image
	max-width: 90vw
	max-height: 90vh
	object-fit: contain
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	user-select: none

.lb-close,
.lb-nav
	position: absolute
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 10%, transparent)
	color: #fff
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 20%, transparent)

.lb-close
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: 40px
	height: 40px

.lb-nav
	top: 50%
	transform: translateY(-50%)
	width: 44px
	height: 44px

.lb-prev
	left: var(--space-sm)

.lb-next
	right: var(--space-sm)

.lb-counter
	position: absolute
	bottom: var(--space-sm)
	left: 50%
	transform: translateX(-50%)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums

// --- Empty state (home / recents / pinned folders / plans) -----------------
.empty-root
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	max-width: 1040px
	margin: 0 auto
	min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height) - var(--space-md))
	gap: var(--space-sm)
	zoom: var(--zoom, 1)

.hero-bar
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	padding: var(--space-3xs) 0 var(--space-2xs)

.hero-logo
	flex-shrink: 0
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)

.hero-text
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: 2px

.hero-title
	font-size: var(--text-lg)
	font-weight: 700
	letter-spacing: -0.01em
	color: var(--text-primary)
	margin: 0

.hero-desc
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0

.quick-actions
	display: flex
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	flex-wrap: wrap

.qa-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		border-color: var(--state-selected)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.qa-primary
		background: var(--theme-color)
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
		color: var(--text-inverse)
		&:hover
			background: var(--theme-color-alt)
			border-color: var(--theme-color-alt)

.section
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.section-header
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: 0 var(--space-3xs)

.section-title
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	color: var(--text-muted)
	margin: 0
	flex: 1

.section-count
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	padding: 1px var(--space-2xs)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.section-action
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: none
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	padding: 0
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)

.section-close
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: none
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.section-action.unpin
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	.section-header:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)

.card
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	overflow: hidden

.card-scroll
	overflow-y: auto

.uniform-card
	height: 300px

.recents-grid
	display: grid
	grid-template-columns: 1fr
	&.two-col
		grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr
		.item:nth-child(even)
			border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

@media #{string.unquote('(max-width: 720px)')}
	.recents-grid.two-col
		grid-template-columns: 1fr
		.item:nth-child(even)
			border-left: none

.card-empty
	padding: var(--space-sm)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	text-align: center

.item
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-xs)
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: none
	border: none
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:last-of-type
		border-bottom: none
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.item-icon
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-lg)
	height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--theme-color)
	flex-shrink: 0
	&.plan
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 12%, transparent)
		color: var(--success)

.item-info
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: 1px

.item-name
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-primary)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.item-path
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap

.item-time
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	white-space: nowrap
	flex-shrink: 0

.panels-grid
	display: grid
	grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))
	gap: var(--space-sm)

@media #{string.unquote('(max-width: 720px)')}
	.panels-grid
		grid-template-columns: 1fr

.footer-row
	margin-top: auto
	padding-top: var(--space-xs)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: space-between
	flex-wrap: wrap
	gap: var(--space-2xs)

.footer-hint
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	.kbd
		display: inline-block
		padding: 1px var(--space-3xs)
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		background: var(--bg-raised)
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		border-radius: var(--radius-sm)

.footer-link
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--theme-color)
	background: none
	border: none
	padding: 0
	cursor: pointer
	text-decoration: underline
	&:hover
		text-decoration: none

.zoom-controls
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.zoom-btn
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.zoom-label
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	min-width: 28px
	text-align: center
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums

// --- Marp presentation ------------------------------------------------------
.present-root
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-md)
	background: #0e0e10

.present-stage
	position: relative
	width: min(100%, calc((100vh - 96px) * 16 / 9))
	aspect-ratio: 16 / 9
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: 0 8px 40px color-mix(in srgb, #000 50%, transparent)
	overflow: hidden
	display: flex

.present-slide
	flex: 1
	overflow-y: auto
	padding: 6% 8%
	:global(.md-content)
		max-width: none !important
		margin: 0 !important
		padding: 0 !important

.present-counter
	position: absolute
	right: var(--space-xs)
	bottom: var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
	color: var(--text-muted)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 4%, transparent)
	padding: 2px var(--space-2xs)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	pointer-events: none

.present-nav-edge
	flex-shrink: 0
	width: 44px
	height: 44px
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	background: transparent
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.25
		cursor: default

.present-close
	position: absolute
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: var(--control-h-lg)
	height: var(--control-h-lg)
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	background: transparent
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)

// --- Reader controls popover ------------------------------------------------
.rc-panel
	position: fixed
	right: var(--space-xs)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	width: 240px
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-xs)

.rc-arrow
	position: absolute
	top: -5px
	right: 60px
	width: 10px
	height: 10px
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border-left: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border)
	transform: rotate(45deg)

.rc-title
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--text-muted)
	text-transform: uppercase
	letter-spacing: 0.06em
	margin: 0 0 var(--space-xs)

.rc-group
	margin-bottom: var(--space-xs)
	&.disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		.rc-range
			cursor: not-allowed

.rc-label
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.rc-label-row
	display: flex
	justify-content: space-between
	align-items: center
	margin-bottom: var(--space-3xs)

.rc-value
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	color: var(--text-muted)

.rc-segmented
	display: flex
	gap: 1px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	overflow: hidden
	margin-top: var(--space-3xs)

.rc-seg-btn
	flex: 1
	padding: var(--space-3xs) 0
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
	&.active
		background: var(--theme-color)
		color: var(--text-inverse)

.rc-range
	width: 100%
	height: 4px
	-webkit-appearance: none
	appearance: none
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	outline: none
	&::-webkit-slider-thumb
		-webkit-appearance: none
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg-popover)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)
	&::-moz-range-thumb
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg-popover)


.copy-feedback
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-primary)

.rc-group-last
	margin-bottom: 0

// --- Print: hide non-document UI -------------------------------------------

@media print
	.progress-bar
		display: none
	.status-bar
		display: none
	.toc-sidebar
		display: none
	.scroll-top
		display: none
	.toast-stack
		display: none
	.toolbar
		display: none
	.tabbar
		display: none
	.search-bar
		display: none
	.rc-panel
		display: none

155: 	function restoreProgress(filePath: string) {

167: 					return;

170: 				const elements = Array.from(
171: 					article.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-source-line]"),

173: 				if (elements.length === 0) {
174: 					isRestoring = false;

176: 				}

178: 				// Find the saved line if it still exists, else fall back to the last

208: 				};

155: 	function restoreProgress(filePath: string) {

160: 		clearTimeout(restoreTimer);
161: 
162: 		tick().then(() => {
163: 			requestAnimationFrame(() => {
164: 				const article = document.querySelector("article.md-content");
165: 				if (!article) {
166: 					isRestoring = false;
167: 					return;
168: 				}
169: 
170: 				const elements = Array.from(
171: 					article.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-source-line]"),
172: 				);
173: 				if (elements.length === 0) {
174: 					isRestoring = false;
175: 					return;
176: 				}

178: 				// Find the saved line if it still exists, else fall back to the last
179: 				// element (handles file-shrunk case where saved line no longer exists)
180: 				let target: HTMLElement | null = null;

183: 						el.getAttribute("data-source-line") || "0",
184: 						10,
185: 					);
186: 					if (elLine >= savedLine) {
187: 						target = el;

189: 					}

193: 				// Tiny-file edge case: don't restore if document fits in viewport
194: 				const docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;

198: 				}

205: 					clearTimeout(restoreTimer);

208: 				};

704: 	// the key is held and stop it on keyup. This matches the native, continuous feel
705: 	// of arrow-key/trackpad scrolling. The half-page (d/u) and gg/G jumps stay smooth.
706: 	//
707: 	// Velocity is time-based (px/sec, scaled by the frame delta) rather than a fixed
708: 	// px-per-frame step, so the speed stays consistent regardless of display refresh
709: 	// rate (60Hz vs 120Hz ProMotion) and roughly matches native arrow-key scrolling.
710: 	const SCROLL_SPEED = 1000; // px per second
711: 	let scrollRAF: number | null = null;
712: 	let scrollDir = 0; // -1 = up, +1 = down, 0 = stopped
713: 	let scrollLastTs = 0;
714: 	const pressedScrollKeys = new Set<"j" | "k">();
715: 	let activeScrollKey: "j" | "k" | null = null;
716: 
717: 	function updateScrollDirection() {
718: 		scrollDir =
719: 			activeScrollKey === "j" ? 1 : activeScrollKey === "k" ? -1 : 0;
720: 	}
721: 
722: 	function startScroll(key: "j" | "k") {
723: 		pressedScrollKeys.add(key);
724: 		activeScrollKey = key;
725: 		updateScrollDirection();
726: 		if (scrollRAF !== null) return;
727: 		scrollLastTs = 0;
728: 		const step = (ts: number) => {
729: 			if (scrollDir === 0) {
730: 				scrollRAF = null;
731: 				return;
732: 			}
733: 			// First frame establishes the baseline timestamp; no movement yet.
734: 			const dt = scrollLastTs === 0 ? 0 : ts - scrollLastTs;
735: 			scrollLastTs = ts;
736: 			window.scrollBy(0, scrollDir * SCROLL_SPEED * (dt / 1000));
737: 			scrollRAF = requestAnimationFrame(step);
738: 		};
739: 		scrollRAF = requestAnimationFrame(step);
740: 	}
741: 
742: 	function stopScroll() {
743: 		pressedScrollKeys.clear();
744: 		activeScrollKey = null;
745: 		scrollDir = 0;
746: 		scrollLastTs = 0;
747: 		if (scrollRAF !== null) {
748: 			cancelAnimationFrame(scrollRAF);
749: 			scrollRAF = null;
750: 		}
751: 	}
752: 
753: 	function releaseScrollKey(key: "j" | "k") {
754: 		pressedScrollKeys.delete(key);
755: 		if (activeScrollKey !== key) return;
756: 
757: 		if (pressedScrollKeys.has("j")) {
758: 			activeScrollKey = "j";
759: 		} else if (pressedScrollKeys.has("k")) {
760: 			activeScrollKey = "k";
761: 		} else {
762: 			activeScrollKey = null;
763: 		}
764: 
765: 		updateScrollDirection();
766: 		if (scrollDir === 0) stopScroll();
767: 	}
768: 
769: 	function isInputFocused(): boolean {
770: 		const el = document.activeElement;
771: 		if (!el) return false;
772: 		const tag = el.tagName;
773: 		return (
774: 			tag === "INPUT" ||
775: 			tag === "TEXTAREA" ||
776: 			(el as HTMLElement).isContentEditable
777: 		);
778: 	}

780: 	function jumpToHeading(direction: "prev" | "next") {
781: 		const headings = document.querySelectorAll(
782: 			"article h1[id], article h2[id], article h3[id], article h4[id], article h5[id], article h6[id]",
783: 		);
784: 		if (headings.length === 0) return;
785: 		const offset = 80;
786: 		const scrollY = window.scrollY + offset;
787: 
788: 		if (direction === "next") {
789: 			for (const h of headings) {
790: 				const top = (h as HTMLElement).offsetTop;
791: 				if (top > scrollY + 5) {
792: 					window.scrollTo({ top: top - offset, behavior: "smooth" });
793: 					return;
794: 				}
795: 			}
796: 		} else {
797: 			const arr = Array.from(headings).reverse();
798: 			for (const h of arr) {
799: 				const top = (h as HTMLElement).offsetTop;
800: 				if (top < scrollY - 5) {
801: 					window.scrollTo({ top: top - offset, behavior: "smooth" });
802: 					return;
803: 				}
804: 			}
805: 		}
806: 	}

808: 	// Move the active tab by `delta` positions through the visible tab order
809: 	// ([Home, ...file tabs]), wrapping around at both ends.
810: 	function cycleTab(delta: number) {
811: 		const order = [HOME_TAB_ID, ...$tabs.map((t) => t.id)];
812: 		if (order.length <= 1) return;
813: 		const current = order.indexOf($activeTabId ?? HOME_TAB_ID);
814: 		const base = current === -1 ? 0 : current;
815: 		const next = (base + delta + order.length) % order.length;
816: 		const nextId = order[next];
817: 		if (nextId === HOME_TAB_ID) {
818: 			tabStore.goHome();
819: 		} else {
820: 			tabStore.switchTab(nextId);
821: 		}
822: 	}

824: 	function handleKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {

827: 			e.preventDefault();
828: 			const idx = parseInt(e.key) - 1;
829: 			if ($tabs[idx]) {
830: 				tabStore.switchTab($tabs[idx].id);
831: 			}
832: 			return;
833: 		}
834: 
835: 		// macOS: Cmd+Shift+[ / Cmd+Shift+] cycle tabs (standard macOS convention).
836: 		// Use e.code because Shift turns "["/"]" into "{"/"}" in e.key.
837: 		if (
838: 			e.metaKey &&
839: 			e.shiftKey &&
840: 			(e.code === "BracketLeft" || e.code === "BracketRight")
841: 		) {
842: 			e.preventDefault();
843: 			cycleTab(e.code === "BracketRight" ? 1 : -1);
844: 			return;
845: 		}
846: 
847: 		// Windows/Linux: Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab (browser convention),
848: 		// and Ctrl+PageDown / Ctrl+PageUp (VS Code convention, also in Chrome).
849: 		if (
850: 			e.ctrlKey &&
851: 			(e.key === "Tab" || e.code === "PageUp" || e.code === "PageDown")
852: 		) {
853: 			e.preventDefault();
854: 			const forward =
855: 				e.key === "Tab" ? !e.shiftKey : e.code === "PageDown";
856: 			cycleTab(forward ? 1 : -1);
857: 			return;
858: 		}
859: 
860: 		// Cmd+Plus / Cmd+= zoom in (works on both macOS and Windows)
861: 		if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && (e.key === "=" || e.key === "+")) {
862: 			e.preventDefault();

864: 				...s,

868: 		}
869: 
870: 		// Cmd+Minus zoom out

872: 			e.preventDefault();
873: 			settings.update((s) => ({
874: 				...s,
875: 				fontSize: Math.max(s.fontSize - 1, 10),
876: 			}));
877: 			return;
878: 		}
879: 
880: 		// Cmd+0 reset zoom

882: 			e.preventDefault();
883: 			settings.update((s) => ({ ...s, fontSize: 17 }));
884: 			return;
885: 		}
886: 
887: 		// Cmd+E toggle edit mode
888: 		if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && !e.shiftKey && e.key === "e") {
889: 			e.preventDefault();
890: 			handleEditToggle();
891: 			return;
892: 		}
893: 
894: 		// Cmd+S save (works whenever the active tab has unsaved changes,
895: 		// even from reader mode after toggling out of edit)

897: 			e.preventDefault();
898: 			if (activeTab?.dirty) {

900: 			}
901: 			return;
902: 		}
903: 
904: 		// Cmd+U raw toggle (disabled in edit mode)

906: 			e.preventDefault();
907: 			handleRawToggle();
908: 			return;
909: 		}
910: 
911: 		// Cmd+T new document (blank tab, opens in the editor — #63)
912: 		if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === "t") {
913: 			e.preventDefault();
914: 			newDocument();
915: 			return;
916: 		}
917: 
918: 		// Cmd+, open settings (macOS Preferences convention)
919: 		if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === ",") {
920: 			e.preventDefault();
921: 			settingsVisible = !settingsVisible;
922: 			return;
923: 		}
924: 
925: 		// Cmd+W close tab (with dirty confirm)
926: 		if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === "w") {
927: 			e.preventDefault();
928: 			const t = tabStore.getActiveTab();
929: 			if (!t) return;
930: 			void handleCloseTab(t.id);
931: 			return;
932: 		}
933: 		if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.shiftKey && e.key === "f") {
934: 			e.preventDefault();
935: 			zenMode = !zenMode;
936: 			return;
937: 		}
938: 
939: 		// Escape — close panels, then optionally close-tab-on-ESC

943: 				return;
944: 			}
945: 
946: 			// Exit the Marp slideshow before any modal/close-tab handling (#44).
947: 			if (presenting) {
948: 				presenting = false;
949: 				return;
950: 			}
951: 
952: 			// Modals/overlays consume ESC first. Inner handlers stopPropagation when focus
953: 			// is inside them; this guard covers the focus-outside case (modal visible but
954: 			// user clicked elsewhere) so we don't nuke the tab while a modal is still up.
955: 			// Add new modals to `anyModalVisible` (see top of script) to keep this safe.
956: 			if (anyModalVisible) return;
957: 
958: 			// Close-on-ESC: opt-in setting. Ignore in edit mode and when an input is focused
959: 			// (so users typing in search/paste/etc. don't accidentally trigger it).
960: 			if (
961: 				$settings.closeOnEscape &&
962: 				!activeTab?.isEditing &&

966: 				// quit-on-last-tab decision runs in an async helper.

970: 		}
971: 
972: 		// Vim-style keys — only when no input is focused and not in edit mode
973: 		if (isInputFocused() || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
974: 		if (activeTab?.isEditing) return;
975: 		if (!$docStore.renderedHtml) return;
976: 
977: 		const now = Date.now();
978: 
979: 		switch (e.key) {
980: 			case "j":
981: 				e.preventDefault();
982: 				// Ignore OS key-repeat — the rAF loop drives continuous motion until keyup.
983: 				if (e.repeat) break;
984: 				startScroll("j");
985: 				break;
986: 			case "k":
987: 				e.preventDefault();
988: 				if (e.repeat) break;
989: 				startScroll("k");
990: 				break;
991: 			case "d":
992: 				// half page down
993: 				e.preventDefault();
994: 				window.scrollBy({
995: 					top: window.innerHeight / 2,
996: 					behavior: "smooth",
997: 				});
998: 				break;
999: 			case "u":
1000: 				// half page up
1001: 				e.preventDefault();
1002: 				window.scrollBy({
1003: 					top: -window.innerHeight / 2,
1004: 					behavior: "smooth",
1005: 				});
1006: 				break;
1007: 			case "G":
1008: 				// Shift+G — go to bottom
1009: 				e.preventDefault();
1010: 				window.scrollTo({
1011: 					top: document.body.scrollHeight,
1012: 					behavior: "smooth",
1013: 				});
1014: 				break;
1015: 			case "g":
1016: 				// gg — go to top (double tap g within 500ms)
1017: 				if (lastKey === "g" && now - lastKeyTime < 500) {
1018: 					e.preventDefault();
1019: 					window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
1020: 					lastKey = "";
1021: 					return;
1022: 				}
1023: 				break;
1024: 			case "/":
1025: 				e.preventDefault();
1026: 				searchVisible = true;
1027: 				break;
1028: 			case "n":
1029: 				// next search match (handled by SearchOverlay if visible)
1030: 				break;
1031: 			case "]":
1032: 				e.preventDefault();
1033: 				jumpToHeading("next");
1034: 				break;
1035: 			case "[":
1036: 				e.preventDefault();
1037: 				jumpToHeading("prev");
1038: 				break;
1039: 		}
1040: 
1041: 		lastKey = e.key;
1042: 		lastKeyTime = now;
1043: 	}

1045: 	function handleKeyup(e: KeyboardEvent) {
1046: 		// Stop the continuous j/k scroll loop when the key is released.
1047: 		if (e.key === "j" || e.key === "k") releaseScrollKey(e.key);
1048: 	}
