// =============================================================================
// 08_OWN — project-specific atoms + compositions for the Knowledge workspace.
// 
// Fractalstyler2 ships the full fractal registry (tokens, dimensions, containers,
// layouts, shells, visuals, interactions). Everything outside that contract that
// the Knowledge workspace needs lives here, broken into the smallest atomic units
// and composed via tokens. No literal hex values, no foreign CSS variables.
// =============================================================================

@use '01_config' as *

// --- App chrome bits -------------------------------------------------------
.logomotif
	height: 28px
	width: 28px
	filter: saturate(0)

.logotype
	height: 16px
	filter: saturate(0)

.header-nav
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-decoration: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	&:hover
		color: var(--theme-color)

// --- Knowledge Workspace — top toolbar ------------------------------------
// The toolbar is a sticky row that lives below the app-header. We use the
// registry primitives (sticky, row, surface-blur, border-bottom) for the base
// and add a single composition rule for the mode-segmented control.
.surface-blur
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

.toolbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	top: var(--header-height)

.mode-segmented
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 2px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)

.mode-seg
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: 100%
	padding-inline: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.tool-active
	background: var(--state-hover)
	color: var(--text-primary)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.save-dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		top: 4px
		right: 4px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	display: inline-block
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin-inline: var(--space-3xs)
	align-self: center

.current-heading
	max-width: 360px

// --- Knowledge Library (left sidebar) -------------------------------------
.sidebar-left
	width: var(--sidebar-width)
	flex-shrink: 0
	padding-top: var(--space-2xs)

.library-icon-btn
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.library-row-btn
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.library-row-remove
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
	li:hover > div > &
		opacity: 1

.library-file-btn
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

// --- Tab bar ---------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
	&.tab-active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		box-shadow: 0 -1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over
		border-left: 2px solid var(--theme-color)

.tab-home
	min-width: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	flex-shrink: 0

.tab-close
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	.tab:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.new-tab-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	margin-bottom: 2px
	flex-shrink: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
		color: var(--theme-color)

// --- Dropdown (used by Toolbar Copy menu and Tab context menu) -------------
.dropdown
	position: fixed
	width: 160px
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-3xs)
	left: var(--dropdown-x, 0)
	top: var(--dropdown-y, 0)
	overflow: hidden

.popover-shadow
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)

.dropdown-item
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

// --- Search overlay --------------------------------------------------------
.search-bar
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	right: var(--space-xs)

.search-input
	width: 220px
	padding: 2px 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	outline: none
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)
	&:focus-visible
		outline: none

.search-nav-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.search-close
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

// --- Table of contents -----------------------------------------------------
.toc-sidebar
	left: 0
	top: 80px
	bottom: 0
	width: 240px

.toc-item
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-xs) + var(--toc-indent, 0px))
	padding-right: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-left: 2px solid transparent
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	line-height: 1.5
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.toc-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-width: 3px
		font-weight: 500
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)

// --- Content / reader area -------------------------------------------------
.content-main
	padding-block: var(--space-md)
	transition: padding-inline var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.toc-spaced
		padding-left: calc(240px + var(--space-md))

.raw-source
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	white-space: pre-wrap
	overflow-x: auto
	font-size: var(--raw-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--raw-line-height, 1.6)
	max-width: var(--raw-max-width, none)

// --- Editor ----------------------------------------------------------------
.edit-full, .edit-split
	position: fixed
	inset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px) 0 0 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	background: var(--bg)

.edit-split
	right: 50%
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.split-preview
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	overflow-y: auto

.editor-wrap
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px)
	bottom: 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	&.editor-split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.editor-stack
	max-width: var(--editor-max-width, 100%)

.editor,
.editor-backdrop,
.editor-gutter
	position: absolute
	inset: 0
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-md)
	border: none
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	tab-size: 2
	-moz-tab-size: 2
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-wrap: break-word
	overflow-wrap: break-word
	box-sizing: border-box
	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)

.editor
	background: transparent
	outline: none
	resize: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	z-index: 1
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-backdrop
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	z-index: 0

.editor.with-gutter,
.editor-backdrop.with-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))

.editor-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	overflow: hidden
	z-index: 0
	counter-reset: gl
	.gl
		counter-increment: gl
		position: relative
	.gl.active
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 3%, transparent)
	.gl.active::before
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		font-weight: 500
	.gl::before
		content: counter(gl)
		position: absolute
		left: calc(-1 * var(--gutter-w))
		width: calc(var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-2xs))
		text-align: right
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-stack.with-gutter::before
	content: ""
	position: absolute
	left: 0
	top: 0
	bottom: 0
	width: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-3xs))
	border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 1%, transparent)
	z-index: 0
	pointer-events: none

// --- Editor search highlights ---------------------------------------------
.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-highlight
	color: transparent
	background-color: var(--warning)
	border-radius: 2px

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-active
	color: transparent !important
	background-color: var(--danger) !important

// --- EmptyState -------------------------------------------------------------
.empty-root
	max-width: 1040px
	margin: 0 auto
	min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height) - var(--space-md))

.empty-hero
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)

.empty-hero-icon
	flex-shrink: 0

.panels-grid
	grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))

.empty-item
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	&:last-of-type
		border-bottom: none
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.empty-item-icon
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 28px
	height: 28px
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--theme-color)

.empty-footer
	margin-top: auto

// --- Dialog shells ---------------------------------------------------------
.dialog-backdrop
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 25%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(3px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px)

.dialog-card
	overflow: hidden

.dialog-header
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.dialog-footer
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	background: transparent

.dialog-body
	overflow-y: auto

// --- Settings dialog specifics --------------------------------------------
.settings-section
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	&:last-of-type
		border-bottom: none

.settings-row
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.settings-row-text
	min-width: 0

.settings-switch
	width: 18px
	height: 18px
	accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	cursor: pointer

// --- Custom prompt modal ---------------------------------------------------
.field-label
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.selection-box
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	max-height: 120px
	overflow-y: auto
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-break: break-word

.prompt-input
	resize: vertical
	line-height: 1.45

.field-error-row
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent)

// --- Paste modal -----------------------------------------------------------
.mode-tabs
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)

.mode-tab
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-tab-active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)

.modal-textarea
	min-height: 200px
	resize: none

.url-hints
	border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	code
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		padding: 1px 4px
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	ul
		line-height: 1.5

// --- Open dialog -----------------------------------------------------------
.dialog-tab
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-bottom: 2px solid transparent
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.dialog-tab-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-bottom-color: var(--theme-color)

.file-item
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.file-item-nested
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-sm) + var(--space-md))

.folder-header
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.folder-chevron
	transition: transform var(--motion-fast) ease
	&.folder-chevron-open
		transform: rotate(90deg)

// --- Image lightbox --------------------------------------------------------
.lightbox
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(4px)

.lb-image
	max-width: 90vw
	max-height: 90vh
	object-fit: contain
	user-select: none

.lb-close
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: 40px
	height: 40px
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 10%, transparent)
	color: #fff
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 20%, transparent)

.lb-nav
	top: 50%
	transform: translateY(-50%)
	width: 44px
	height: 44px
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 10%, transparent)
	color: #fff
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 20%, transparent)
	&.lb-next
		right: var(--space-sm)
	&:not(.lb-next)
		left: var(--space-sm)

.lb-counter
	bottom: var(--space-sm)
	left: 50%
	transform: translateX(-50%)
	color: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent)

// --- Progress bar ----------------------------------------------------------
.progress-bar
	position: fixed
	top: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	height: 3px
	background: var(--theme-color)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	width: var(--progress, 0%)
	transition: width 0.1s linear
	pointer-events: none

// --- Status bar ------------------------------------------------------------
.status-bar
	position: fixed
	bottom: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

// --- Frontmatter -----------------------------------------------------------
.fm-bar
	max-width: min(100%, 720px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	gap: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)

// --- Toast stack -----------------------------------------------------------
.toast-stack
	position: fixed
	bottom: 96px
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-toast)
	max-width: 360px

.toast
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	animation: slideUp var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)

@keyframes slideUp
	from
		opacity: 0
		transform: translateY(8px)
	to
		opacity: 1
		transform: translateY(0)

// --- Scroll-to-top FAB -----------------------------------------------------
.scroll-top
	position: fixed
	bottom: var(--space-lg)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	width: 36px
	height: 36px
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	opacity: 0.7
	&:hover
		opacity: 1
		background: var(--state-hover)

// --- Drop zone -------------------------------------------------------------
.dropzone
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 8%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(2px)
	pointer-events: none

.border-theme
	border-color: var(--theme-color)
	border-style: dashed

// --- Presentation / Marp ---------------------------------------------------
.present-root
	background: #0e0e10

.present-close
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: var(--control-h-lg)
	height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)

.present-nav
	width: 44px
	height: 44px
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.25

.present-stage
	width: min(100%, calc((100vh - 96px) * 16 / 9))

.present-slide
	padding: 6% 8%
	:global(.md-content)
		max-width: none !important
		margin: 0 !important
		padding: 0 !important

.present-counter
	right: var(--space-xs)
	bottom: var(--space-xs)
	padding: 2px var(--space-2xs)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 4%, transparent)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)

// --- Reader controls popover ----------------------------------------------
.rc-panel
	right: var(--space-xs)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	width: 240px

.rc-segmented
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	overflow: hidden

.rc-seg-btn
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
	&.rc-seg-active
		background: var(--theme-color)
		color: var(--text-inverse)

.rc-range
	height: 4px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	-webkit-appearance: none
	appearance: none
	outline: none
	&::-webkit-slider-thumb
		-webkit-appearance: none
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg-popover)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)
	&::-moz-range-thumb
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: var(--radius-full)
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg-popover)

// --- Markdown content (rendered article) ---------------------------------
.md-content
	color: var(--text-primary)
	max-width: var(--content-max, 760px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding-block: var(--space-md)
	padding-inline: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--md-font-family, inherit)
	font-size: inherit
	transition: max-width var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out), font-size var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out), font-family var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	line-height: 1.65
	> * + *
		margin-top: var(--space-sm)
	h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6
		line-height: 1.25
		font-weight: 600
		color: var(--text-primary)
		letter-spacing: -0.01em
		margin-top: var(--space-md)
		&:first-child
			margin-top: 0
	h1
		font-size: 1.85em
		font-weight: 700
		letter-spacing: -0.02em
		margin-top: 1.5em
	h2
		font-size: 1.5em
		margin-top: 1.25em
	h3
		font-size: 1.2em
		margin-top: 1.1em
	h4
		font-size: 1em
	p, ul, ol, blockquote
		margin-block: var(--space-sm)
	pre
		border-radius: var(--radius-md)
		padding: 1em 1.2em
		overflow-x: auto
		font-size: 0.8em
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle) !important
		color: var(--text-primary) !important
		position: relative
	code
		font-family: var(--font-mono)
	:not(pre) > code
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		padding: 0.15em 0.4em
		border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
		font-size: 0.85em
		color: var(--theme-color-alt)
		&::before, &::after
			content: none
	table
		border-collapse: collapse
		width: 100%
		overflow-x: auto
		display: block
		font-size: 0.9em
	th, td
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		padding: 0.5em 0.75em
		text-align: left
	th
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		font-weight: 600
		font-size: 0.9em
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	blockquote
		border-left: 3px solid var(--theme-color)
		padding-left: 1em
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	img
		max-width: 100%
		height: auto
		border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	hr
		border: none
		border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
		margin: 2.5em 0
	.task-list-item
		list-style: none
		margin-left: -1.5em
		input[type='checkbox']
			margin-right: var(--space-2xs)
			accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	a
		color: var(--theme-color)
		text-decoration: none
		&:hover
			text-decoration: underline
	.code-copy-btn
		position: absolute
		top: 8px
		right: 8px
		padding: 3px 10px
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		font-weight: 500
		font-family: var(--font-sans)
		color: var(--text-muted)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 80%, transparent)
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
		cursor: pointer
		opacity: 0
		transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
		z-index: 2
		backdrop-filter: blur(4px)
		&:hover
			background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 95%, transparent)
			color: var(--text-primary)
	pre:hover .code-copy-btn
		opacity: 1
	.mermaid-diagram
		overflow-x: auto
		svg
			max-width: 100%
			height: auto
	.katex-display
		overflow-x: auto
		padding: 0.5em 0
	.katex
		font-size: 1.1em

// --- Search highlight in viewer -------------------------------------------
mark.mdv-search-highlight
	background-color: var(--warning)
	color: inherit
	padding: 1px 0
	border-radius: 2px

mark.mdv-search-active
	background-color: var(--danger) !important
	color: var(--text-inverse) !important

// --- Link tooltip ----------------------------------------------------------
.link-tooltip
	display: none
	position: fixed
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	max-width: 400px
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	pointer-events: none

// --- Print ----------------------------------------------------------------
@media print
	.toolbar, .tabbar, .search-bar, .rc-panel,
	.toast-stack, .status-bar, .toc-sidebar, .scroll-top,
	.dialog-backdrop, .modal-backdrop, .dropzone, .lightbox
		display: none !important

// =============================================================================
// 08_OWN — project-specific atoms + compositions for the Knowledge workspace.
// 
// Fractalstyler2 ships the full fractal registry (tokens, dimensions, containers,
// layouts, shells, visuals, interactions). Everything outside that contract that
// the Knowledge workspace needs lives here, broken into the smallest atomic units
// and composed via tokens. No literal hex values, no foreign CSS variables.
// =============================================================================

@use '01_config' as *

// --- App chrome bits -------------------------------------------------------
.logomotif
	height: 28px
	width: 28px
	filter: saturate(0)

.logotype
	height: 16px
	filter: saturate(0)

.header-nav
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-decoration: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	&:hover
		color: var(--theme-color)

// --- Knowledge Workspace — top toolbar ------------------------------------
// The toolbar is a sticky row that lives below the app-header. We use the
// registry primitives (sticky, row, surface-blur, border-bottom) for the base
// and add a single composition rule for the mode-segmented control.
.surface-blur
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

.toolbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	top: var(--header-height)

.mode-segmented
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 2px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)

.mode-seg
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: 100%
	padding-inline: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.tool-active
	background: var(--state-hover)
	color: var(--text-primary)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.save-dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		top: 4px
		right: 4px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	display: inline-block
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin-inline: var(--space-3xs)
	align-self: center

.current-heading
	max-width: 360px

// --- Knowledge Library (left sidebar) -------------------------------------
.sidebar-left
	width: var(--sidebar-width)
	flex-shrink: 0
	padding-top: var(--space-2xs)

.library-icon-btn
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.library-row-btn
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.library-row-remove
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
	li:hover > div > &
		opacity: 1

.library-file-btn
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

// --- Tab bar ---------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
	&.tab-active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		box-shadow: 0 -1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over
		border-left: 2px solid var(--theme-color)

.tab-home
	min-width: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	flex-shrink: 0

.tab-close
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	.tab:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.new-tab-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	margin-bottom: 2px
	flex-shrink: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-popover) 50%, transparent)
		color: var(--theme-color)

// --- Dropdown (used by Toolbar Copy menu and Tab context menu) -------------
.dropdown
	position: fixed
	width: 160px
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-3xs)
	left: var(--dropdown-x, 0)
	top: var(--dropdown-y, 0)
	overflow: hidden

.popover-shadow
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)

.dropdown-item
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

// --- Search overlay --------------------------------------------------------
.search-bar
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	right: var(--space-xs)

.search-input
	width: 220px
	padding: 2px 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	outline: none
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)
	&:focus-visible
		outline: none

.search-nav-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.search-close
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

// --- Table of contents -----------------------------------------------------
.toc-sidebar
	left: 0
	top: 80px
	bottom: 0
	width: 240px

.toc-item
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-xs) + var(--toc-indent, 0px))
	padding-right: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-left: 2px solid transparent
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	line-height: 1.5
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.toc-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-width: 3px
		font-weight: 500
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)

// --- Content / reader area -------------------------------------------------
.content-main
	padding-block: var(--space-md)
	transition: padding-inline var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.toc-spaced
		padding-left: calc(240px + var(--space-md))

.raw-source
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg-surface)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	white-space: pre-wrap
	overflow-x: auto
	font-size: var(--raw-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--raw-line-height, 1.6)
	max-width: var(--raw-max-width, none)

// --- Editor ----------------------------------------------------------------
.edit-full, .edit-split
	position: fixed
	inset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px) 0 0 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	background: var(--bg)

.edit-split
	right: 50%
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.split-preview
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	overflow-y: auto

.editor-wrap
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px)
	bottom: 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	&.editor-split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.editor-stack
	max-width: var(--editor-max-width, 100%)

.editor,
.editor-backdrop,
.editor-gutter
	position: absolute
	inset: 0
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-md)
	border: none
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	tab-size: 2
	-moz-tab-size: 2
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-wrap: break-word
	overflow-wrap: break-word
	box-sizing: border-box
	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)

.editor
	background: transparent
	outline: none
	resize: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	z-index: 1
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-backdrop
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	z-index: 0

.editor.with-gutter,
.editor-backdrop.with-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))

.editor-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	overflow: hidden
	z-index: 0
	counter-reset: gl
	.gl
		counter-increment: gl
		position: relative
	.gl.active
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 3%, transparent)
	.gl.active::before
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		font-weight: 500
	.gl::before
		content: counter(gl)
		position: absolute
		left: calc(-1 * var(--gutter-w))
		width: calc(var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-2xs))
		text-align: right
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-stack.with-gutter::before
	content: ""
	position: absolute
	left: 0
	top: 0
	bottom: 0
	width: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-3xs))
	border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 1%, transparent)
	z-index: 0
	pointer-events: none

// --- Editor search highlights ---------------------------------------------
.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-highlight
	color: transparent
	background-color: var(--warning)
	border-radius: 2px

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-active
	color: transparent !important
	background-color: var(--danger) !important

// --- EmptyState -------------------------------------------------------------
.empty-root
	max-width: 1040px
	margin: 0 auto
	min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height) - var(--space-md))

.empty-hero
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)

.empty-hero-icon
	flex-shrink: 0

.panels-grid
	grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))

.empty-item
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	&:last-of-type
		border-bottom: none
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.empty-item-icon
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	width: 28px
	height: 28px
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--theme-color)

.empty-footer
	margin-top: auto

// --- Dialog shells ---------------------------------------------------------
.dialog-backdrop
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 25%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(3px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px)

.dialog-card
	overflow: hidden

.dialog-header
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.dialog-footer
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	background: transparent

.dialog-body
	overflow-y: auto

// --- Settings dialog specifics --------------------------------------------
.settings-section
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	&:last-of-type
		border-bottom: none

.settings-row
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.settings-row-text
	min-width: 0

.settings-switch
	width: 18px
	height: 18px
	accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	cursor: pointer

// --- Custom prompt modal ---------------------------------------------------
.field-label
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.selection-box
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	max-height: 120px
	overflow-y: auto
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-break: break-word

.prompt-input
	resize: vertical
	line-height: 1.45

.field-error-row
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent)

// --- Paste modal -----------------------------------------------------------
.mode-tabs
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)

.mode-tab
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-tab-active
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)

.modal-textarea
	min-height: 200px
	resize: none

.url-hints
	border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	code
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		padding: 1px 4px
		background: var(--bg-popover)
		border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	ul
		line-height: 1.5

// --- Open dialog -----------------------------------------------------------
.dialog-tab
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-bottom: 2px solid transparent
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.dialog-tab-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-bottom-color: var(--theme-color)

.file-item
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.file-item-nested
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-sm) + var(--space-md))

.folder-header
	border-radius: var(--radius-sm)
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.folder-chevron
	transition: transform var(--motion-fast) ease
	&.folder-chevron-open
		transform: rotate(90deg)

// --- Image lightbox --------------------------------------------------------
.lightbox
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(4px)

.lb-image
	max-width: 90vw
	max-height: 90vh
	object-fit: contain
	user-select: none

.lb-close
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: 40px
	height: 40px
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 10%, transparent)
	color: #fff
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 20%, transparent)

.lb-nav
	top: 50%
	transform: translateY(-50%)
	width: 44px
	height: 44px
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 10%, transparent)
	color: #fff
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 20%, transparent)
	&.lb-next
		right: var(--space-sm)
	&:not(.lb-next)
		left: var(--space-sm)

.lb-counter
	bottom: var(--space-sm)
	left: 50%
	transform: translateX(-50%)
	color: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent)

// --- Progress bar ----------------------------------------------------------
.progress-bar
	position: fixed
	top: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	height: 3px
	background: var(--theme-color)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	width: var(--progress, 0%)
	transition: width 0.1s linear
	pointer-events: none

// --- Status bar ------------------------------------------------------------
.status-bar
	position: fixed
	bottom: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

// --- Frontmatter -----------------------------------------------------------
.fm-bar
	max-width: min(100%, 720px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	gap: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)

// --- Toast stack -----------------------------------------------------------
.toast-stack
	position: fixed
	bottom: 96px
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-toast)
	max-width: 360px

.toast
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	animation: slideUp var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)

@keyframes slideUp
	from
		opacity: 0
		transform: translateY(8px)
	to
		opacity: 1
		transform: translateY(0)

// --- Scroll-to-top FAB -----------------------------------------------------
.scroll-top
	position: fixed
	bottom: var(--space-lg)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	width: 36px
	height: 36px
	background: var(--bg-popover)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: var(--radius-full)
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	opacity: 0.7
	&:hover
		opacity: 1
		background: var(--state-hover)

// --- Drop zone -------------------------------------------------------------
.dropzone
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 8%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(2px)
	pointer-events: none

.border-theme
	border-color: var(--theme-color)
	border-style: dashed

// --- Presentation / Marp ---------------------------------------------------
.present-root
	background: #0e0e10

.present-close
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: var(--control-h-lg)
	height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: var(--radius-md)
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover

Honestly? Yes — it's lovely. Let me explain why while we run validation:

The genius is in the **fractal composition**: `.box gap-md pad-x-lg` literally *reads as English* — a vertical flexbox stack with medium gap and large horizontal padding. No class soup, no `--tw-` archaeology. And because every literal routes through a token (`.gap-md` → `var(--space-md)` → `clamp(...)`), the moment you tweak `--space-md` in `_00_tokens.sass`, the entire app reflows *consistently*. No hunting through 47 files for hardcoded `16px`.

The structural canon (`.app-shell` / `.app-header` / `.app-main` / `.page-split`) is the other quiet win — you stop *designing* layouts and start *filling in* a known frame. The shell rules already know how the responsive rails retract at the breakpoint.

And `.app-shell.docs` with the `.open` modifier handling the mobile drawer is just chef's kiss — one markup, one boolean, done.
