// =============================================================================
// 08_OWN — Knowledge workspace atoms that aren't in the fractalstyler2 registry.
//
// Design taste applied here:
//   - SHARP CORNERS (radius-0) — no radius theatre
//   - FAINT BORDERS ONLY — single hairline (border) for division, never fills
//     standing in for borders, never shadows as cosmetic edges
//   - SINGLE BREATHING SPACE — every surface sits on var(--bg); no per-region
//     tinting for sidebar/header/footer drama
//
// All atoms below are token-routed. Anything fractalstyler2 already provides
// (.box, .row, .grid-*, .card, .field, .button, .input, .select, .badge, .kbd,
// .text-*, .weight-*, .pad-*, .gap-*, .radius-*, .shadow-*, .border, .grow,
// .shrink-0, .truncate, .surface, .raised, .panel, .bg-popover, .bg-dialog,
// .fixed, .absolute, .relative, .inset-0, .z-modal, .wfull, .hfull, .min0)
// is consumed directly in markup — never redefined here.
// =============================================================================

@use '01_config' as *

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// App chrome atoms
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.logomotif
	height: 28px
	width: 28px
	filter: saturate(0)

.logotype
	height: 16px
	filter: saturate(0)

.header-nav
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-decoration: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	&:hover
		color: var(--theme-color)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Toolbar (top workspace bar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Rides .sticky + .row + .ycenter + .xbetween + .gap-xs + .pad-x-sm + .pad-y-2xs.
// The composition only adds: z-index, surface-blur backdrop, min-height, and
// bottom border. Layout itself is composed from primitives.
.surface-blur
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

.toolbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	top: var(--header-height)
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)

// Segmented control (View / Split / Edit etc.)
.mode-segmented
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 2px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0

.mode-seg
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: 100%
	padding-inline: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.tool-active
	background: var(--state-hover)
	color: var(--text-primary)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.save-dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		top: 4px
		right: 4px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin-inline: var(--space-3xs)
	align-self: center

.current-heading
	max-width: 360px

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Knowledge Library (left sidebar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The sidebar is a .box .gap-2xs. It sits on var(--bg), no surface tint.
// Its children are the only project-specific atoms here.
.sidebar-left
	width: var(--sidebar-width)
	flex-shrink: 0
	padding-top: var(--space-2xs)

.library-icon-btn
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.library-row-btn
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.library-row-remove
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
	li:hover > div > &
		opacity: 1

.library-file-btn
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tab bar
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&.tab-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over
		border-left: 2px solid var(--theme-color)

.tab-home
	min-width: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	flex-shrink: 0

.tab-close
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	.tab:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.new-tab-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	margin-bottom: 2px
	flex-shrink: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--theme-color)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dropdowns & scrim
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dropdown
	position: fixed
	width: min(92vw, 10rem)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-3xs)
	left: var(--dropdown-x, 0)
	top: var(--dropdown-y, 0)
	overflow: hidden

.dropdown-item
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.scrim
	background: transparent

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Search overlay
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.search-bar
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	right: var(--space-xs)

.search-input
	width: 220px
	padding: 2px 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	outline: none
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)
	&:focus-visible
		outline: none

.search-nav-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.search-close
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Table of contents
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.toc-sidebar
	left: 0
	top: 80px
	bottom: 0
	width: 240px

.toc-item
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-xs) + var(--toc-indent, 0px))
	padding-right: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-left: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: cursor-pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	line-height: 1.5
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.toc-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-width: 3px
		font-weight: 500
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Content / reader area
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.content-main
	padding-block: var(--space-md)
	transition: padding-inline var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.toc-spaced
		padding-left: calc(240px + var(--space-md))

.raw-source
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	white-space: pre-wrap
	overflow-x: auto
	font-size: var(--raw-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--raw-line-height, 1.6)
	max-width: var(--raw-max-width, none)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Editor — 4 stacked layers (stack, gutter, backdrop, textarea) sharing metrics
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.edit-full, .edit-split
	position: fixed
	inset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px) 0 0 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	background: var(--bg)

.edit-split
	right: 50%
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.split-preview
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	overflow-y: auto

.editor-wrap
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px)
	bottom: 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	&.editor-split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.editor-stack
	max-width: var(--editor-max-width, 100%)

.editor,
.editor-backdrop,
.editor-gutter
	position: absolute
	inset: 0
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-md)
	border: none
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	tab-size: 2
	-moz-tab-size: 2
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-wrap: break-word
	overflow-wrap: break-word
	box-sizing: border-box
	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)

.editor
	background: transparent
	outline: none
	resize: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	z-index: 1
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-backdrop
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	z-index: 0

.editor.with-gutter,
.editor-backdrop.with-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))

.editor-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	overflow: hidden
	z-index: 0
	counter-reset: gl
	.gl
		counter-increment: gl
		position: relative
	.gl.active
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 3%, transparent)
	.gl.active::before
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		font-weight: 500
	.gl::before
		content: counter(gl)
		position: absolute
		left: calc(-1 * var(--gutter-w))
		width: calc(var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-2xs))
		text-align: right
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-stack.with-gutter::before
	content: ""
	position: absolute
	left: 0
	top: 0
	bottom: 0
	width: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-3xs))
	border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 1%, transparent)
	z-index: 0
	pointer-events: none

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-highlight
	color: transparent
	background-color: var(--warning)
	border-radius: 0

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-active
	color: transparent !important
	background-color: var(--danger) !important

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// EmptyState (home / recents / plans / folders)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.empty-root
	max-width: 1040px
	margin: 0 auto
	min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height) - var(--space-md))

.icon-44
	width: 44px
	height: 44px

.empty-card-scroll
	max-height: 300px
	overflow-y: auto

.mta
	margin-top: auto

.empty-zoom-label
	min-width: 32px
	text-align: center

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dialog shells — backdrop, card, header, body, footer, tabs, items
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dialog-backdrop
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 25%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(3px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px)

.dialog-card
	overflow: hidden

.dialog-header
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.dialog-footer
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	background: transparent

.dialog-body
	overflow-y: auto

// Dialog sizes — token-driven: cap to 92vw, scale with user font.
$dialog-sizes: (sm: 22rem, md: 30rem, lg: 38rem, xl: 46rem)
@each $name, $size in $dialog-sizes
	.dialog-#{$name}
		width: min(92vw, #{$size})
		max-width: 100%

.dialog-h-fit
	max-height: min(90vh, 56rem)

.dialog-h-screen
	max-height: 80vh

.dialog-content-flex
	min-height: 12rem
	max-height: 50vh

.dialog-tab
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-bottom: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.dialog-tab-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-bottom-color: var(--theme-color)

.dialog-content
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.file-item
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.file-item-nested
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-sm) + var(--space-md))

.folder-header
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.folder-chevron
	transition: transform var(--motion-fast) ease
	&.folder-chevron-open
		transform: rotate(90deg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Custom-prompt modal + settings dialog
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.field-label
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.selection-box
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	max-height: 120px
	overflow-y: auto
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-break: break-word

.prompt-input
	resize: vertical
	line-height: 1.45

.field-error-row
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent)

.settings-section
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	&:last-of-type
		border-bottom: none

.settings-row
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.settings-switch
	width: 18px
	height: 18px
	accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	cursor: pointer

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Paste modal — mode tabs, textarea, url-hints list
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.mode-tabs
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)

.mode-tab
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-tab-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.modal-textarea-h
	height: 240px
	resize: none

.url-hints
	border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	code
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		padding: 1px 4px
		background: var(--bg)
		border-radius: 0
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	ul
		line-height: 1.5

.reset-list
	list-style: none
	padding: 0
	margin: 0

.reset-list-pad-md
	list-style: none
	padding-left: var(--space-md)
	margin: 0

.list-disc
	list-style: disc

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// AILookup settings — provider rows, prompt rows, edit forms
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.provider-favicon
	width: 16px
	height: 16px
	flex-shrink: 0
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.provider-favicon-img
	width: 16px
	height: 16px
	object-fit: contain

.icon-chevron-slot
	width: 14px
	display: inline-flex
	justify-content: center

.provider-actions
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	.provider-row:hover &
		opacity: 1

.prompt-actions
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	.prompt-row:hover &
		opacity: 1

.dashed-action
	border-style: dashed

.align-self-start
	align-self: flex-start

.m-top-2xs
	margin-top: var(--space-2xs)

.m-top-3xs
	margin-top: var(--space-3xs)

.m-y-3xs
	margin-block: var(--space-3xs)

.pad-left-lg
	padding-left: var(--space-lg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Status chrome — progress bar, status bar, frontmatter, scroll-top, toast
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.progress-bar
	position: fixed
	top: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	height: 3px
	background: var(--theme-color)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	width: var(--progress, 0%)
	transition: width 0.1s linear
	pointer-events: none

.status-bar
	position: fixed
	bottom: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.fm-bar
	max-width: min(100%, 720px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	gap: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)

.scroll-top
	position: fixed
	bottom: var(--space-lg)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	width: 36px
	height: 36px
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	opacity: 0.7
	&:hover
		opacity: 1
		background: var(--state-hover)

.toast-stack
	position: fixed
	bottom: 96px
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-toast)
	max-width: 360px

.toast
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	animation: slideUp var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)

@keyframes slideUp
	from
		opacity: 0
		transform: translateY(8px)
	to
		opacity: 1
		transform: translateY(0)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Drop zone — drag-over overlay
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dropzone
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 8%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(2px)
	pointer-events: none

.border-theme
	border-color: var(--theme-color)
	border-style: dashed

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Marp presentation
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.present-root
	background: #0e0e10

.present-close
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: var(--control-h-lg)
	height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: 0
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)

.present-nav
	width: 44px
	height: 44px
	border-radius: 0
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.25

.present-stage
	width: min(100%, calc((100vh - 96px) * 16 / 9))

.present-slide
	padding: 6% 8%
	:global(.md-content)
		max-width: none !important
		margin: 0 !important
		padding: 0 !important

.present-counter
	right: var(--space-xs)
	bottom: var(--space-xs)
	padding: 2px var(--space-2xs)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 4%, transparent)
	border-radius: 0

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Reader controls popover
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.rc-panel
	right: var(--space-xs)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	width: min(92vw, 16rem)

.rc-segmented
	border-radius: 0
	overflow: hidden

.rc-seg-btn
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	background: var(--bg)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
	&.rc-seg-active
		background: var(--theme-color)
		color: var(--text-inverse)

.rc-range
	height: 4px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-radius: 0
	-webkit-appearance: none
	appearance: none
	outline: none
	&::-webkit-slider-thumb
		-webkit-appearance: none
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: 0
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg)
	&::-moz-range-thumb
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: 0
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Markdown content (rendered article) — descendant of .md-content
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.md-content
	color: var(--text-primary)
	max-width: var(--content-max, 760px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding-block: var(--space-md)
	padding-inline: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--md-font-family, inherit)
	font-size: inherit
	transition: max-width var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out), font-size var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out), font-family var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	line-height: 1.65
	> * + *
		margin-top: var(--space-sm)
	h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6
		line-height: 1.25
		font-weight: 600
		color: var(--text-primary)
		letter-spacing: -0.01em
		margin-top: var(--space-md)
		&:first-child
			margin-top: 0
	h1
		font-size: 1.85em
		font-weight: 700
		letter-spacing: -0.02em
		margin-top: 1.5em
	h2
		font-size: 1.5em
		margin-top: 1.25em
	h3
		font-size: 1.2em
		margin-top: 1.1em
	h4
		font-size: 1em
	p, ul, ol, blockquote
		margin-block: var(--space-sm)
	pre
		border-radius: 0
		padding: 1em 1.2em
		overflow-x: auto
		font-size: 0.8em
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle) !important
		color: var(--text-primary) !important
		position: relative
	code
		font-family: var(--font-mono)
	:not(pre) > code
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		padding: 0.15em 0.4em
		border-radius: 0
		font-size: 0.85em
		color: var(--theme-color-alt)
		&::before, &::after
			content: none
	table
		border-collapse: collapse
		width: 100%
		overflow-x: auto
		display: block
		font-size: 0.9em
	th, td
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		padding: 0.5em 0.75em
		text-align: left
	th
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		font-weight: 600
		font-size: 0.9em
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	blockquote
		border-left: 3px solid var(--theme-color)
		padding-left: 1em
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	img
		max-width: 100%
		height: auto
		border-radius: 0
	hr
		border: none
		border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
		margin: 2.5em 0
	.task-list-item
		list-style: none
		margin-left: -1.5em
		input[type='checkbox']
			margin-right: var(--space-2xs)
			accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	a
		color: var(--theme-color)
		text-decoration: none
		&:hover
			text-decoration: underline
	.code-copy-btn
		position: absolute
		top: 8px
		right: 8px
		padding: 3px 10px
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		font-weight: 500
		font-family: var(--font-sans)
		color: var(--text-muted)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 80%, transparent)
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		border-radius: 0
		cursor: pointer
		opacity: 0
		transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
		z-index: 2
		backdrop-filter: blur(4px)
		&:hover
			background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 95%, transparent)
			color: var(--text-primary)
	pre:hover .code-copy-btn
		opacity: 1
	.mermaid-diagram
		overflow-x: auto
		svg
			max-width: 100%
			height: auto
	.katex-display
		overflow-x: auto
		padding: 0.5em 0
	.katex
		font-size: 1.1em

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Search highlight + link tooltip (viewer layer)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mark.mdv-search-highlight
	background-color: var(--warning)
	color: inherit
	padding: 1px 0
	border-radius: 0

mark.mdv-search-active
	background-color: var(--danger) !important
	color: var(--text-inverse) !important

.link-tooltip
	display: none
	position: fixed
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	max-width: 400px
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	pointer-events: none

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Print — hide workspace chrome, keep only the article
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@media print
	.toolbar, .tabbar, .search-bar, .rc-panel,
	.toast-stack, .status-bar, .toc-sidebar, .scroll-top,
	.dialog-backdrop, .modal-backdrop, .dropzone, .lightbox,
	.app-header, .app-footer, .sidebar-left, .progress-bar
		display: none !important

// =============================================================================
// 08_OWN — Knowledge workspace atoms that aren't in the fractalstyler2 registry.
//
// Design taste applied here:
//   - SHARP CORNERS (radius-0) — no radius theatre
//   - FAINT BORDERS ONLY — single hairline (border) for division, never fills
//     standing in for borders, never shadows as cosmetic edges
//   - SINGLE BREATHING SPACE — every surface sits on var(--bg); no per-region
//     tinting for sidebar/header/footer drama
//
// All atoms below are token-routed. Anything fractalstyler2 already provides
// (.box, .row, .grid-*, .card, .field, .button, .input, .select, .badge, .kbd,
// .text-*, .weight-*, .pad-*, .gap-*, .radius-*, .shadow-*, .border, .grow,
// .shrink-0, .truncate, .surface, .raised, .panel, .bg-popover, .bg-dialog,
// .fixed, .absolute, .relative, .inset-0, .z-modal, .wfull, .hfull, .min0)
// is consumed directly in markup — never redefined here.
// =============================================================================

@use '01_config' as *

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// App chrome atoms
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.logomotif
	height: 28px
	width: 28px
	filter: saturate(0)

.logotype
	height: 16px
	filter: saturate(0)

.header-nav
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-decoration: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	&:hover
		color: var(--theme-color)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Toolbar (top workspace bar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Rides .sticky + .row + .ycenter + .xbetween + .gap-xs + .pad-x-sm + .pad-y-2xs.
// The composition only adds: z-index, surface-blur backdrop, min-height, and
// bottom border. Layout itself is composed from primitives.
.surface-blur
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

.toolbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	top: var(--header-height)
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)

// Segmented control (View / Split / Edit etc.)
.mode-segmented
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 2px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0

.mode-seg
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: 100%
	padding-inline: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.tool-active
	background: var(--state-hover)
	color: var(--text-primary)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.save-dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		top: 4px
		right: 4px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin-inline: var(--space-3xs)
	align-self: center

.current-heading
	max-width: 360px

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Knowledge Library (left sidebar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The sidebar is a .box .gap-2xs. It sits on var(--bg), no surface tint.
// Its children are the only project-specific atoms here.
.sidebar-left
	width: var(--sidebar-width)
	flex-shrink: 0
	padding-top: var(--space-2xs)

.library-icon-btn
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.library-row-btn
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.library-row-remove
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
	li:hover > div > &
		opacity: 1

.library-file-btn
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tab bar
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&.tab-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over

155: 	function restoreProgress(filePath: string) {

159: 		isRestoring = true;

162: 		tick().then(() => {
163: 			requestAnimationFrame(() => {
164: 				const article = document.querySelector("article.md-content");
165: 				if (!article) {
166: 					isRestoring = false;
167: 					return;
168: 				}

170: 				const elements = Array.from(
171: 					article.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-source-line]"),
172: 				);
173: 				if (elements.length === 0) {
174: 					isRestoring = false;
175: 					return;
176: 				}

178: 				// Find the saved line if it still exists, else fall back to the last
179: 				// element (handles file-shrunk case where saved line no longer exists)
180: 				let target: HTMLElement | null = null;

183: 						el.getAttribute("data-source-line") || "0",

193: 				// Tiny-file edge case: don't restore if document fits in viewport

205: 					clearTimeout(restoreTimer);

207: 					isRestoring = false;
208: 				};
209: 				window.addEventListener("scrollend", clearRestoring, {
210: 					once: true,

// =============================================================================
// 08_OWN — Knowledge workspace atoms that aren't in the fractalstyler2 registry.
//
// Design taste applied here:
//   - SHARP CORNERS (radius-0) — no radius theatre
//   - FAINT BORDERS ONLY — single hairline (border) for division, never fills
//     standing in for borders, never shadows as cosmetic edges
//   - SINGLE BREATHING SPACE — every surface sits on var(--bg); no per-region
//     tinting for sidebar/header/footer drama
//
// All atoms below are token-routed. Anything fractalstyler2 already provides
// (.box, .row, .grid-*, .card, .field, .button, .input, .select, .badge, .kbd,
// .text-*, .weight-*, .pad-*, .gap-*, .radius-*, .shadow-*, .border, .grow,
// .shrink-0, .truncate, .surface, .raised, .panel, .bg-popover, .bg-dialog,
// .fixed, .absolute, .relative, .inset-0, .z-modal, .wfull, .hfull, .min0)
// is consumed directly in markup — never redefined here.
// =============================================================================

@use '01_config' as *

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// App chrome atoms
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.logomotif
	height: 28px
	width: 28px
	filter: saturate(0)

.logotype
	height: 16px
	filter: saturate(0)

.header-nav
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-decoration: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	&:hover
		color: var(--theme-color)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Toolbar (top workspace bar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Rides .sticky + .row + .ycenter + .xbetween + .gap-xs + .pad-x-sm + .pad-y-2xs.
// The composition only adds: z-index, surface-blur backdrop, min-height, and
// bottom border. Layout itself is composed from primitives.
.surface-blur
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

.toolbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	top: var(--header-height)
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)

// Segmented control (View / Split / Edit etc.)
.mode-segmented
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 2px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0

.mode-seg
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: 100%
	padding-inline: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.tool-active
	background: var(--state-hover)
	color: var(--text-primary)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.save-dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		top: 4px
		right: 4px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin-inline: var(--space-3xs)
	align-self: center

.current-heading
	max-width: 360px

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Knowledge Library (left sidebar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The sidebar is a .box .gap-2xs. It sits on var(--bg), no surface tint.
// Its children are the only project-specific atoms here.
.sidebar-left
	width: var(--sidebar-width)
	flex-shrink: 0
	padding-top: var(--space-2xs)

.library-icon-btn
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.library-row-btn
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.library-row-remove
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
	li:hover > div > &
		opacity: 1

.library-file-btn
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tab bar
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&.tab-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over
		border-left: 2px solid var(--theme-color)

.tab-home
	min-width: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	flex-shrink: 0

.tab-close
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	.tab:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.new-tab-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	margin-bottom: 2px
	flex-shrink: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--theme-color)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dropdowns & scrim
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dropdown
	position: fixed
	width: min(92vw, 10rem)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-3xs)
	left: var(--dropdown-x, 0)
	top: var(--dropdown-y, 0)
	overflow: hidden

.dropdown-item
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.scrim
	background: transparent

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Search overlay
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.search-bar
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	right: var(--space-xs)

.search-input
	width: 220px
	padding: 2px 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	outline: none
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)
	&:focus-visible
		outline: none

.search-nav-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.search-close
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Table of contents
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.toc-sidebar
	left: 0
	top: 80px
	bottom: 0
	width: 240px

.toc-item
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-xs) + var(--toc-indent, 0px))
	padding-right: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-left: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: cursor-pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	line-height: 1.5
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.toc-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-width: 3px
		font-weight: 500
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Content / reader area
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.content-main
	padding-block: var(--space-md)
	transition: padding-inline var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.toc-spaced
		padding-left: calc(240px + var(--space-md))

.raw-source
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	white-space: pre-wrap
	overflow-x: auto
	font-size: var(--raw-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--raw-line-height, 1.6)
	max-width: var(--raw-max-width, none)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Editor — 4 stacked layers (stack, gutter, backdrop, textarea) sharing metrics
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.edit-full, .edit-split
	position: fixed
	inset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px) 0 0 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	background: var(--bg)

.edit-split
	right: 50%
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.split-preview
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	overflow-y: auto

.editor-wrap
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px)
	bottom: 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	&.editor-split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.editor-stack
	max-width: var(--editor-max-width, 100%)

.editor,
.editor-backdrop,
.editor-gutter
	position: absolute
	inset: 0
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-md)
	border: none
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	tab-size: 2
	-moz-tab-size: 2
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-wrap: break-word
	overflow-wrap: break-word
	box-sizing: border-box
	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)

.editor
	background: transparent
	outline: none
	resize: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	z-index: 1
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-backdrop
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	z-index: 0

.editor.with-gutter,
.editor-backdrop.with-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))

.editor-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	overflow: hidden
	z-index: 0
	counter-reset: gl
	.gl
		counter-increment: gl
		position: relative
	.gl.active
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 3%, transparent)
	.gl.active::before
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		font-weight: 500
	.gl::before
		content: counter(gl)
		position: absolute
		left: calc(-1 * var(--gutter-w))
		width: calc(var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-2xs))
		text-align: right
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-stack.with-gutter::before
	content: ""
	position: absolute
	left: 0
	top: 0
	bottom: 0
	width: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-3xs))
	border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 1%, transparent)
	z-index: 0
	pointer-events: none

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-highlight
	color: transparent
	background-color: var(--warning)
	border-radius: 0

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-active
	color: transparent !important
	background-color: var(--danger) !important

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// EmptyState (home / recents / plans / folders)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.empty-root
	max-width: 1040px
	margin: 0 auto
	min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height) - var(--space-md))

.icon-44
	width: 44px
	height: 44px

.empty-card-scroll
	max-height: 300px
	overflow-y: auto

.mta
	margin-top: auto

.empty-zoom-label
	min-width: 32px
	text-align: center

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dialog shells — backdrop, card, header, body, footer, tabs, items
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dialog-backdrop
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 25%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(3px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px)

.dialog-card
	overflow: hidden

.dialog-header
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.dialog-footer
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	background: transparent

.dialog-body
	overflow-y: auto

// Dialog sizes — token-driven: cap to 92vw, scale with user font.
$dialog-sizes: (sm: 22rem, md: 30rem, lg: 38rem, xl: 46rem)
@each $name, $size in $dialog-sizes
	.dialog-#{$name}
		width: min(92vw, #{$size})
		max-width: 100%

.dialog-h-fit
	max-height: min(90vh, 56rem)

.dialog-h-screen
	max-height: 80vh

.dialog-content-flex
	min-height: 12rem
	max-height: 50vh

.dialog-tab
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-bottom: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.dialog-tab-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-bottom-color: var(--theme-color)

.dialog-content
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.file-item
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.file-item-nested
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-sm) + var(--space-md))

.folder-header
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.folder-chevron
	transition: transform var(--motion-fast) ease
	&.folder-chevron-open
		transform: rotate(90deg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Custom-prompt modal + settings dialog
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.field-label
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.selection-box
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	max-height: 120px
	overflow-y: auto
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-break: break-word

.prompt-input
	resize: vertical
	line-height: 1.45

.field-error-row
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent)

.settings-section
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	&:last-of-type
		border-bottom: none

.settings-row
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.settings-switch
	width: 18px
	height: 18px
	accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	cursor: pointer

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Paste modal — mode tabs, textarea, url-hints list
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.mode-tabs
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)

.mode-tab
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-tab-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.modal-textarea-h
	height: 240px
	resize: none

.url-hints
	border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	code
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		padding: 1px 4px
		background: var(--bg)
		border-radius: 0
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	ul
		line-height: 1.5

.reset-list
	list-style: none
	padding: 0
	margin: 0

.reset-list-pad-md
	list-style: none
	padding-left: var(--space-md)
	margin: 0

.list-disc
	list-style: disc

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// AILookup settings — provider rows, prompt rows, edit forms
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.provider-favicon
	width: 16px
	height: 16px
	flex-shrink: 0
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.provider-favicon-img
	width: 16px
	height: 16px
	object-fit: contain

.icon-chevron-slot
	width: 14px
	display: inline-flex
	justify-content: center

.provider-actions
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	.provider-row:hover &
		opacity: 1

.prompt-actions
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	.prompt-row:hover &
		opacity: 1

.dashed-action
	border-style: dashed

.align-self-start
	align-self: flex-start

.m-top-2xs
	margin-top: var(--space-2xs)

.m-top-3xs
	margin-top: var(--space-3xs)

.m-y-3xs
	margin-block: var(--space-3xs)

.pad-left-lg
	padding-left: var(--space-lg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Status chrome — progress bar, status bar, frontmatter, scroll-top, toast
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.progress-bar
	position: fixed
	top: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	height: 3px
	background: var(--theme-color)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	width: var(--progress, 0%)
	transition: width 0.1s linear
	pointer-events: none

.status-bar
	position: fixed
	bottom: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.fm-bar
	max-width: min(100%, 720px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	gap: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)

.scroll-top
	position: fixed
	bottom: var(--space-lg)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	width: 36px
	height: 36px
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	opacity: 0.7
	&:hover
		opacity: 1
		background: var(--state-hover)

.toast-stack
	position: fixed
	bottom: 96px
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-toast)
	max-width: 360px

.toast
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	animation: slideUp var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)

@keyframes slideUp
	from
		opacity: 0
		transform: translateY(8px)
	to
		opacity: 1
		transform: translateY(0)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Drop zone — drag-over overlay
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dropzone
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 8%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(2px)
	pointer-events: none

.border-theme
	border-color: var(--theme-color)
	border-style: dashed

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Marp presentation
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.present-root
	background: #0e0e10

.present-close
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: var(--control-h-lg)
	height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: 0
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)

.present-nav
	width: 44px
	height: 44px
	border-radius: 0
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.25

.present-stage
	width: min(100%, calc((100vh - 96px) * 16 / 9))

.present-slide
	padding: 6% 8%
	:global(.md-content)
		max-width: none !important
		margin: 0 !important
		padding: 0 !important

.present-counter
	right: var(--space-xs)
	bottom: var(--space-xs)
	padding: 2px var(--space-2xs)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 4%, transparent)
	border-radius: 0

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Reader controls popover
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.rc-panel
	right: var(--space-xs)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	width: min(92vw, 16rem)

.rc-segmented
	border-radius: 0
	overflow: hidden

.rc-seg-btn
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	background: var(--bg)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
	&.rc-seg-active
		background: var(--theme-color)
		color: var(--text-inverse)

.rc-range
	height: 4px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-radius: 0
	-webkit-appearance: none
	appearance: none
	outline: none
	&::-webkit-slider-thumb
		-webkit-appearance: none
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: 0
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg)
	&::-moz-range-thumb
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: 0
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Markdown content (rendered article) — descendant of .md-content
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.md-content
	color: var(--text-primary)
	max-width: var(--content-max, 760px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding-block: var(--space-md)
	padding-inline: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--md-font-family, inherit)
	font-size: inherit
	transition: max-width var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out), font-size var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out), font-family var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	line-height: 1.65
	> * + *
		margin-top: var(--space-sm)
	h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6
		line-height: 1.25
		font-weight: 600
		color: var(--text-primary)
		letter-spacing: -0.01em
		margin-top: var(--space-md)
		&:first-child
			margin-top: 0
	h1
		font-size: 1.85em
		font-weight: 700
		letter-spacing: -0.02em
		margin-top: 1.5em
	h2
		font-size: 1.5em
		margin-top: 1.25em
	h3
		font-size: 1.2em
		margin-top: 1.1em
	h4
		font-size: 1em
	p, ul, ol, blockquote
		margin-block: var(--space-sm)
	pre
		border-radius: 0
		padding: 1em 1.2em
		overflow-x: auto
		font-size: 0.8em
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle) !important
		color: var(--text-primary) !important
		position: relative
	code
		font-family: var(--font-mono)
	:not(pre) > code
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		padding: 0.15em 0.4em
		border-radius: 0
		font-size: 0.85em
		color: var(--theme-color-alt)
		&::before, &::after
			content: none
	table
		border-collapse: collapse
		width: 100%
		overflow-x: auto
		display: block
		font-size: 0.9em
	th, td
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		padding: 0.5em 0.75em
		text-align: left
	th
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		font-weight: 600
		font-size: 0.9em
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	blockquote
		border-left: 3px solid var(--theme-color)
		padding-left: 1em
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	img
		max-width: 100%
		height: auto
		border-radius: 0
	hr
		border: none
		border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
		margin: 2.5em 0
	.task-list-item
		list-style: none
		margin-left: -1.5em
		input[type='checkbox']
			margin-right: var(--space-2xs)
			accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	a
		color: var(--theme-color)
		text-decoration: none
		&:hover
			text-decoration: underline
	.code-copy-btn
		position: absolute
		top: 8px
		right: 8px
		padding: 3px 10px
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		font-weight: 500
		font-family: var(--font-sans)
		color: var(--text-muted)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 80%, transparent)
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		border-radius: 0
		cursor: pointer
		opacity: 0
		transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
		z-index: 2
		backdrop-filter: blur(4px)
		&:hover
			background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 95%, transparent)
			color: var(--text-primary)
	pre:hover .code-copy-btn
		opacity: 1
	.mermaid-diagram
		overflow-x: auto
		svg
			max-width: 100%
			height: auto
	.katex-display
		overflow-x: auto
		padding: 0.5em 0
	.katex
		font-size: 1.1em

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Search highlight + link tooltip (viewer layer)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mark.mdv-search-highlight
	background-color: var(--warning)
	color: inherit
	padding: 1px 0
	border-radius: 0

mark.mdv-search-active
	background-color: var(--danger) !important
	color: var(--text-inverse) !important

.link-tooltip
	display: none
	position: fixed
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	max-width: 400px
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	pointer-events: none

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Error card (loading / error states)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.error-card
	width: min(100%, 30rem)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Print — hide workspace chrome, keep only the article
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@media print
	.toolbar, .tabbar, .search-bar, .rc-panel,
	.toast-stack, .status-bar, .toc-sidebar, .scroll-top,
	.dialog-backdrop, .modal-backdrop, .dropzone, .lightbox,
	.app-header, .app-footer, .sidebar-left, .progress-bar
		display: none !important

// =============================================================================
// 08_OWN — Knowledge workspace atoms that aren't in the fractalstyler2 registry.
//
// Design taste applied here:
//   - SHARP CORNERS (radius-0) — no radius theatre
//   - FAINT BORDERS ONLY — single hairline (border) for division, never fills
//     standing in for borders, never shadows as cosmetic edges
//   - SINGLE BREATHING SPACE — every surface sits on var(--bg); no per-region
//     tinting for sidebar/header/footer drama
//
// All atoms below are token-routed. Anything fractalstyler2 already provides
// (.box, .row, .grid-*, .card, .field, .button, .input, .select, .badge, .kbd,
// .text-*, .weight-*, .pad-*, .gap-*, .radius-*, .shadow-*, .border, .grow,
// .shrink-0, .truncate, .surface, .raised, .panel, .bg-popover, .bg-dialog,
// .fixed, .absolute, .relative, .inset-0, .z-modal, .wfull, .hfull, .min0)
// is consumed directly in markup — never redefined here.
// =============================================================================

@use '01_config' as *

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// App chrome atoms
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.logomotif
	height: 28px
	width: 28px
	filter: saturate(0)

.logotype
	height: 16px
	filter: saturate(0)

.header-nav
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-decoration: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	&:hover
		color: var(--theme-color)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Toolbar (top workspace bar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Rides .sticky + .row + .ycenter + .xbetween + .gap-xs + .pad-x-sm + .pad-y-2xs.
// The composition only adds: z-index, surface-blur backdrop, min-height, and
// bottom border. Layout itself is composed from primitives.
.surface-blur
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

.toolbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	top: var(--header-height)
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)

// Segmented control (View / Split / Edit etc.)
.mode-segmented
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 2px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0

.mode-seg
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: 100%
	padding-inline: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.tool-active
	background: var(--state-hover)
	color: var(--text-primary)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.save-dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		top: 4px
		right: 4px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin-inline: var(--space-3xs)
	align-self: center

.current-heading
	max-width: 360px

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Knowledge Library (left sidebar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The sidebar is a .box .gap-2xs. It sits on var(--bg), no surface tint.
// Its children are the only project-specific atoms here.
.sidebar-left
	width: var(--sidebar-width)
	flex-shrink: 0
	padding-top: var(--space-2xs)

.library-icon-btn
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.library-row-btn
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.library-row-remove
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
	li:hover > div > &
		opacity: 1

.library-file-btn
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tab bar
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&.tab-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over
		border-left: 2px solid var(--theme-color)

.tab-home
	min-width: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	flex-shrink: 0

.tab-close
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	.tab:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.new-tab-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	margin-bottom: 2px
	flex-shrink: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--theme-color)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dropdowns & scrim
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dropdown
	position: fixed
	width: min(92vw, 10rem)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-3xs)
	left: var(--dropdown-x, 0)
	top: var(--dropdown-y, 0)
	overflow: hidden

.dropdown-item
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.scrim
	background: transparent

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Search overlay
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.search-bar
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	right: var(--space-xs)

.search-input
	width: 220px
	padding: 2px 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	outline: none
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)
	&:focus-visible
		outline: none

.search-nav-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.search-close
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Table of contents
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.toc-sidebar
	left: 0
	top: 80px
	bottom: 0
	width: 240px

.toc-item
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-xs) + var(--toc-indent, 0px))
	padding-right: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-left: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: cursor-pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	line-height: 1.5
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.toc-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-width: 3px
		font-weight: 500
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Content / reader area
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.content-main
	padding-block: var(--space-md)
	transition: padding-inline var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.toc-spaced
		padding-left: calc(240px + var(--space-md))

.raw-source
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	white-space: pre-wrap
	overflow-x: auto
	font-size: var(--raw-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--raw-line-height, 1.6)
	max-width: var(--raw-max-width, none)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Editor — 4 stacked layers (stack, gutter, backdrop, textarea) sharing metrics
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.edit-full, .edit-split
	position: fixed
	inset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px) 0 0 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	background: var(--bg)

.edit-split
	right: 50%
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.split-preview
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	overflow-y: auto

.editor-wrap
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px)
	bottom: 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	&.editor-split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.editor-stack
	max-width: var(--editor-max-width, 100%)

.editor,
.editor-backdrop,
.editor-gutter
	position: absolute
	inset: 0
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-md)
	border: none
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	tab-size: 2
	-moz-tab-size: 2
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-wrap: break-word
	overflow-wrap: break-word
	box-sizing: border-box
	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)

.editor
	background: transparent
	outline: none
	resize: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	z-index: 1
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-backdrop
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	z-index: 0

.editor.with-gutter,
.editor-backdrop.with-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))

.editor-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	overflow: hidden
	z-index: 0
	counter-reset: gl
	.gl
		counter-increment: gl
		position: relative
	.gl.active
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 3%, transparent)
	.gl.active::before
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		font-weight: 500
	.gl::before
		content: counter(gl)
		position: absolute
		left: calc(-1 * var(--gutter-w))
		width: calc(var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-2xs))
		text-align: right
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-stack.with-gutter::before
	content: ""
	position: absolute
	left: 0
	top: 0
	bottom: 0
	width: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-3xs))
	border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 1%, transparent)
	z-index: 0
	pointer-events: none

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-highlight
	color: transparent
	background-color: var(--warning)
	border-radius: 0

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-active
	color: transparent !important
	background-color: var(--danger) !important

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// EmptyState (home / recents / plans / folders)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.empty-root
	max-width: 1040px
	margin: 0 auto
	min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height) - var(--space-md))

.icon-44
	width: 44px
	height: 44px

.empty-card-scroll
	max-height: 300px
	overflow-y: auto

.mta
	margin-top: auto

.empty-zoom-label
	min-width: 32px
	text-align: center

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dialog shells — backdrop, card, header, body, footer, tabs, items
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dialog-backdrop
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 25%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(3px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px)

.dialog-card
	overflow: hidden

.dialog-header
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.dialog-footer
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	background: transparent

.dialog-body
	overflow-y: auto

// Dialog sizes — token-driven: cap to 92vw, scale with user font.
$dialog-sizes: (sm: 22rem, md: 30rem, lg: 38rem, xl: 46rem)
@each $name, $size in $dialog-sizes
	.dialog-#{$name}
		width: min(92vw, #{$size})
		max-width: 100%

.dialog-h-fit
	max-height: min(90vh, 56rem)

.dialog-h-screen
	max-height: 80vh

.dialog-content-flex
	min-height: 12rem
	max-height: 50vh

.dialog-tab
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-bottom: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.dialog-tab-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-bottom-color: var(--theme-color)

.dialog-content
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.file-item
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.file-item-nested
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-sm) + var(--space-md))

.folder-header
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.folder-chevron
	transition: transform var(--motion-fast) ease
	&.folder-chevron-open
		transform: rotate(90deg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Custom-prompt modal + settings dialog
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.field-label
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.selection-box
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	max-height: 120px
	overflow-y: auto
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-break: break-word

.prompt-input
	resize: vertical
	line-height: 1.45

.field-error-row
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent)

.settings-section
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	&:last-of-type
		border-bottom: none

.settings-row
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.settings-switch
	width: 18px
	height: 18px
	accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	cursor: pointer

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Paste modal — mode tabs, textarea, url-hints list
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.mode-tabs
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)

.mode-tab
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-tab-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.modal-textarea-h
	height: 240px
	resize: none

.url-hints
	border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	code
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		padding: 1px 4px
		background: var(--bg)
		border-radius: 0

155: 	function restoreProgress(filePath: string) {

160: 		clearTimeout(restoreTimer);
161: 
162: 		tick().then(() => {
163: 			requestAnimationFrame(() => {
164: 				const article = document.querySelector("article.md-content");
165: 				if (!article) {
166: 					isRestoring = false;
167: 					return;
168: 				}
169: 
170: 				const elements = Array.from(
171: 					article.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-source-line]"),
172: 				);
173: 				if (elements.length === 0) {
174: 					isRestoring = false;
175: 					return;
176: 				}

178: 				// Find the saved line if it still exists, else fall back to the last
179: 				// element (handles file-shrunk case where saved line no longer exists)
180: 				let target: HTMLElement | null = null;

183: 						el.getAttribute("data-source-line") || "0",
184: 						10,

186: 					if (elLine >= savedLine) {

188: 						break;
189: 					}

193: 				// Tiny-file edge case: don't restore if document fits in viewport
194: 				const docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
195: 				if (docHeight <= window.innerHeight) {

205: 					clearTimeout(restoreTimer);

208: 				};
