703: 	// producing visible stutter), we drive a single requestAnimationFrame loop while
704: 	// the key is held and stop it on keyup. This matches the native, continuous feel
705: 	// of arrow-key/trackpad scrolling. The half-page (d/u) and gg/G jumps stay smooth.
706: 	//
707: 	// Velocity is time-based (px/sec, scaled by the frame delta) rather than a fixed
708: 	// px-per-frame step, so the speed stays consistent regardless of display refresh
709: 	// rate (60Hz vs 120Hz ProMotion) and roughly matches native arrow-key scrolling.
710: 	const SCROLL_SPEED = 1000; // px per second
711: 	let scrollRAF: number | null = null;
712: 	let scrollDir = 0; // -1 = up, +1 = down, 0 = stopped
713: 	let scrollLastTs = 0;
714: 	const pressedScrollKeys = new Set<"j" | "k">();
715: 	let activeScrollKey: "j" | "k" | null = null;
716: 
717: 	function updateScrollDirection() {
718: 		scrollDir =
719: 			activeScrollKey === "j" ? 1 : activeScrollKey === "k" ? -1 : 0;
720: 	}
721: 
722: 	function startScroll(key: "j" | "k") {
723: 		pressedScrollKeys.add(key);
724: 		activeScrollKey = key;
725: 		updateScrollDirection();
726: 		if (scrollRAF !== null) return;
727: 		scrollLastTs = 0;
728: 		const step = (ts: number) => {
729: 			if (scrollDir === 0) {
730: 				scrollRAF = null;
731: 				return;
732: 			}
733: 			// First frame establishes the baseline timestamp; no movement yet.
734: 			const dt = scrollLastTs === 0 ? 0 : ts - scrollLastTs;
735: 			scrollLastTs = ts;
736: 			window.scrollBy(0, scrollDir * SCROLL_SPEED * (dt / 1000));
737: 			scrollRAF = requestAnimationFrame(step);
738: 		};
739: 		scrollRAF = requestAnimationFrame(step);
740: 	}
741: 
742: 	function stopScroll() {
743: 		pressedScrollKeys.clear();
744: 		activeScrollKey = null;
745: 		scrollDir = 0;
746: 		scrollLastTs = 0;
747: 		if (scrollRAF !== null) {
748: 			cancelAnimationFrame(scrollRAF);
749: 			scrollRAF = null;
750: 		}
751: 	}
752: 
753: 	function releaseScrollKey(key: "j" | "k") {
754: 		pressedScrollKeys.delete(key);
755: 		if (activeScrollKey !== key) return;
756: 
757: 		if (pressedScrollKeys.has("j")) {
758: 			activeScrollKey = "j";
759: 		} else if (pressedScrollKeys.has("k")) {
760: 			activeScrollKey = "k";
761: 		} else {
762: 			activeScrollKey = null;
763: 		}
764: 
765: 		updateScrollDirection();
766: 		if (scrollDir === 0) stopScroll();
767: 	}
768: 
769: 	function isInputFocused(): boolean {
770: 		const el = document.activeElement;
771: 		if (!el) return false;
772: 		const tag = el.tagName;
773: 		return (
774: 			tag === "INPUT" ||
775: 			tag === "TEXTAREA" ||
776: 			(el as HTMLElement).isContentEditable
777: 		);
778: 	}
779: 
780: 	function jumpToHeading(direction: "prev" | "next") {
781: 		const headings = document.querySelectorAll(
782: 			"article h1[id], article h2[id], article h3[id], article h4[id], article h5[id], article h6[id]",
783: 		);
784: 		if (headings.length === 0) return;
785: 		const offset = 80;
786: 		const scrollY = window.scrollY + offset;
787: 
788: 		if (direction === "next") {
789: 			for (const h of headings) {
790: 				const top = (h as HTMLElement).offsetTop;
791: 				if (top > scrollY + 5) {
792: 					window.scrollTo({ top: top - offset, behavior: "smooth" });
793: 					return;
794: 				}
795: 			}
796: 		} else {
797: 			const arr = Array.from(headings).reverse();
798: 			for (const h of arr) {
799: 				const top = (h as HTMLElement).offsetTop;
800: 				if (top < scrollY - 5) {
801: 					window.scrollTo({ top: top - offset, behavior: "smooth" });
802: 					return;
803: 				}
804: 			}
805: 		}
806: 	}

808: 	// Move the active tab by `delta` positions through the visible tab order
809: 	// ([Home, ...file tabs]), wrapping around at both ends.
810: 	function cycleTab(delta: number) {
811: 		const order = [HOME_TAB_ID, ...$tabs.map((t) => t.id)];
812: 		if (order.length <= 1) return;
813: 		const current = order.indexOf($activeTabId ?? HOME_TAB_ID);
814: 		const base = current === -1 ? 0 : current;
815: 		const next = (base + delta + order.length) % order.length;
816: 		const nextId = order[next];
817: 		if (nextId === HOME_TAB_ID) {
818: 			tabStore.goHome();
819: 		} else {
820: 			tabStore.switchTab(nextId);
821: 		}
822: 	}

824: 	function handleKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {

829: 			if ($tabs[idx]) {
830: 				tabStore.switchTab($tabs[idx].id);

832: 			return;
833: 		}
834: 
835: 		// macOS: Cmd+Shift+[ / Cmd+Shift+] cycle tabs (standard macOS convention).
836: 		// Use e.code because Shift turns "["/"]" into "{"/"}" in e.key.
837: 		if (
838: 			e.metaKey &&
839: 			e.shiftKey &&
840: 			(e.code === "BracketLeft" || e.code === "BracketRight")
841: 		) {
842: 			e.preventDefault();
843: 			cycleTab(e.code === "BracketRight" ? 1 : -1);
844: 			return;
845: 		}
846: 
847: 		// Windows/Linux: Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab (browser convention),
848: 		// and Ctrl+PageDown / Ctrl+PageUp (VS Code convention, also in Chrome).
849: 		if (
850: 			e.ctrlKey &&
851: 			(e.key === "Tab" || e.code === "PageUp" || e.code === "PageDown")
852: 		) {
853: 			e.preventDefault();
854: 			const forward =
855: 				e.key === "Tab" ? !e.shiftKey : e.code === "PageDown";
856: 			cycleTab(forward ? 1 : -1);
857: 			return;
858: 		}
859: 
860: 		// Cmd+Plus / Cmd+= zoom in (works on both macOS and Windows)
861: 		if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && (e.key === "=" || e.key === "+")) {
862: 			e.preventDefault();

864: 				...s,

868: 		}
869: 
870: 		// Cmd+Minus zoom out
871: 		if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === "-") {
872: 			e.preventDefault();

874: 				...s,

877: 			return;
878: 		}
879: 
880: 		// Cmd+0 reset zoom

882: 			e.preventDefault();
883: 			settings.update((s) => ({ ...s, fontSize: 17 }));

885: 		}

887: 		// Cmd+E toggle edit mode
888: 		if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && !e.shiftKey && e.key === "e") {
889: 			e.preventDefault();

891: 			return;
892: 		}
893: 
894: 		// Cmd+S save (works whenever the active tab has unsaved changes,

900: 			}
901: 			return;
902: 		}
903: 
904: 		// Cmd+U raw toggle (disabled in edit mode)
905: 		if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === "u") {
906: 			e.preventDefault();
907: 			handleRawToggle();
908: 			return;
909: 		}
910: 
911: 		// Cmd+T new document (blank tab, opens in the editor — #63)
912: 		if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === "t") {
913: 			e.preventDefault();
914: 			newDocument();
915: 			return;
916: 		}
917: 
918: 		// Cmd+, open settings (macOS Preferences convention)
919: 		if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === ",") {
920: 			e.preventDefault();
921: 			settingsVisible = !settingsVisible;
922: 			return;
923: 		}
924: 
925: 		// Cmd+W close tab (with dirty confirm)
926: 		if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === "w") {
927: 			e.preventDefault();

929: 			if (!t) return;
930: 			void handleCloseTab(t.id);
931: 			return;
932: 		}
933: 		if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.shiftKey && e.key === "f") {
934: 			e.preventDefault();
935: 			zenMode = !zenMode;
936: 			return;
937: 		}
938: 
939: 		// Escape — close panels, then optionally close-tab-on-ESC
940: 		if (e.key === "Escape") {
941: 			if (zenMode) {
942: 				zenMode = false;
943: 				return;
944: 			}
945: 
946: 			// Exit the Marp slideshow before any modal/close-tab handling (#44).
947: 			if (presenting) {
948: 				presenting = false;
949: 				return;
950: 			}
951: 
952: 			// Modals/overlays consume ESC first. Inner handlers stopPropagation when focus
953: 			// is inside them; this guard covers the focus-outside case (modal visible but
954: 			// user clicked elsewhere) so we don't nuke the tab while a modal is still up.
955: 			// Add new modals to `anyModalVisible` (see top of script) to keep this safe.
956: 			if (anyModalVisible) return;
957: 
958: 			// Close-on-ESC: opt-in setting. Ignore in edit mode and when an input is focused

960: 			if (
961: 				$settings.closeOnEscape &&

970: 		}
971: 
972: 		// Vim-style keys — only when no input is focused and not in edit mode
973: 		if (isInputFocused() || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
974: 		if (activeTab?.isEditing) return;
975: 		if (!$docStore.renderedHtml) return;
976: 
977: 		const now = Date.now();
978: 
979: 		switch (e.key) {
980: 			case "j":
981: 				e.preventDefault();
982: 				// Ignore OS key-repeat — the rAF loop drives continuous motion until keyup.
983: 				if (e.repeat) break;
984: 				startScroll("j");
985: 				break;
986: 			case "k":
987: 				e.preventDefault();
988: 				if (e.repeat) break;
989: 				startScroll("k");
990: 				break;
991: 			case "d":
992: 				// half page down
993: 				e.preventDefault();
994: 				window.scrollBy({
995: 					top: window.innerHeight / 2,
996: 					behavior: "smooth",
997: 				});
998: 				break;
999: 			case "u":
1000: 				// half page up
1001: 				e.preventDefault();
1002: 				window.scrollBy({
1003: 					top: -window.innerHeight / 2,
1004: 					behavior: "smooth",
1005: 				});
1006: 				break;
1007: 			case "G":
1008: 				// Shift+G — go to bottom
1009: 				e.preventDefault();
1010: 				window.scrollTo({
1011: 					top: document.body.scrollHeight,
1012: 					behavior: "smooth",
1013: 				});
1014: 				break;
1015: 			case "g":
1016: 				// gg — go to top (double tap g within 500ms)
1017: 				if (lastKey === "g" && now - lastKeyTime < 500) {
1018: 					e.preventDefault();
1019: 					window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
1020: 					lastKey = "";
1021: 					return;
1022: 				}
1023: 				break;
1024: 			case "/":
1025: 				e.preventDefault();
1026: 				searchVisible = true;
1027: 				break;
1028: 			case "n":
1029: 				// next search match (handled by SearchOverlay if visible)
1030: 				break;
1031: 			case "]":
1032: 				e.preventDefault();
1033: 				jumpToHeading("next");
1034: 				break;
1035: 			case "[":
1036: 				e.preventDefault();
1037: 				jumpToHeading("prev");
1038: 				break;
1039: 		}
1040: 
1041: 		lastKey = e.key;
1042: 		lastKeyTime = now;
1043: 	}

1045: 	function handleKeyup(e: KeyboardEvent) {
1046: 		// Stop the continuous j/k scroll loop when the key is released.
1047: 		if (e.key === "j" || e.key === "k") releaseScrollKey(e.key);

1050: 	// Sync tab switching with document store — only reads $activeTabId and $tabs
1051: 	let prevTabId: string | null = null;

1053: 	$effect(() => {
1054: 		const id = $activeTabId;
1055: 		const allTabs = $tabs;
1056: 
1057: 		// Skip if same tab
1058: 		if (id === prevTabId) return;
1059: 
1060: 		// Save reading progress for the tab we're leaving.
1061: 		// At this point in the $effect, $activeTabId has changed but the DOM still
1062: 		// shows the previous tab's content (docStore.set happens below), so
1063: 		// getCurrentSourceLine reads the correct article elements. We flush the
1064: 		// debounce to ensure nothing is lost on rapid tab switches.

1066: 			const prevTab = allTabs.find((t) => t.id === prevTabId);
1067: 			if (
1068: 				prevTab &&
1069: 				!prevTab.isEditing &&
1070: 				!prevTab.filePath.startsWith("paste://")

1079: 			}
1080: 		}
1081: 
1082: 		prevTabId = id;
1083: 
1084: 		if (!id || id === HOME_TAB_ID) {
1085: 			rawMode = false;
1086: 			presenting = false;
1087: 			splitMode = false;
1088: 			docStore.set({
1089: 				filePath: null,
1090: 				fileName: null,
1091: 				content: "",
1092: 				renderedHtml: "",
1093: 				frontmatter: null,
1094: 				wordCount: 0,
1095: 				loading: false,
1096: 				error: null,
1097: 			});
1098: 			tocVisible.set(false);
1099: 			tocEntries.set([]);
1100: 			setNativeWindowTitle("Fracta Knowledge");
1101: 			return;
1102: 		}
1103: 
1104: 		const tab = allTabs.find((t) => t.id === id);
1105: 		if (!tab) return;
1106: 
1107: 		docStore.set({
1108: 			filePath: tab.filePath,
1109: 			fileName: tab.fileName,
1110: 			content: tab.content,
1111: 			renderedHtml: tab.renderedHtml,
1112: 			frontmatter: tab.frontmatter,
1113: 			wordCount: tab.wordCount,
1114: 			loading: false,
1115: 			error: null,
1116: 		});

1118: 		// Auto-present a Marp deck on activation when the setting is on and we're not
1119: 		// mid-edit (#44). Runs once per tab switch, so an explicit exit (Esc) sticks.

1122: 			get(settings).autoPresentMarp &&
1123: 			!tab.isEditing;
1124: 
1125: 		setNativeWindowTitle(`${tab.fileName} — Fracta Knowledge`);

1127: 		const savedScroll = tab.scrollTop;

1137: 		});
1138: 	});

1140: 	// Watch for file path changes to set up watcher (only when path actually changes)
1141: 	$effect(() => {
1142: 		const path = $docStore.filePath;
1143: 		if (
1144: 			path &&
1145: 			!path.startsWith("paste://") &&
1146: 			!path.startsWith("new://") &&

1148: 		) {
1149: 			lastWatchedPath = path;
1150: 			startFileWatcher(path);
1151: 		}
1152: 	});

// =============================================================================
// 08_OWN — Knowledge workspace atoms that aren't in the fractalstyler2 registry.
//
// Design taste applied here:
//   - SHARP CORNERS (radius-0) — no radius theatre
//   - FAINT BORDERS ONLY — single hairline (border) for division, never fills
//     standing in for borders, never shadows as cosmetic edges
//   - SINGLE BREATHING SPACE — every surface sits on var(--bg); no per-region
//     tinting for sidebar/header/footer drama
//
// All atoms below are token-routed. Anything fractalstyler2 already provides
// (.box, .row, .grid-*, .card, .field, .button, .input, .select, .badge, .kbd,
// .text-*, .weight-*, .pad-*, .gap-*, .radius-*, .shadow-*, .border, .grow,
// .shrink-0, .truncate, .surface, .raised, .panel, .bg-popover, .bg-dialog,
// .fixed, .absolute, .relative, .inset-0, .z-modal, .wfull, .hfull, .min0)
// is consumed directly in markup — never redefined here.
// =============================================================================

@use '01_config' as *

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// App chrome atoms
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.logomotif
	height: 28px
	width: 28px
	filter: saturate(0)

.logotype
	height: 16px
	filter: saturate(0)

.header-nav
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-decoration: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	&:hover
		color: var(--theme-color)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Toolbar (top workspace bar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Rides .sticky + .row + .ycenter + .xbetween + .gap-xs + .pad-x-sm + .pad-y-2xs.
// The composition only adds: z-index, surface-blur backdrop, min-height, and
// bottom border. Layout itself is composed from primitives.
.surface-blur
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

.toolbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	top: var(--header-height)
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)

// Segmented control (View / Split / Edit etc.)
.mode-segmented
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 2px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0

.mode-seg
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: 100%
	padding-inline: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.tool-active
	background: var(--state-hover)
	color: var(--text-primary)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.save-dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		top: 4px
		right: 4px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin-inline: var(--space-3xs)
	align-self: center

.current-heading
	max-width: 360px

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Knowledge Library (left sidebar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The sidebar is a .box .gap-2xs. It sits on var(--bg), no surface tint.
// Its children are the only project-specific atoms here.
.sidebar-left
	width: var(--sidebar-width)
	flex-shrink: 0
	padding-top: var(--space-2xs)

.library-icon-btn
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.library-row-btn
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.library-row-remove
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
	li:hover > div > &
		opacity: 1

.library-file-btn
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tab bar
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&.tab-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over
		border-left: 2px solid var(--theme-color)

.tab-home
	min-width: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	flex-shrink: 0

.tab-close
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	.tab:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.new-tab-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	margin-bottom: 2px
	flex-shrink: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--theme-color)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dropdowns & scrim
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dropdown
	position: fixed
	width: min(92vw, 10rem)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-3xs)
	left: var(--dropdown-x, 0)
	top: var(--dropdown-y, 0)
	overflow: hidden

.dropdown-item
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.scrim
	background: transparent

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Search overlay
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.search-bar
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	right: var(--space-xs)

.search-input
	width: 220px
	padding: 2px 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	outline: none
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)
	&:focus-visible
		outline: none

.search-nav-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.search-close
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Table of contents
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.toc-sidebar
	left: 0
	top: 80px
	bottom: 0
	width: 240px

.toc-item
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-xs) + var(--toc-indent, 0px))
	padding-right: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-left: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: cursor-pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	line-height: 1.5
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.toc-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-width: 3px
		font-weight: 500
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Content / reader area
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.content-main
	padding-block: var(--space-md)
	transition: padding-inline var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.toc-spaced
		padding-left: calc(240px + var(--space-md))

.raw-source
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	white-space: pre-wrap
	overflow-x: auto
	font-size: var(--raw-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--raw-line-height, 1.6)
	max-width: var(--raw-max-width, none)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Editor — 4 stacked layers (stack, gutter, backdrop, textarea) sharing metrics
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.edit-full, .edit-split
	position: fixed
	inset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px) 0 0 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	background: var(--bg)

.edit-split
	right: 50%
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.split-preview
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	overflow-y: auto

.editor-wrap
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px)
	bottom: 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	&.editor-split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.editor-stack
	max-width: var(--editor-max-width, 100%)

.editor,
.editor-backdrop,
.editor-gutter
	position: absolute
	inset: 0
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-md)
	border: none
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	tab-size: 2
	-moz-tab-size: 2
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-wrap: break-word
	overflow-wrap: break-word
	box-sizing: border-box
	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)

.editor
	background: transparent
	outline: none
	resize: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	z-index: 1
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-backdrop
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	z-index: 0

.editor.with-gutter,
.editor-backdrop.with-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))

.editor-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	overflow: hidden
	z-index: 0
	counter-reset: gl
	.gl
		counter-increment: gl
		position: relative
	.gl.active
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 3%, transparent)
	.gl.active::before
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		font-weight: 500
	.gl::before
		content: counter(gl)
		position: absolute
		left: calc(-1 * var(--gutter-w))
		width: calc(var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-2xs))
		text-align: right
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-stack.with-gutter::before
	content: ""
	position: absolute
	left: 0
	top: 0
	bottom: 0
	width: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-3xs))
	border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 1%, transparent)
	z-index: 0
	pointer-events: none

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-highlight
	color: transparent
	background-color: var(--warning)
	border-radius: 0

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-active
	color: transparent !important
	background-color: var(--danger) !important

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// EmptyState (home / recents / plans / folders)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.empty-root
	max-width: 1040px
	margin: 0 auto
	min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height) - var(--space-md))

.icon-44
	width: 44px
	height: 44px

.empty-card-scroll
	max-height: 300px
	overflow-y: auto

.mta
	margin-top: auto

.empty-zoom-label
	min-width: 32px
	text-align: center

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dialog shells — backdrop, card, header, body, footer, tabs, items
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dialog-backdrop
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 25%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(3px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px)

.dialog-card
	overflow: hidden

.dialog-header
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.dialog-footer
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	background: transparent

.dialog-body
	overflow-y: auto

// Dialog sizes — token-driven: cap to 92vw, scale with user font.
$dialog-sizes: (sm: 22rem, md: 30rem, lg: 38rem, xl: 46rem)
@each $name, $size in $dialog-sizes
	.dialog-#{$name}
		width: min(92vw, #{$size})
		max-width: 100%

.dialog-h-fit
	max-height: min(90vh, 56rem)

.dialog-h-screen
	max-height: 80vh

.dialog-content-flex
	min-height: 12rem
	max-height: 50vh

.dialog-tab
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-bottom: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.dialog-tab-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-bottom-color: var(--theme-color)

.dialog-content
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.file-item
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.file-item-nested
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-sm) + var(--space-md))

.folder-header
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.folder-chevron
	transition: transform var(--motion-fast) ease
	&.folder-chevron-open
		transform: rotate(90deg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Custom-prompt modal + settings dialog
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.field-label
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.selection-box
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	max-height: 120px
	overflow-y: auto
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-break: break-word

.prompt-input
	resize: vertical
	line-height: 1.45

.field-error-row
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent)

.settings-section
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	&:last-of-type
		border-bottom: none

.settings-row
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.settings-switch
	width: 18px
	height: 18px
	accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	cursor: pointer

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Paste modal — mode tabs, textarea, url-hints list
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.mode-tabs
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)

.mode-tab
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-tab-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.modal-textarea-h
	height: 240px
	resize: none

.url-hints
	border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	code
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		padding: 1px 4px
		background: var(--bg)
		border-radius: 0
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	ul
		line-height: 1.5

.reset-list
	list-style: none
	padding: 0
	margin: 0

.reset-list-pad-md
	list-style: none
	padding-left: var(--space-md)
	margin: 0

.list-disc
	list-style: disc

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// AILookup settings — provider rows, prompt rows, edit forms
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.provider-favicon
	width: 16px
	height: 16px
	flex-shrink: 0
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.provider-favicon-img
	width: 16px
	height: 16px
	object-fit: contain

.icon-chevron-slot
	width: 14px
	display: inline-flex
	justify-content: center

.provider-actions
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	.provider-row:hover &
		opacity: 1

.prompt-actions
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	.prompt-row:hover &
		opacity: 1

.dashed-action
	border-style: dashed

.align-self-start
	align-self: flex-start

.m-top-2xs
	margin-top: var(--space-2xs)

.m-top-3xs
	margin-top: var(--space-3xs)

.m-y-3xs
	margin-block: var(--space-3xs)

.pad-left-lg
	padding-left: var(--space-lg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Status chrome — progress bar, status bar, frontmatter, scroll-top, toast
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.progress-bar
	position: fixed
	top: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	height: 3px
	background: var(--theme-color)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	width: var(--progress, 0%)
	transition: width 0.1s linear
	pointer-events: none

.status-bar
	position: fixed
	bottom: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.fm-bar
	max-width: min(100%, 720px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	gap: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)

.scroll-top
	position: fixed
	bottom: var(--space-lg)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	width: 36px
	height: 36px
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	opacity: 0.7
	&:hover
		opacity: 1
		background: var(--state-hover)

.toast-stack
	position: fixed
	bottom: 96px
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-toast)
	max-width: 360px

.toast
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	animation: slideUp var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)

@keyframes slideUp
	from
		opacity: 0
		transform: translateY(8px)
	to
		opacity: 1
		transform: translateY(0)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Drop zone — drag-over overlay
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dropzone
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 8%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(2px)
	pointer-events: none

.border-theme
	border-color: var(--theme-color)
	border-style: dashed

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Marp presentation
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.present-root
	background: #0e0e10

.present-close
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: var(--control-h-lg)
	height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: 0
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)

.present-nav
	width: 44px
	height: 44px
	border-radius: 0
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.25

.present-stage
	width: min(100%, calc((100vh - 96px) * 16 / 9))

.present-slide
	padding: 6% 8%
	:global(.md-content)
		max-width: none !important
		margin: 0 !important
		padding: 0 !important

.present-counter
	right: var(--space-xs)
	bottom: var(--space-xs)
	padding: 2px var(--space-2xs)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 4%, transparent)
	border-radius: 0

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Reader controls popover
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.rc-panel
	right: var(--space-xs)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	width: min(92vw, 16rem)

.rc-segmented
	border-radius: 0
	overflow: hidden

.rc-seg-btn
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	background: var(--bg)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
	&.rc-seg-active
		background: var(--theme-color)
		color: var(--text-inverse)

.rc-range
	height: 4px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-radius: 0
	-webkit-appearance: none
	appearance: none
	outline: none
	&::-webkit-slider-thumb
		-webkit-appearance: none
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: 0
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg)
	&::-moz-range-thumb
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: 0
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Markdown content (rendered article) — descendant of .md-content
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.md-content
	color: var(--text-primary)
	max-width: var(--content-max, 760px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding-block: var(--space-md)
	padding-inline: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--md-font-family, inherit)
	font-size: inherit
	transition: max-width var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out), font-size var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out), font-family var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	line-height: 1.65
	> * + *
		margin-top: var(--space-sm)
	h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6
		line-height: 1.25
		font-weight: 600
		color: var(--text-primary)
		letter-spacing: -0.01em
		margin-top: var(--space-md)
		&:first-child
			margin-top: 0
	h1
		font-size: 1.85em
		font-weight: 700
		letter-spacing: -0.02em
		margin-top: 1.5em
	h2
		font-size: 1.5em
		margin-top: 1.25em
	h3
		font-size: 1.2em
		margin-top: 1.1em
	h4
		font-size: 1em
	p, ul, ol, blockquote
		margin-block: var(--space-sm)
	pre
		border-radius: 0
		padding: 1em 1.2em
		overflow-x: auto
		font-size: 0.8em
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle) !important
		color: var(--text-primary) !important
		position: relative
	code
		font-family: var(--font-mono)
	:not(pre) > code
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		padding: 0.15em 0.4em
		border-radius: 0
		font-size: 0.85em
		color: var(--theme-color-alt)
		&::before, &::after
			content: none
	table
		border-collapse: collapse
		width: 100%
		overflow-x: auto
		display: block
		font-size: 0.9em
	th, td
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		padding: 0.5em 0.75em
		text-align: left
	th
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		font-weight: 600
		font-size: 0.9em
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	blockquote
		border-left: 3px solid var(--theme-color)
		padding-left: 1em
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	img
		max-width: 100%
		height: auto
		border-radius: 0
	hr
		border: none
		border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
		margin: 2.5em 0
	.task-list-item
		list-style: none
		margin-left: -1.5em
		input[type='checkbox']
			margin-right: var(--space-2xs)
			accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	a
		color: var(--theme-color)
		text-decoration: none
		&:hover
			text-decoration: underline
	.code-copy-btn
		position: absolute
		top: 8px
		right: 8px
		padding: 3px 10px
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		font-weight: 500
		font-family: var(--font-sans)
		color: var(--text-muted)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 80%, transparent)
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		border-radius: 0
		cursor: pointer
		opacity: 0
		transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
		z-index: 2
		backdrop-filter: blur(4px)
		&:hover
			background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 95%, transparent)
			color: var(--text-primary)
	pre:hover .code-copy-btn
		opacity: 1
	.mermaid-diagram
		overflow-x: auto
		svg
			max-width: 100%
			height: auto
	.katex-display
		overflow-x: auto
		padding: 0.5em 0
	.katex
		font-size: 1.1em

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Search highlight + link tooltip (viewer layer)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mark.mdv-search-highlight
	background-color: var(--warning)
	color: inherit
	padding: 1px 0
	border-radius: 0

mark.mdv-search-active
	background-color: var(--danger) !important
	color: var(--text-inverse) !important

.link-tooltip
	display: none
	position: fixed
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	max-width: 400px
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	pointer-events: none

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Error card (loading / error states)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.error-card
	width: min(100%, 30rem)


.max-w-measure
	max-width: min(100%, 45rem)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Print — hide workspace chrome, keep only the article
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@media print
	.toolbar, .tabbar, .search-bar, .rc-panel,
	.toast-stack, .status-bar, .toc-sidebar, .scroll-top,
	.dialog-backdrop, .modal-backdrop, .dropzone, .lightbox,
	.app-header, .app-footer, .sidebar-left, .progress-bar
		display: none !important

// =============================================================================
// 08_OWN — Knowledge workspace atoms that aren't in the fractalstyler2 registry.
//
// Design taste applied here:
//   - SHARP CORNERS (radius-0) — no radius theatre
//   - FAINT BORDERS ONLY — single hairline (border) for division, never fills
//     standing in for borders, never shadows as cosmetic edges
//   - SINGLE BREATHING SPACE — every surface sits on var(--bg); no per-region
//     tinting for sidebar/header/footer drama
//
// All atoms below are token-routed. Anything fractalstyler2 already provides
// (.box, .row, .grid-*, .card, .field, .button, .input, .select, .badge, .kbd,
// .text-*, .weight-*, .pad-*, .gap-*, .radius-*, .shadow-*, .border, .grow,
// .shrink-0, .truncate, .surface, .raised, .panel, .bg-popover, .bg-dialog,
// .fixed, .absolute, .relative, .inset-0, .z-modal, .wfull, .hfull, .min0)
// is consumed directly in markup — never redefined here.
// =============================================================================

@use '01_config' as *

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// App chrome atoms
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.logomotif
	height: 28px
	width: 28px
	filter: saturate(0)

.logotype
	height: 16px
	filter: saturate(0)

.header-nav
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-decoration: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	&:hover
		color: var(--theme-color)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Toolbar (top workspace bar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Rides .sticky + .row + .ycenter + .xbetween + .gap-xs + .pad-x-sm + .pad-y-2xs.
// The composition only adds: z-index, surface-blur backdrop, min-height, and
// bottom border. Layout itself is composed from primitives.
.surface-blur
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

.toolbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	top: var(--header-height)
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)

// Segmented control (View / Split / Edit etc.)
.mode-segmented
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 2px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0

.mode-seg
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: 100%
	padding-inline: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.tool-active
	background: var(--state-hover)
	color: var(--text-primary)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.save-dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		top: 4px
		right: 4px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin-inline: var(--space-3xs)
	align-self: center

.current-heading
	max-width: 360px

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Knowledge Library (left sidebar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The sidebar is a .box .gap-2xs. It sits on var(--bg), no surface tint.
// Its children are the only project-specific atoms here.
.sidebar-left
	width: var(--sidebar-width)
	flex-shrink: 0
	padding-top: var(--space-2xs)

.library-icon-btn
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.library-row-btn
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.library-row-remove
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
	li:hover > div > &
		opacity: 1

.library-file-btn
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tab bar
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&.tab-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over
		border-left: 2px solid var(--theme-color)

.tab-home
	min-width: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	flex-shrink: 0

.tab-close
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	.tab:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.new-tab-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	margin-bottom: 2px
	flex-shrink: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--theme-color)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dropdowns & scrim
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dropdown
	position: fixed
	width: min(92vw, 10rem)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-3xs)
	left: var(--dropdown-x, 0)
	top: var(--dropdown-y, 0)
	overflow: hidden

.dropdown-item
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.scrim
	background: transparent

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Search overlay
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.search-bar
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	right: var(--space-xs)

.search-input
	width: 220px
	padding: 2px 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	outline: none
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)
	&:focus-visible
		outline: none

.search-nav-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.search-close
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Table of contents
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.toc-sidebar
	left: 0
	top: 80px
	bottom: 0
	width: 240px

.toc-item
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-xs) + var(--toc-indent, 0px))
	padding-right: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-left: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: cursor-pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	line-height: 1.5
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.toc-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-width: 3px
		font-weight: 500
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Content / reader area
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.content-main
	padding-block: var(--space-md)
	transition: padding-inline var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.toc-spaced
		padding-left: calc(240px + var(--space-md))

.raw-source
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	white-space: pre-wrap
	overflow-x: auto
	font-size: var(--raw-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--raw-line-height, 1.6)
	max-width: var(--raw-max-width, none)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Editor — 4 stacked layers (stack, gutter, backdrop, textarea) sharing metrics
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.edit-full, .edit-split
	position: fixed
	inset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px) 0 0 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	background: var(--bg)

.edit-split
	right: 50%
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.split-preview
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	overflow-y: auto

.editor-wrap
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px)
	bottom: 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	&.editor-split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.editor-stack
	max-width: var(--editor-max-width, 100%)

.editor,
.editor-backdrop,
.editor-gutter
	position: absolute
	inset: 0
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-md)
	border: none
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	tab-size: 2
	-moz-tab-size: 2
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-wrap: break-word
	overflow-wrap: break-word
	box-sizing: border-box
	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))

1. **`.box` / `.row`** for vertical/horizontal flow. `.grid-1..6` for grid stepping. Reach for these first.

const root = '/Users/amrit/fractalmandala/fracta-era1';

// Step 1: delete the entire observatory-styles directory (dead files referencing deleted partial)
const r1 = await bash(`rm -rf ${root}/src/lib/observatory-styles && ls ${root}/src/lib/ | grep observatory`, 'delete dead styles', root);
console.log(r1.stdout.text);

// Step 2: strip <style>...</style> blocks from all 12 components that have them
const sweep = [
  'const fs = require("fs");',
  'const path = require("path");',
  'const root = process.argv[2];',
  '',
  'function walk(dir) {',
  '  const out = [];',
  '  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {',
  '    const p = path.join(dir, e.name);',
  '    if (e.isDirectory()) out.push(...walk(p));',
  '    else if (e.name.endsWith(".svelte")) out.push(p);',
  '  }',
  '  return out;',
  '}',
  '',
  'const files = walk(path.join(root, "src/lib/observatory-components"));',
  'let stripped = 0;',
  'for (const f of files) {',
  '  let c = fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8");',
  '  const before = c.length;',
  '  // Strip <style>...</style> blocks (greedy multiline)',
  '  c = c.replace(/\\n*\\s*<style>[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>\\s*\\n*/g, "\\n");',
  '  // Strip leading blank lines if any',
  '  c = c.replace(/\\n\\s*\\n\\s*\\n+/g, "\\n\\n");',
  '  if (c.length !== before) {',
  '    fs.writeFileSync(f, c);',
  '    stripped++;',
  '  }',
  '}',
  'console.log("stripped", stripped, "of", files.length, "files");',
].join("\n");
await write('/tmp/strip.js', sweep);
const r2 = await bash(`node /tmp/strip.js ${root}`, 'strip styles', root);
console.log(r2.stdout.text);

const inline = [
  'const fs = require("fs");',
  'const path = require("path");',
  'const root = process.argv[2];',
  '',
  'function walk(dir) {',
  '  const out = [];',
  '  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {',

  '  }',
  '  return out;',
  '}',
  '',
  'const files = walk(path.join(root, "src/lib/observatory-components"));',
  'let kept = 0, hardcoded = [];',

  '  const c = fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8");',
  '  const re = /style="([^"]*)"/g;',
  '  let m;',

I see — the **graph and shell components use bespoke class names AND heavy inline styles** for the graph/treemap rendering. This is **data visualization** — the XYFlow library, SVG treemap rectangles with `fill`, etc. These aren't stylable through fractalstyler2 because they're **dynamic computed values** (graph positions, computed colors from risk score). The system can't (and shouldn't) carry those.

Strategy:
- For **presentational shell** (headers, sidebars, layouts) → fractalstyler2 primitives
- For **graph/canvas rendering** (XYFlow nodes, SVG, computed heatmap colors) → keep dynamic `style=""` for what must be dynamic, but the *chrome around* them uses the system
- For **borders/radii on graph elements** → push to `_08_own.sass`

Let me rewrite them with this principle. Start with the simpler ones:
