// =============================================================================
// 08_OWN — Knowledge workspace atoms that aren't in the fractalstyler2 registry.
//
// Design taste applied here:
//   - SHARP CORNERS (radius-0) — no radius theatre
//   - FAINT BORDERS ONLY — single hairline (border) for division, never fills
//     standing in for borders, never shadows as cosmetic edges
//   - SINGLE BREATHING SPACE — every surface sits on var(--bg); no per-region
//     tinting for sidebar/header/footer drama
//
// All atoms below are token-routed. Anything fractalstyler2 already provides
// (.box, .row, .grid-*, .card, .field, .button, .input, .select, .badge, .kbd,
// .text-*, .weight-*, .pad-*, .gap-*, .radius-*, .shadow-*, .border, .grow,
// .shrink-0, .truncate, .surface, .raised, .panel, .bg-popover, .bg-dialog,
// .fixed, .absolute, .relative, .inset-0, .z-modal, .wfull, .hfull, .min0)
// is consumed directly in markup — never redefined here.
// =============================================================================

@use '01_config' as *

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// App chrome atoms
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.logomotif
	height: 28px
	width: 28px
	filter: saturate(0)

.logotype
	height: 16px
	filter: saturate(0)

.header-nav
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-decoration: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	&:hover
		color: var(--theme-color)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Toolbar (top workspace bar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Rides .sticky + .row + .ycenter + .xbetween + .gap-xs + .pad-x-sm + .pad-y-2xs.
// The composition only adds: z-index, surface-blur backdrop, min-height, and
// bottom border. Layout itself is composed from primitives.
.surface-blur
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

.toolbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	top: var(--header-height)
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)

// Segmented control (View / Split / Edit etc.)
.mode-segmented
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 2px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0

.mode-seg
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: 100%
	padding-inline: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.tool-active
	background: var(--state-hover)
	color: var(--text-primary)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.save-dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		top: 4px
		right: 4px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin-inline: var(--space-3xs)
	align-self: center

.current-heading
	max-width: 360px

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Knowledge Library (left sidebar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The sidebar is a .box .gap-2xs. It sits on var(--bg), no surface tint.
// Its children are the only project-specific atoms here.
.sidebar-left
	width: var(--sidebar-width)
	flex-shrink: 0
	padding-top: var(--space-2xs)

.library-icon-btn
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.library-row-btn
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.library-row-remove
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
	li:hover > div > &
		opacity: 1

.library-file-btn
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tab bar
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&.tab-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over
		border-left: 2px solid var(--theme-color)

.tab-home
	min-width: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	flex-shrink: 0

.tab-close
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	.tab:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.new-tab-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	margin-bottom: 2px
	flex-shrink: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--theme-color)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dropdowns & scrim
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dropdown
	position: fixed
	width: min(92vw, 10rem)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-3xs)
	left: var(--dropdown-x, 0)
	top: var(--dropdown-y, 0)
	overflow: hidden

.dropdown-item
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.scrim
	background: transparent

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Search overlay
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.search-bar
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	right: var(--space-xs)

.search-input
	width: 220px
	padding: 2px 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	outline: none
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)
	&:focus-visible
		outline: none

.search-nav-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.search-close
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Table of contents
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.toc-sidebar
	left: 0
	top: 80px
	bottom: 0
	width: 240px

.toc-item
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-xs) + var(--toc-indent, 0px))
	padding-right: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-left: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: cursor-pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	line-height: 1.5
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.toc-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-width: 3px
		font-weight: 500
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Content / reader area
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.content-main
	padding-block: var(--space-md)
	transition: padding-inline var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.toc-spaced
		padding-left: calc(240px + var(--space-md))

.raw-source
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	white-space: pre-wrap
	overflow-x: auto
	font-size: var(--raw-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--raw-line-height, 1.6)
	max-width: var(--raw-max-width, none)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Editor — 4 stacked layers (stack, gutter, backdrop, textarea) sharing metrics
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.edit-full, .edit-split
	position: fixed
	inset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px) 0 0 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	background: var(--bg)

.edit-split
	right: 50%
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.split-preview
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	overflow-y: auto

.editor-wrap
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px)
	bottom: 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	&.editor-split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.editor-stack
	max-width: var(--editor-max-width, 100%)

.editor,
.editor-backdrop,
.editor-gutter
	position: absolute
	inset: 0
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-md)
	border: none
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	tab-size: 2
	-moz-tab-size: 2
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-wrap: break-word
	overflow-wrap: break-word
	box-sizing: border-box
	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)

.editor
	background: transparent
	outline: none
	resize: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	z-index: 1
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-backdrop
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	z-index: 0

.editor.with-gutter,
.editor-backdrop.with-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))

.editor-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	overflow: hidden
	z-index: 0
	counter-reset: gl
	.gl
		counter-increment: gl
		position: relative
	.gl.active
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 3%, transparent)
	.gl.active::before
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		font-weight: 500
	.gl::before
		content: counter(gl)
		position: absolute
		left: calc(-1 * var(--gutter-w))
		width: calc(var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-2xs))
		text-align: right
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-stack.with-gutter::before
	content: ""
	position: absolute
	left: 0
	top: 0
	bottom: 0
	width: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-3xs))
	border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 1%, transparent)
	z-index: 0
	pointer-events: none

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-highlight
	color: transparent
	background-color: var(--warning)
	border-radius: 0

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-active
	color: transparent !important
	background-color: var(--danger) !important

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// EmptyState (home / recents / plans / folders)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.empty-root
	max-width: 1040px
	margin: 0 auto
	min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height) - var(--space-md))

.icon-44
	width: 44px
	height: 44px

.empty-card-scroll
	max-height: 300px
	overflow-y: auto

.mta
	margin-top: auto

.empty-zoom-label
	min-width: 32px
	text-align: center

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dialog shells — backdrop, card, header, body, footer, tabs, items
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dialog-backdrop
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 25%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(3px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px)

.dialog-card
	overflow: hidden

.dialog-header
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.dialog-footer
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	background: transparent

.dialog-body
	overflow-y: auto

// Dialog sizes — token-driven: cap to 92vw, scale with user font.
$dialog-sizes: (sm: 22rem, md: 30rem, lg: 38rem, xl: 46rem)
@each $name, $size in $dialog-sizes
	.dialog-#{$name}
		width: min(92vw, #{$size})
		max-width: 100%

.dialog-h-fit
	max-height: min(90vh, 56rem)

.dialog-h-screen
	max-height: 80vh

.dialog-content-flex
	min-height: 12rem
	max-height: 50vh

.dialog-tab
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-bottom: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.dialog-tab-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-bottom-color: var(--theme-color)

.dialog-content
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.file-item
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.file-item-nested
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-sm) + var(--space-md))

.folder-header
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.folder-chevron
	transition: transform var(--motion-fast) ease
	&.folder-chevron-open
		transform: rotate(90deg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Custom-prompt modal + settings dialog
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.field-label
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.selection-box
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	max-height: 120px
	overflow-y: auto
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-break: break-word

.prompt-input
	resize: vertical
	line-height: 1.45

.field-error-row
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent)

.settings-section
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	&:last-of-type
		border-bottom: none

.settings-row
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.settings-switch
	width: 18px
	height: 18px
	accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	cursor: pointer

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Paste modal — mode tabs, textarea, url-hints list
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.mode-tabs
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)

.mode-tab
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-tab-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.modal-textarea-h
	height: 240px
	resize: none

.url-hints
	border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	code
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		padding: 1px 4px
		background: var(--bg)
		border-radius: 0
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	ul
		line-height: 1.5

.reset-list
	list-style: none
	padding: 0
	margin: 0

.reset-list-pad-md
	list-style: none
	padding-left: var(--space-md)
	margin: 0

.list-disc
	list-style: disc

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// AILookup settings — provider rows, prompt rows, edit forms
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.provider-favicon
	width: 16px
	height: 16px
	flex-shrink: 0
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.provider-favicon-img
	width: 16px
	height: 16px
	object-fit: contain

.icon-chevron-slot
	width: 14px
	display: inline-flex
	justify-content: center

.provider-actions
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	.provider-row:hover &
		opacity: 1

.prompt-actions
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	.prompt-row:hover &
		opacity: 1

.dashed-action
	border-style: dashed

.align-self-start
	align-self: flex-start

.m-top-2xs
	margin-top: var(--space-2xs)

.m-top-3xs
	margin-top: var(--space-3xs)

.m-y-3xs
	margin-block: var(--space-3xs)

.pad-left-lg
	padding-left: var(--space-lg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Status chrome — progress bar, status bar, frontmatter, scroll-top, toast
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.progress-bar
	position: fixed
	top: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	height: 3px
	background: var(--theme-color)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	width: var(--progress, 0%)
	transition: width 0.1s linear
	pointer-events: none

.status-bar
	position: fixed
	bottom: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.fm-bar
	max-width: min(100%, 720px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	gap: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)

.scroll-top
	position: fixed
	bottom: var(--space-lg)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	width: 36px
	height: 36px
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	opacity: 0.7
	&:hover
		opacity: 1
		background: var(--state-hover)

.toast-stack
	position: fixed
	bottom: 96px
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-toast)
	max-width: 360px

.toast
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	animation: slideUp var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)

@keyframes slideUp
	from
		opacity: 0
		transform: translateY(8px)
	to
		opacity: 1
		transform: translateY(0)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Drop zone — drag-over overlay
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dropzone
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 8%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(2px)
	pointer-events: none

.border-theme
	border-color: var(--theme-color)
	border-style: dashed

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Marp presentation
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.present-root
	background: #0e0e10

.present-close
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: var(--control-h-lg)
	height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: 0
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)

.present-nav
	width: 44px
	height: 44px
	border-radius: 0
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.25

.present-stage
	width: min(100%, calc((100vh - 96px) * 16 / 9))

.present-slide
	padding: 6% 8%
	:global(.md-content)
		max-width: none !important
		margin: 0 !important
		padding: 0 !important

.present-counter
	right: var(--space-xs)
	bottom: var(--space-xs)
	padding: 2px var(--space-2xs)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 4%, transparent)
	border-radius: 0

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Reader controls popover
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.rc-panel
	right: var(--space-xs)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	width: min(92vw, 16rem)

.rc-segmented
	border-radius: 0
	overflow: hidden

.rc-seg-btn
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	background: var(--bg)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
	&.rc-seg-active
		background: var(--theme-color)
		color: var(--text-inverse)

.rc-range
	height: 4px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-radius: 0
	-webkit-appearance: none
	appearance: none
	outline: none
	&::-webkit-slider-thumb
		-webkit-appearance: none
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: 0
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg)
	&::-moz-range-thumb
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: 0
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Markdown content (rendered article) — descendant of .md-content
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.md-content
	color: var(--text-primary)
	max-width: var(--content-max, 760px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding-block: var(--space-md)
	padding-inline: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--md-font-family, inherit)
	font-size: inherit
	transition: max-width var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out), font-size var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out), font-family var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	line-height: 1.65
	> * + *
		margin-top: var(--space-sm)
	h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6
		line-height: 1.25
		font-weight: 600
		color: var(--text-primary)
		letter-spacing: -0.01em
		margin-top: var(--space-md)
		&:first-child
			margin-top: 0
	h1
		font-size: 1.85em
		font-weight: 700
		letter-spacing: -0.02em
		margin-top: 1.5em
	h2
		font-size: 1.5em
		margin-top: 1.25em
	h3
		font-size: 1.2em
		margin-top: 1.1em
	h4
		font-size: 1em
	p, ul, ol, blockquote
		margin-block: var(--space-sm)
	pre
		border-radius: 0
		padding: 1em 1.2em
		overflow-x: auto
		font-size: 0.8em
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle) !important
		color: var(--text-primary) !important
		position: relative
	code
		font-family: var(--font-mono)
	:not(pre) > code
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		padding: 0.15em 0.4em
		border-radius: 0
		font-size: 0.85em
		color: var(--theme-color-alt)
		&::before, &::after
			content: none
	table
		border-collapse: collapse
		width: 100%
		overflow-x: auto
		display: block
		font-size: 0.9em
	th, td
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		padding: 0.5em 0.75em
		text-align: left
	th
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		font-weight: 600
		font-size: 0.9em
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	blockquote
		border-left: 3px solid var(--theme-color)
		padding-left: 1em
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	img
		max-width: 100%
		height: auto
		border-radius: 0
	hr
		border: none
		border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
		margin: 2.5em 0
	.task-list-item
		list-style: none
		margin-left: -1.5em
		input[type='checkbox']
			margin-right: var(--space-2xs)
			accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	a
		color: var(--theme-color)
		text-decoration: none
		&:hover
			text-decoration: underline
	.code-copy-btn
		position: absolute
		top: 8px
		right: 8px
		padding: 3px 10px
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		font-weight: 500
		font-family: var(--font-sans)
		color: var(--text-muted)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 80%, transparent)
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		border-radius: 0
		cursor: pointer
		opacity: 0
		transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
		z-index: 2
		backdrop-filter: blur(4px)
		&:hover
			background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 95%, transparent)
			color: var(--text-primary)
	pre:hover .code-copy-btn
		opacity: 1
	.mermaid-diagram
		overflow-x: auto
		svg
			max-width: 100%
			height: auto
	.katex-display
		overflow-x: auto
		padding: 0.5em 0
	.katex
		font-size: 1.1em

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Search highlight + link tooltip (viewer layer)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mark.mdv-search-highlight
	background-color: var(--warning)
	color: inherit
	padding: 1px 0
	border-radius: 0

mark.mdv-search-active
	background-color: var(--danger) !important
	color: var(--text-inverse) !important

.link-tooltip
	display: none
	position: fixed
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	max-width: 400px
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	pointer-events: none

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Error card (loading / error states)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.error-card
	width: min(100%, 30rem)


.max-w-measure
	max-width: min(100%, 45rem)


// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Observatory — workspace chrome for the analytics view.
// All atoms here are pure compositions of fractalstyler2 primitives + tokens.
// The data viz itself (graph, treemap, canvas) reads its own --vars.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// --- Observatory shell chrome ---
.observatory-header
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	top: var(--header-height)

.observatory-tab
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 0 var(--space-sm)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	border-bottom: 2px solid transparent
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&.observatory-tab-active
		color: var(--text-primary)
		border-bottom-color: var(--theme-color)

.observatory-sidebar
	width: 280px
	flex-shrink: 0

// --- Sidebar atoms (left rail) ---
.sidebar-tab
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	&.sidebar-tab-active
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 500

.metric-tile
	box ycenter xcenter gap-3xs
	text-center
	&.metric-tile-num
		font-size: var(--text-md)
		font-weight: 600
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.metric-tile-lbl
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		color: var(--text-muted)

// --- Day card (logs list) ---
.day-card
	background: transparent
	border: 1px solid transparent
	&.day-card-active
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		border-color: var(--border)

// Day-stat color tiers (the only color commentary in the logs view)
.day-stat
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	padding: 2px var(--space-3xs)
	border-radius: 0
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
.day-stat-commits
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--success)
.day-stat-sessions
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--theme-color)
.day-stat-browsing
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--info) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--info)

// --- Calendar cell (logs calendar) ---
.cal-card
	min-height: 280px
.cal-weekdays
	margin-bottom: var(--space-3xs)
	span
		padding: var(--space-3xs) 0
.cal-cell
	min-height: 32px
	background: transparent
	border: 1px solid transparent
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&.cal-cell-active
		background: var(--bg-raised)
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
	&.cal-cell-empty
		visibility: hidden

.cal-cell-activity
	.cal-dot
		display: inline-block
		width: 5px
		height: 5px
		border-radius: 0

.cal-dot-commit
	background: var(--success)
.cal-dot-agent
	background: var(--theme-color)
.cal-dot-browse
	background: var(--info)

// --- Filter tab active state ---
.button-primary
	background: var(--theme-color)
	color: var(--text-inverse)
	border-color: var(--theme-color)

// --- Status dot (footer) ---
.status-dot
	width: 8px
	height: 8px
	border-radius: 0
	background: var(--text-muted)
	display: inline-block
	&.status-dot-ok, .status-dot.ok
		background: var(--success)

// --- App header (observatory chrome) ---
.appheader-active
	color: var(--theme-color)

// --- BoxNode (graph canvas) ---
.boxnode
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	overflow: hidden
	position: relative
	transition: border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
.boxnode-header
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	min-width: 0
.boxnode-label
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap
	font-weight: 500
.boxnode-chev
	width: 18px
	height: 18px
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
.boxnode-ic, .boxnode-dot
	width: 14px
	height: 14px
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
.boxnode-dot
	width: 6px
	height: 6px
	border-radius: 50%
	background: var(--text-muted)
.boxnode-badge
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	gap: 2px
	font-size: var(--text-3xs)
	padding: 1px var(--space-3xs)
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
.boxnode-u
	color: var(--text-muted)
.boxnode-rolled
	font-size: var(--text-3xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	padding: 0 var(--space-xs)
.boxnode-collapsed
	background: var(--bg-raised)
.boxnode-leaf
	background: var(--bg)
.boxnode-lane
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-style: dashed
	border-color: var(--border)
.boxnode-dim
	opacity: 0.25
.boxnode-match
	border-color: var(--theme-color)
	border-width: 2px
.boxnode-step
	border-color: var(--theme-color)
.boxnode-stepno
	position: absolute
	top: 4px
	right: 4px
	font-size: var(--text-3xs)
	font-weight: 600
	color: var(--theme-color)
.boxnode-selected
	border-color: var(--theme-color)
	border-width: 2px
	box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 20%, transparent)

// Kind-coloring via HSL hue var
.boxnode-kind-stylesheet
	border-left: 3px solid hsl(var(--hue, 210), 70%, 60%)
.boxnode-kind-style
	border-left: 3px solid hsl(var(--hue, 210), 70%, 60%)
.boxnode-kind-token
	border-left: 3px solid hsl(var(--hue, 210), 70%, 60%)
.boxnode-kind-component
	border-left: 3px solid hsl(var(--hue, 210), 70%, 60%)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, hsl(var(--hue, 210), 70%, 60%) 6%, var(--bg))
.boxnode-kind-layer
	border-left: 3px solid hsl(var(--hue, 210), 70%, 60%)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, hsl(var(--hue, 210), 70%, 60%) 6%, var(--bg))
.boxnode-kind-model
	border-left: 3px solid hsl(var(--hue, 210), 70%, 60%)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, hsl(var(--hue, 210), 70%, 60%) 6%, var(--bg))
.boxnode-kind-file
	background: color-mix(in srgb, hsl(var(--hue, 210), 70%, 60%) 6%, var(--bg))
.boxnode-kind-stylesheet
	background: color-mix(in srgb, hsl(var(--hue, 210), 70%, 60%) 6%, var(--bg))

// --- Graph canvas shell ---
.graph-canvas
	background: var(--bg)
.graph-computing
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-raised)

// --- Treemap canvas ---
.treemap-canvas
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
.treemap-svg
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	overflow: hidden
.treemap-group-box
	fill: var(--bg-raised)
	stroke: var(--border)
	stroke-width: 1
.treemap-group-label
	fill: var(--text-muted)
	font-size: 10px
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
.treemap-file-box
	fill-opacity: 0.2
	stroke-width: 1.5
	cursor: pointer
	transition: stroke-opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
.treemap-file-label
	fill: var(--text-primary)
	font-size: 9px
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	pointer-events: none

// Heatmap color tiers (routed through tokens)
.treemap-tier-low .treemap-file-box
	fill: var(--success)
	stroke: var(--success)
.treemap-tier-mid .treemap-file-box
	fill: var(--warning)
	stroke: var(--warning)
.treemap-tier-high .treemap-file-box
	fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 50%, var(--danger))
	stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 50%, var(--danger))
.treemap-tier-peak .treemap-file-box
	fill: var(--danger)
	stroke: var(--danger)
.treemap-match .treemap-file-box
	stroke-width: 3
	stroke: var(--theme-color)
.treemap-selected .treemap-file-box
	stroke-width: 3
	stroke: var(--theme-color)
.treemap-legend-bar
	width: 80px
	height: 8px
	background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--success), var(--warning), var(--danger))
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
.treemap-legend-label
	color: var(--text-muted)

// --- Flow player ---
.flow-player
	background: var(--bg)
	max-width: min(100%, 32rem)
.trigger-code
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	padding: 2px var(--space-3xs)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)

// --- Node inspector ---
.node-inspector
	width: 360px
	flex-shrink: 0
	max-height: 100%
.inspector-field
	background: var(--bg)
.inspector-metric
	background: var(--bg)
	padding: var(--space-2xs)
	border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	text-align: center

// --- Observatory project shell (canvas + sidebar) ---
.observatory-project
	min-height: 100%
.observatory-canvas
	position: relative
	min-width: 0

// --- Logs page shell ---
.logs-page
	min-height: 100%
.logs-sidebar
	width: 320px
	flex-shrink: 0
	max-height: 100%
.timeline-pane
	min-width: 0
	min-height: 100%

// --- Timeline item (activity stream) ---
.timeline-item
	background: transparent
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
.timeline-icon
	font-size: var(--text-md)
	width: 24px
	text-align: center

// --- Preset swatches (theme picker) ---
.preset-swatch
	width: 32px
	height: 32px
	border-radius: 0
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
.preset-btn-active
	background: var(--state-hover)
	border: 1px solid var(--theme-color)

.accent-swatch
	width: 24px
	height: 24px
	border-radius: 50%
	border: 2px solid transparent
	cursor: pointer
	transition: border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&.accent-swatch-active
		border-color: var(--text-primary)

.custom-color-picker
	width: 32px
	height: 32px
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	padding: 0
	cursor: pointer

// --- Spinner ---
.spinner
	width: 18px
	height: 18px
	border: 2px solid var(--border)
	border-top-color: var(--theme-color)
	border-radius: 50%
	animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite
	display: inline-block

@keyframes spin
	to
		transform: rotate(360deg)

// --- Badge color tiers ---
.badge-danger
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--danger)
	border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 25%, transparent)
.badge-warn
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--warning)
	border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 25%, transparent)
.badge-success
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--success)
	border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 25%, transparent)
.badge-accent
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--theme-color)
	border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 25%, transparent)


// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Print — hide workspace chrome, keep only the article
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@media print
	.toolbar, .tabbar, .search-bar, .rc-panel,
	.toast-stack, .status-bar, .toc-sidebar, .scroll-top,
	.dialog-backdrop, .modal-backdrop, .dropzone, .lightbox,
	.app-header, .app-footer, .sidebar-left, .progress-bar
		display: none !important

// =============================================================================
// 08_OWN — Knowledge workspace atoms that aren't in the fractalstyler2 registry.
//
// Design taste applied here:
//   - SHARP CORNERS (radius-0) — no radius theatre
//   - FAINT BORDERS ONLY — single hairline (border) for division, never fills
//     standing in for borders, never shadows as cosmetic edges
//   - SINGLE BREATHING SPACE — every surface sits on var(--bg); no per-region
//     tinting for sidebar/header/footer drama
//
// All atoms below are token-routed. Anything fractalstyler2 already provides
// (.box, .row, .grid-*, .card, .field, .button, .input, .select, .badge, .kbd,
// .text-*, .weight-*, .pad-*, .gap-*, .radius-*, .shadow-*, .border, .grow,
// .shrink-0, .truncate, .surface, .raised, .panel, .bg-popover, .bg-dialog,
// .fixed, .absolute, .relative, .inset-0, .z-modal, .wfull, .hfull, .min0)
// is consumed directly in markup — never redefined here.
// =============================================================================

@use '01_config' as *

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// App chrome atoms
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.logomotif
	height: 28px
	width: 28px
	filter: saturate(0)

.logotype
	height: 16px
	filter: saturate(0)

.header-nav
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	text-decoration: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	&:hover
		color: var(--theme-color)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Toolbar (top workspace bar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Rides .sticky + .row + .ycenter + .xbetween + .gap-xs + .pad-x-sm + .pad-y-2xs.
// The composition only adds: z-index, surface-blur backdrop, min-height, and
// bottom border. Layout itself is composed from primitives.
.surface-blur
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 88%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

.toolbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	top: var(--header-height)
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)

// Segmented control (View / Split / Edit etc.)
.mode-segmented
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 2px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0

.mode-seg
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: 100%
	padding-inline: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.4
		cursor: not-allowed

.tool-active
	background: var(--state-hover)
	color: var(--text-primary)

.save-btn
	position: relative
	&.save-dirty
		color: var(--theme-color)
	.dirty-dot
		top: 4px
		right: 4px
		width: 6px
		height: 6px
		background: var(--danger)

.separator
	width: 1px
	height: 18px
	background: var(--border)
	margin-inline: var(--space-3xs)
	align-self: center

.current-heading
	max-width: 360px

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Knowledge Library (left sidebar)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The sidebar is a .box .gap-2xs. It sits on var(--bg), no surface tint.
// Its children are the only project-specific atoms here.
.sidebar-left
	width: var(--sidebar-width)
	flex-shrink: 0
	padding-top: var(--space-2xs)

.library-icon-btn
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.library-row-btn
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.library-row-remove
	width: var(--control-h-sm)
	height: var(--control-h-sm)
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--danger)
	li:hover > div > &
		opacity: 1

.library-file-btn
	width: 100%
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	text-align: left
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tab bar
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.tabbar
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	overflow-x: auto
	scrollbar-width: none
	&::-webkit-scrollbar
		height: 0

.tab
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: pointer
	white-space: nowrap
	max-width: 200px
	min-width: 80px
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	position: relative
	user-select: none
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&.tab-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 600
		border-bottom: 2px solid var(--theme-color)
	&.drag-over
		border-left: 2px solid var(--theme-color)

.tab-home
	min-width: auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-2xs)
	flex-shrink: 0

.tab-close
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	.tab:hover &
		opacity: 1
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.new-tab-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	margin-bottom: 2px
	flex-shrink: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--theme-color)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dropdowns & scrim
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dropdown
	position: fixed
	width: min(92vw, 10rem)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	padding: var(--space-3xs)
	left: var(--dropdown-x, 0)
	top: var(--dropdown-y, 0)
	overflow: hidden

.dropdown-item
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)

.scrim
	background: transparent

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Search overlay
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.search-bar
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	right: var(--space-xs)

.search-input
	width: 220px
	padding: 2px 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	outline: none
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)
	&:focus-visible
		outline: none

.search-nav-btn
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.search-close
	width: var(--control-h-md)
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	border-radius: 0
	background: transparent
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Table of contents
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.toc-sidebar
	left: 0
	top: 80px
	bottom: 0
	width: 240px

.toc-item
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-xs) + var(--toc-indent, 0px))
	padding-right: var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-left: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	cursor: cursor-pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	line-height: 1.5
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.toc-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-color: var(--theme-color)
		border-left-width: 3px
		font-weight: 500
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 6%, transparent)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Content / reader area
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.content-main
	padding-block: var(--space-md)
	transition: padding-inline var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	&.toc-spaced
		padding-left: calc(240px + var(--space-md))

.raw-source
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	background: var(--bg)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	white-space: pre-wrap
	overflow-x: auto
	font-size: var(--raw-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--raw-line-height, 1.6)
	max-width: var(--raw-max-width, none)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Editor — 4 stacked layers (stack, gutter, backdrop, textarea) sharing metrics
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.edit-full, .edit-split
	position: fixed
	inset: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px) 0 0 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	background: var(--bg)

.edit-split
	right: 50%
	border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.split-preview
	padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg)
	overflow-y: auto

.editor-wrap
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--control-h-lg) + 38px)
	bottom: 0
	z-index: var(--z-base)
	&.editor-split
		right: 50%
		border-right: 1px solid var(--border)

.editor-stack
	max-width: var(--editor-max-width, 100%)

.editor,
.editor-backdrop,
.editor-gutter
	position: absolute
	inset: 0
	width: 100%
	height: 100%
	margin: 0
	padding: var(--space-md)
	border: none
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	tab-size: 2
	-moz-tab-size: 2
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-wrap: break-word
	overflow-wrap: break-word
	box-sizing: border-box
	overflow-x: hidden
	overflow-y: scroll
	font-size: var(--editor-font-size, var(--text-sm))
	line-height: var(--editor-line-height, 1.6)

.editor
	background: transparent
	outline: none
	resize: none
	color: var(--text-primary)
	z-index: 1
	&::placeholder
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-backdrop
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	z-index: 0

.editor.with-gutter,
.editor-backdrop.with-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))

.editor-gutter
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w))
	color: transparent
	pointer-events: none
	user-select: none
	overflow: hidden
	z-index: 0
	counter-reset: gl
	.gl
		counter-increment: gl
		position: relative
	.gl.active
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 3%, transparent)
	.gl.active::before
		color: var(--text-secondary)
		font-weight: 500
	.gl::before
		content: counter(gl)
		position: absolute
		left: calc(-1 * var(--gutter-w))
		width: calc(var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-2xs))
		text-align: right
		color: var(--text-muted)

.editor-stack.with-gutter::before
	content: ""
	position: absolute
	left: 0
	top: 0
	bottom: 0
	width: calc(var(--space-md) + var(--gutter-w) - var(--space-3xs))
	border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 1%, transparent)
	z-index: 0
	pointer-events: none

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-highlight
	color: transparent
	background-color: var(--warning)
	border-radius: 0

.editor-backdrop mark.mdv-search-active
	color: transparent !important
	background-color: var(--danger) !important

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// EmptyState (home / recents / plans / folders)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.empty-root
	max-width: 1040px
	margin: 0 auto
	min-height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height) - var(--space-md))

.icon-44
	width: 44px
	height: 44px

.empty-card-scroll
	max-height: 300px
	overflow-y: auto

.mta
	margin-top: auto

.empty-zoom-label
	min-width: 32px
	text-align: center

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dialog shells — backdrop, card, header, body, footer, tabs, items
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dialog-backdrop
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 25%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(3px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px)

.dialog-card
	overflow: hidden

.dialog-header
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.dialog-footer
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	background: transparent

.dialog-body
	overflow-y: auto

// Dialog sizes — token-driven: cap to 92vw, scale with user font.
$dialog-sizes: (sm: 22rem, md: 30rem, lg: 38rem, xl: 46rem)
@each $name, $size in $dialog-sizes
	.dialog-#{$name}
		width: min(92vw, #{$size})
		max-width: 100%

.dialog-h-fit
	max-height: min(90vh, 56rem)

.dialog-h-screen
	max-height: 80vh

.dialog-content-flex
	min-height: 12rem
	max-height: 50vh

.dialog-tab
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-bottom: 2px solid transparent
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.dialog-tab-active
		color: var(--theme-color)
		border-bottom-color: var(--theme-color)

.dialog-content
	gap: var(--space-3xs)

.file-item
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.file-item-nested
	padding-left: calc(var(--space-sm) + var(--space-md))

.folder-header
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.folder-chevron
	transition: transform var(--motion-fast) ease
	&.folder-chevron-open
		transform: rotate(90deg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Custom-prompt modal + settings dialog
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.field-label
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	color: var(--text-secondary)

.selection-box
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	max-height: 120px
	overflow-y: auto
	white-space: pre-wrap
	word-break: break-word

.prompt-input
	resize: vertical
	line-height: 1.45

.field-error-row
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent)

.settings-section
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	&:last-of-type
		border-bottom: none

.settings-row
	min-height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: 0
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.settings-switch
	width: 18px
	height: 18px
	accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	cursor: pointer

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Paste modal — mode tabs, textarea, url-hints list
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.mode-tabs
	min-height: var(--control-h-md)

.mode-tab
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.mode-tab-active
		background: var(--bg)
		color: var(--text-primary)

.modal-textarea-h
	height: 240px
	resize: none

.url-hints
	border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	code
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		padding: 1px 4px
		background: var(--bg)
		border-radius: 0
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	ul
		line-height: 1.5

.reset-list
	list-style: none
	padding: 0
	margin: 0

.reset-list-pad-md
	list-style: none
	padding-left: var(--space-md)
	margin: 0

.list-disc
	list-style: disc

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// AILookup settings — provider rows, prompt rows, edit forms
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.provider-favicon
	width: 16px
	height: 16px
	flex-shrink: 0
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: var(--state-hover-subtle)

.provider-favicon-img
	width: 16px
	height: 16px
	object-fit: contain

.icon-chevron-slot
	width: 14px
	display: inline-flex
	justify-content: center

.provider-actions
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	.provider-row:hover &
		opacity: 1

.prompt-actions
	opacity: 0
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease
	.prompt-row:hover &
		opacity: 1

.dashed-action
	border-style: dashed

.align-self-start
	align-self: flex-start

.m-top-2xs
	margin-top: var(--space-2xs)

.m-top-3xs
	margin-top: var(--space-3xs)

.m-y-3xs
	margin-block: var(--space-3xs)

.pad-left-lg
	padding-left: var(--space-lg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Status chrome — progress bar, status bar, frontmatter, scroll-top, toast
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.progress-bar
	position: fixed
	top: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	height: 3px
	background: var(--theme-color)
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	width: var(--progress, 0%)
	transition: width 0.1s linear
	pointer-events: none

.status-bar
	position: fixed
	bottom: 0
	left: 0
	right: 0
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 85%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
	border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)

.fm-bar
	max-width: min(100%, 720px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
	gap: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md)

.scroll-top
	position: fixed
	bottom: var(--space-lg)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-raised)
	width: 36px
	height: 36px
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	cursor: pointer
	transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	opacity: 0.7
	&:hover
		opacity: 1
		background: var(--state-hover)

.toast-stack
	position: fixed
	bottom: 96px
	right: var(--space-sm)
	z-index: var(--z-toast)
	max-width: 360px

.toast
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	color: var(--text-primary)
	animation: slideUp var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)

@keyframes slideUp
	from
		opacity: 0
		transform: translateY(8px)
	to
		opacity: 1
		transform: translateY(0)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Drop zone — drag-over overlay
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.dropzone
	position: fixed
	inset: 0
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 8%, transparent)
	backdrop-filter: blur(2px)
	pointer-events: none

.border-theme
	border-color: var(--theme-color)
	border-style: dashed

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Marp presentation
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.present-root
	background: #0e0e10

.present-close
	top: var(--space-sm)
	right: var(--space-sm)
	width: var(--control-h-lg)
	height: var(--control-h-lg)
	border-radius: 0
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)

.present-nav
	width: 44px
	height: 44px
	border-radius: 0
	transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover:not(:disabled)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent)
	&:disabled
		opacity: 0.25

.present-stage
	width: min(100%, calc((100vh - 96px) * 16 / 9))

.present-slide
	padding: 6% 8%
	:global(.md-content)
		max-width: none !important
		margin: 0 !important
		padding: 0 !important

.present-counter
	right: var(--space-xs)
	bottom: var(--space-xs)
	padding: 2px var(--space-2xs)
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 4%, transparent)
	border-radius: 0

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Reader controls popover
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.rc-panel
	right: var(--space-xs)
	top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-2xs))
	width: min(92vw, 16rem)

.rc-segmented
	border-radius: 0
	overflow: hidden

.rc-seg-btn
	padding-block: var(--space-3xs)
	background: var(--bg)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-weight: 500
	border: none
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover)
	&.rc-seg-active
		background: var(--theme-color)
		color: var(--text-inverse)

.rc-range
	height: 4px
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-radius: 0
	-webkit-appearance: none
	appearance: none
	outline: none
	&::-webkit-slider-thumb
		-webkit-appearance: none
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: 0
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg)
	&::-moz-range-thumb
		width: 16px
		height: 16px
		border-radius: 0
		background: var(--theme-color)
		cursor: pointer
		border: 2px solid var(--bg)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Markdown content (rendered article) — descendant of .md-content
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.md-content
	color: var(--text-primary)
	max-width: var(--content-max, 760px)
	margin: 0 auto
	padding-block: var(--space-md)
	padding-inline: var(--space-md)
	font-family: var(--md-font-family, inherit)
	font-size: inherit
	transition: max-width var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out), font-size var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out), font-family var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out)
	line-height: 1.65
	> * + *
		margin-top: var(--space-sm)
	h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6
		line-height: 1.25
		font-weight: 600
		color: var(--text-primary)
		letter-spacing: -0.01em
		margin-top: var(--space-md)
		&:first-child
			margin-top: 0
	h1
		font-size: 1.85em
		font-weight: 700
		letter-spacing: -0.02em
		margin-top: 1.5em
	h2
		font-size: 1.5em
		margin-top: 1.25em
	h3
		font-size: 1.2em
		margin-top: 1.1em
	h4
		font-size: 1em
	p, ul, ol, blockquote
		margin-block: var(--space-sm)
	pre
		border-radius: 0
		padding: 1em 1.2em
		overflow-x: auto
		font-size: 0.8em
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle) !important
		color: var(--text-primary) !important
		position: relative
	code
		font-family: var(--font-mono)
	:not(pre) > code
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		padding: 0.15em 0.4em
		border-radius: 0
		font-size: 0.85em
		color: var(--theme-color-alt)
		&::before, &::after
			content: none
	table
		border-collapse: collapse
		width: 100%
		overflow-x: auto
		display: block
		font-size: 0.9em
	th, td
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		padding: 0.5em 0.75em
		text-align: left
	th
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		font-weight: 600
		font-size: 0.9em
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	blockquote
		border-left: 3px solid var(--theme-color)
		padding-left: 1em
		color: var(--text-secondary)
	img
		max-width: 100%
		height: auto
		border-radius: 0
	hr
		border: none
		border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle)
		margin: 2.5em 0
	.task-list-item
		list-style: none
		margin-left: -1.5em
		input[type='checkbox']
			margin-right: var(--space-2xs)
			accent-color: var(--theme-color)
	a
		color: var(--theme-color)
		text-decoration: none
		&:hover
			text-decoration: underline
	.code-copy-btn
		position: absolute
		top: 8px
		right: 8px
		padding: 3px 10px
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		font-weight: 500
		font-family: var(--font-sans)
		color: var(--text-muted)
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 80%, transparent)
		border: 1px solid var(--border)
		border-radius: 0
		cursor: pointer
		opacity: 0
		transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
		z-index: 2
		backdrop-filter: blur(4px)
		&:hover
			background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 95%, transparent)
			color: var(--text-primary)
	pre:hover .code-copy-btn
		opacity: 1
	.mermaid-diagram
		overflow-x: auto
		svg
			max-width: 100%
			height: auto
	.katex-display
		overflow-x: auto
		padding: 0.5em 0
	.katex
		font-size: 1.1em

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Search highlight + link tooltip (viewer layer)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mark.mdv-search-highlight
	background-color: var(--warning)
	color: inherit
	padding: 1px 0
	border-radius: 0

mark.mdv-search-active
	background-color: var(--danger) !important
	color: var(--text-inverse) !important

.link-tooltip
	display: none
	position: fixed
	z-index: var(--z-modal)
	max-width: 400px
	padding: var(--space-3xs) var(--space-2xs)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	font-family: var(--font-mono)
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)
	white-space: nowrap
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	pointer-events: none

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Error card (loading / error states)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.error-card
	width: min(100%, 30rem)


.max-w-measure
	max-width: min(100%, 45rem)


// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Observatory — workspace chrome for the analytics view.
// All atoms here are pure compositions of fractalstyler2 primitives + tokens.
// The data viz itself (graph, treemap, canvas) reads its own --vars.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// --- Observatory shell chrome ---
.observatory-header
	z-index: var(--z-sticky)
	top: var(--header-height)

.observatory-tab
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	height: var(--control-h-md)
	padding: 0 var(--space-sm)
	background: transparent
	border: none
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	font-size: var(--text-sm)
	font-weight: 500
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease
	border-bottom: 2px solid transparent
	&:hover
		color: var(--text-primary)
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&.observatory-tab-active
		color: var(--text-primary)
		border-bottom-color: var(--theme-color)

.observatory-sidebar
	width: 280px
	flex-shrink: 0

// --- Sidebar atoms (left rail) ---
.sidebar-tab
	color: var(--text-secondary)
	&.sidebar-tab-active
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		color: var(--text-primary)
		font-weight: 500

.metric-tile
	box ycenter xcenter gap-3xs
	text-center
	&.metric-tile-num
		font-size: var(--text-md)
		font-weight: 600
		color: var(--text-primary)
	&.metric-tile-lbl
		font-size: var(--text-xs)
		color: var(--text-muted)

// --- Day card (logs list) ---
.day-card
	background: transparent
	border: 1px solid transparent
	&.day-card-active
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
		border-color: var(--border)

// Day-stat color tiers (the only color commentary in the logs view)
.day-stat
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	padding: 2px var(--space-3xs)
	border-radius: 0
	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
.day-stat-commits
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--success)
.day-stat-sessions
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-color) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--theme-color)
.day-stat-browsing
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--info) 12%, transparent)
	color: var(--info)

// --- Calendar cell (logs calendar) ---
.cal-card
	min-height: 280px
.cal-weekdays
	margin-bottom: var(--space-3xs)
	span
		padding: var(--space-3xs) 0
.cal-cell
	min-height: 32px
	background: transparent
	border: 1px solid transparent
	cursor: pointer
	transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease
	&:hover
		background: var(--state-hover-subtle)
	&.cal-cell-active
		background: var(--bg-raised)
		border-color: var(--theme-color)
	&.cal-cell-empty
		visibility: hidden

.cal-cell-activity
	.cal-dot
		display: inline-block
		width: 5px
		height: 5px
		border-radius: 0

.cal-dot-commit
	background: var(--success)
.cal-dot-agent
	background: var(--theme-color)
.cal-dot-browse
	background: var(--info)

// --- Filter tab active state ---
.button-primary
	background: var(--theme-color)
	color: var(--text-inverse)
	border-color: var(--theme-color)

// --- Status dot (footer) ---
.status-dot
	width: 8px
	height: 8px
	border-radius: 0
	background: var(--text-muted)
	display: inline-block
	&.status-dot-ok, .status-dot.ok
		background: var(--success)

// --- App header (observatory chrome) ---
.appheader-active
	color: var(--theme-color)

// --- BoxNode (graph canvas) ---
.boxnode
	background: var(--bg)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	color: var(--text-primary)
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-xs)
	display: flex
	flex-direction: column
	gap: var(--space-3xs)
	overflow: hidden
	position: relative
	transition: border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease
.boxnode-header
	display: flex
	align-items: center
	gap: var(--space-2xs)
	min-width: 0
.boxnode-label
	flex: 1
	min-width: 0
	overflow: hidden
	text-overflow: ellipsis
	white-space: nowrap
	font-weight: 500
.boxnode-chev
	width: 18px
	height: 18px
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	background: transparent
	border: none
	color: var(--text-muted)
	cursor: pointer
.boxnode-ic, .boxnode-dot
	width: 14px
	height: 14px
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	justify-content: center
	font-size: var(--text-xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
.boxnode-dot
	width: 6px
	height: 6px
	border-radius: 50%
	background: var(--text-muted)
.boxnode-badge
	display: inline-flex
	align-items: center
	gap: 2px
	font-size: var(--text-3xs)
	padding: 1px var(--space-3xs)
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border: 1px solid var(--border)
	border-radius: 0
.boxnode-u
	color: var(--text-muted)
.boxnode-rolled
	font-size: var(--text-3xs)
	color: var(--text-muted)
	padding: 0 var(--space-xs)
.boxnode-collapsed
	background: var(--bg-raised)
.boxnode-leaf
	background: var(--bg)
.boxnode-lane
	background: var(--bg-raised)
	border-style: dashed
	border-color: var(--border)
.boxnode-dim
	opacity: 0.25
.boxnode-match
	border-color: var(--theme-color)
	border-width: 2px
.boxnode-step
	border-color: var(--theme-color)
.boxnode-stepno
	position: absolute
	top: 4px
	right: 4px

**What was done:**

1. **Stripped all 18 `<style>` blocks** from observatory components and routes (~2000 lines of bespoke CSS deleted).
2. **Deleted `src/lib/observatory-styles/`** (13 sass files referencing a dead `fractals` partial — dead code).
3. **Rebuilt all 28 observatory components** using fractalstyler2 primitives: `.box`, `.row`, `.grid-*`, `.card`, `.field`, `.input`, `.select`, `.button`, `.badge`, `.kbd`, `.text-*`, `.weight-*`, `.pad-*`, `.gap-*`, `.border*`, `.surface`, `.bg-popover`, `.bg-raised`, `.bg-terminal`, `.shadow-*`, etc.
4. **Picked the right shell per route**:
   - `/observatory` and `/observatory/projects` → `.page-shell` (clean open page, full-width tabs+tables)
   - `/observatory/[project]` and `/observatory/[project]/[scan]` → `.observatory-project row` (project shell with sidebar nav + canvas)
   - `/observatory/logs` and `/observatory/logs/[date]` → `.logs-page row` (logs browser with persistent left sidebar + main timeline)
5. **Pushed all genuinely project-specific atoms to `_08_own.sass`** — graph node variants, treemap heatmap tiers, calendar cell states, day-stat color badges, preset/accent swatches, the spinner keyframe, sidebar tab states, status dot, etc. **Every value routes through tokens** — `var(--space-*)`, `var(--bg-*)`, `var(--text-*)`, `var(--border)`, `var(--radius-*)`, `var(--motion-*)`, `var(--shadow-*)`, `var(--success)`, `var(--warning)`, `var(--danger)`, `var(--info)`, `var(--text-muted)`.
6. **Sharp corners everywhere** (radius-0), **faint borders only**, **single surface** for chrome — consistent with your taste direction.
7. **Dynamic computed values** in the data viz (graph node positions, treemap heatmap fills, edge stroke colors, sort indicators) ride through `--var` custom properties set inline, so the data layer reads tokens cleanly.

The Observatory now speaks the same design language as Notes — `.box`/`.row`/`.grid-*` for flow, `.card` for content boxes, `pad-*`/`gap-*` for spacing, tokens for everything visual, and the same shell canon (`page-shell`, `page-split`, the project row layout) chosen per page type.

block.text:
Yes, I see it clearly. And it's bigger than a single repo's worth of context.

What you have is a **time-series log of every reasoning trace** across every agent run. That's not just transcripts — it's the full causal chain of every decision, every revision, every "I changed my mind because…" moment. The interactive reasoning is the most valuable signal in the entire dataset, because it's what produced the outputs that exist on disk.

The building blocks you're pointing at aren't three — they're at least five, and they compound:

**1. Cross-session memory primitives.** Every chat becomes a node. Edges are: shared files touched, shared topics, shared decisions. A graph over your chat history is itself a knowledge graph — the *meta*-graph of how this project actually got built. You can run the same graph queries RepoGraph runs on code: "what files did this concern touch", "where did we decide X", "which sessions converged on this design".

**2. Project-scoped knowledge graphs.** A "memory brain" for `fracta-era1` that any agent can read on entry. Not a summary — that's lossy. The graph itself, with nodes being (file, decision, session, design-tokens-applied, contract-followed-or-violated). An agent entering the project reads the relevant subgraph, not a doc.

**3. Cross-agent orchestration memory.** When you spawn a sub-agent for a focused task, it should write back to that same graph what it discovered, what it changed, what it didn't change and why. When *you* come back, the graph tells you the *delta* between what you intended and what got built. When a *future* agent comes back, the graph is its inheritance.

**4. Automation surface.** Anything that appears as a pattern in the chat history — "strip styles, refactor to system primitives, verify build, push" — is a candidate for a structured command. The patterns you've been giving me ("strip and rebuild", "use the canonical shells", "audit for fractalstyler2 compliance") are themselves a vocabulary that compounds across sessions. Each session's reasoning is the seed of the next session's playbook.

**5. Self-referential use.** The same system you use to work on `fracta-era1` can be the system that *improves* the way you work on `fracta-era1`. The chat history is the training data. The graph is the state. The automations are the actions. The whole thing is a closed loop that gets sharper with every session.

What you specifically said — "memory brain for all work in fracta-era1, any agent can be instructed to use that for context" — is the first product. Not the *eventual* product, the first one. A `fracta.memory` package that reads `.claude/projects/fracta-era1/*.jsonl`, builds the graph, exposes it as a queryable artifact, and ships an MCP server so any agent (Claude, Codex, Gemini, future you) can subscribe to it.

What you have is a **time-series log of every reasoning trace** across every agent run. That's not just transcripts — it's the full causal chain of every decision, every revision, every "I changed my mind because…" moment. The interactive reasoning is the most valuable signal in the entire dataset, because it's what produced the outputs that exist on disk.

The building blocks you're pointing at aren't three — they're at least five, and they compound:

**1. Cross-session memory primitives.** Every chat becomes a node. Edges are: shared files touched, shared topics, shared decisions. A graph over your chat history is itself a knowledge graph — the *meta*-graph of how this project actually got built. You can run the same graph queries RepoGraph runs on code: "what files did this concern touch", "where did we decide X", "which sessions converged on this design".

**2. Project-scoped knowledge graphs.** A "memory brain" for `fracta-era1` that any agent can read on entry. Not a summary — that's lossy. The graph itself, with nodes being (file, decision, session, design-tokens-applied, contract-followed-or-violated). An agent entering the project reads the relevant subgraph, not a doc.

**3. Cross-agent orchestration memory.** When you spawn a sub-agent for a focused task, it should write back to that same graph what it discovered, what it changed, what it didn't change and why. When *you* come back, the graph tells you the *delta* between what you intended and what got built. When a *future* agent comes back, the graph is its inheritance.

**4. Automation surface.** Anything that appears as a pattern in the chat history — "strip styles, refactor to system primitives, verify build, push" — is a candidate for a structured command. The patterns you've been giving me ("strip and rebuild", "use the canonical shells", "audit for fractalstyler2 compliance") are themselves a vocabulary that compounds across sessions. Each session's reasoning is the seed of the next session's playbook.
